-- Full-runtime development package. Contact Core 3.1 remains an independent service.
-- Requiring this module does not start movement replication.
require(script:WaitForChild("Await",30)).Ready(script)
local Core=require(script.Core)
local Types=require(script.Replication.Shared.Types)
export type Entity=Types.Entity
export type EntityConfig=Types.EntityConfig
export type EntityConfigInput=Types.EntityConfigInput
export type MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE=Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE
export type SnapshotData<V,T> = Types.SnapshotData<V,T>
export type Snapshot<V,T> = Types.Snapshot<V,T>
export type Ticker=Types.Ticker
export type ClientClock=Types.ClientClock
export type InterpolationBuffer=Types.InterpolationBuffer
export type PlayerEntityHolder=Types.PlayerEntityHolder
export type Connection=Types.Connection
export type Event<F,T...> = Types.Event<F,T...>
export type Signal<F,T...> = Types.Signal<F,T...>
export type ReplicationRule=Types.ReplicationRule
export type EntityReceivePacket=Types.EntityReceivePacket
export type ClientEntitiesStats=Types.ClientEntitiesStats
export type ServerEntitiesStats=Types.ServerEntitiesStats
local F={Version="3.3.0-dev",CoreVersion=Core.Version,WireVersion=2,Shapes=Core.Shapes,new=Core.new,Explain=Core.Explain}
local replication
local function original()
	if not replication then replication=require(script.Replication) end
	return replication
end
function F.Start(config)
	assert(script:GetAttribute("ChronoForkRuntimeMode")~="Engine","This package uses the engine simulation adapter; do not start a second movement driver")
	local ok,authority=pcall(function() return workspace.AuthorityMode end)
	assert(not ok or authority~=Enum.AuthorityMode.Server,
		"This place uses Roblox server authority. Use Competitive.Simulation.Bind for its simulation; do not also start custom CFrame replication.")
	return original().Start(config)
end
function F.IsStarted() return replication~=nil and replication.IsStarted() end
function F.GetStartupState() return if replication then replication.GetStartupState() else "idle" end
F.Competitive=require(script.Competitive)
F.Experimental=table.freeze({Prediction=require(script.Replication.Shared.ExperimentalPrediction)})
-- Public original APIs and paths are retained in Replication. Existing Core calls
-- remain available through new/Shapes/Explain and the explicit Core child.
return setmetatable(F,{__index=function(_,key) return original()[key] end})

--!strict
-- Chrono V3: server historical contact evidence. No automatic gameplay/network side effects.
local Guard=require(script.Guard)
local Contract=require(script.Contract)
local History=require(script.History)
local Shapes=require(script.Shapes)
local Types=require(script.Types)
local API={Shapes=Shapes,Version="3.1.0"}
-- Optional explanation helper. It never changes the result or runs a hit check.
function API.Explain(reason: (string | {reason: string})?): Types.Explanation return require(script.Help).Explain(reason) end
local Methods={} Methods.__index=Methods
local private=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function session(self)
	local s=assert(private[self],"This Chrono instance was destroyed, or the call used the wrong object.")
	assert(not s.inCallback,"Do not call Chrono again from inside a position or rule function. Return its data first.")
	return s
end
local function call(s,callback,...)
	s.inCallback=true
	local out=table.pack(Contract.Call(callback,...))
	s.inCallback=false
	return table.unpack(out,1,out.n)
end
local function bounded(n,lo,hi) return Guard.Number(n) and n>=lo and n<=hi end
local function name(n) return type(n)=="string" and #n>0 and #n<=64 end
local function frozenResult(ok,reason,fields)
	local out=fields or {} out.ok=ok out.reason=reason
	if not out.contacts then out.contacts=table.freeze({}) end
	return table.freeze(out)
end
local function failure(s,reason,fields)
	s.stats.rejected+=1 s.stats.lastRejection=reason
	return frozenResult(false,reason,fields)
end
local function fresh(s)
	local ok,now=call(s,s.clock)
	if not ok or not Guard.Number(now) then return nil,"clock_fault" end
	if not s.time then return nil,"capture_required" end
	if now<s.time-1e-6 then return nil,"clock_reversed" end
	if now-s.time>s.maxGap then return nil,"capture_stale" end
	return now
end
function API.new(options: Types.Options?): Types.Service
	assert(game:GetService("RunService"):IsServer(),"Chrono V3 runs on the server")
	local o=options or {}
	local seconds,rate,gap=o.seconds or 0.6,o.rate or 60,o.maxGap or 0.075
	assert(bounded(seconds,0.05,10) and bounded(rate,1,240) and bounded(gap,0.001,1),"Use seconds=0.05 to 10, rate=1 to 240, and maxGap=0.001 to 1. These control saved-position storage.")
	assert(bounded(o.maxRewind or 0,0,seconds),"maxRewind must be zero or a positive number no greater than seconds (the time you keep past positions).")
	assert(o.clock==nil or type(o.clock)=="function","clock must be a function that returns server time in seconds, or leave it unset.")
	assert(o.resolveRewind==nil or type(o.resolveRewind)=="function","resolveRewind must be a function that returns an approved earlier-time delay, or leave it unset.")
	assert(o.world==nil or type(o.world)=="function","world must be an obstacle-check function, or leave it unset.")
	local self=setmetatable({},Methods)
	private[self]={clock=o.clock or function() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end,
		seconds=seconds,capacity=math.ceil(rate*seconds)+2,maxGap=gap,maxRewind=o.maxRewind or 0,
		resolveRewind=o.resolveRewind,world=o.world,actors={},actions={},actionCount=0,roster=0,
		stats={captures=0,queries=0,accepted=0,rejected=0,contacts=0,providerFaults=0,lastRejection="none"}}
	return self :: any -- Public method types help Studio autocomplete; checks above still run.
end
function Methods:Track(id,binding)
	local s=session(self)
	assert(name(id) and type(binding)=="table" and name(binding.kind),"Track needs short text id and kind names. Example: id='player-12', kind='player'.")
	assert(not s.actors[id],"This id is already tracked. Call Untrack before deliberately registering a replacement.")
	assert(type(binding.capture)=="function","Track needs capture=function(time) ... end to supply the object's position, hitboxes and game values.")
	assert(bounded(binding.maxSpeed,0,4096) and bounded(binding.maxRadius,0.001,512),"Set maxSpeed from 0 to 4096 studs/second and maxRadius from 0.001 to 512 studs. They must describe your allowed movement and hitbox extent.")
	local trust=binding.trust or "unverified"
	assert(trust=="unverified" or trust=="serverValidated" or trust=="serverSimulated","Use trust='unverified', 'serverValidated' or 'serverSimulated'. Choose a trusted label only after your server actually checks or calculates the data.")
	local count=0 for _ in s.actors do count+=1 end assert(count<256,"This instance already tracks 256 objects. Remove objects no longer needed before adding another.")
	s.actors[id]={id=id,kind=binding.kind,capture=binding.capture,trust=trust,status="awaiting_capture",faults=0,
		history=History.new({seconds=s.seconds,capacity=s.capacity,maxGap=s.maxGap,maxSpeed=binding.maxSpeed,maxRadius=binding.maxRadius})}
	s.roster+=1
end
function Methods:Untrack(id)
	local s=session(self) if not s.actors[id] then return false end
	s.actors[id]=nil s.roster+=1 return true
end
function Methods:Discontinuity(id,reason)
	local s=session(self) local actor=assert(s.actors[id],"actor not tracked")
	local ok,now=call(s,s.clock) assert(ok and Guard.Number(now),"clock fault")
	actor.history:Break(math.max(now,s.time or now)) actor.status=reason or "discontinuity" actor.quarantined=false
end
-- Invoke after your authoritative simulation. All providers must describe the same instant.
-- An optional timestamp supports a fixed-step server simulation using this clock domain.
function Methods:Capture(time)
	local s=session(self)
	local ok,now=call(s,s.clock)
	if not ok or not Guard.Number(now) then return frozenResult(false,"clock_fault") end
	time=time or now
	if not Guard.Number(time) or time>now+1e-6 or now-time>s.maxGap then return frozenResult(false,"invalid_capture_time") end
	if s.time and time<=s.time then return frozenResult(false,"non_monotonic") end
	s.time=time s.stats.captures+=1
	local faults={}
	for id,actor in s.actors do
		if actor.quarantined then table.insert(faults,table.freeze({id=id,reason="quarantined"})) continue end
		local called,snapshot=call(s,actor.capture,time)
		local pushed,reason=false,"provider_fault"
		if called then
			-- Validation itself can encounter an erroneous table metamethod from an adapter.
			local validated,accepted,why=call(s,function() return actor.history:Push(time,snapshot) end)
			pushed=validated and accepted==true
			reason=if validated then why else "invalid_snapshot"
		end
		if not pushed then
			actor.history:Break(time) actor.faults+=1 s.stats.providerFaults+=1
			actor.status=reason actor.quarantined=true table.insert(faults,table.freeze({id=id,reason=reason}))
		else actor.status="captured" end
	end
	for token,action in s.actions do
		if time>action.started+action.close or action.roster~=s.roster then s.actions[token]=nil s.actionCount-=1 end
	end
	return frozenResult(#faults==0,if #faults==0 then "captured" else "capture_fault",{time=time,faults=table.freeze(faults)})
end
-- Call only after your existing server move/action service authorizes the action.
-- No client-facing RemoteEvent is created. Context is consumed only by YOUR timing resolver.
function Methods:BeginAction(actorId,profile,approvedContext)
	local s=session(self) local now,err=fresh(s)
	if not now then return nil,err end
	local actor=s.actors[actorId] if not actor then return nil,"actor_missing" end
	if actor.trust=="unverified" then return nil,"unverified_source" end
	if type(profile)~="table" then return nil,"invalid_profile" end
	local shape=Shapes.Copy(profile.shape)
	local opening,closing=profile.opens or 0,profile.closes or 0.25
	if not shape or not bounded(opening,0,10) or not bounded(closing,opening,10)
		or not bounded(profile.maxReach or 32,0,4096) or Shapes.Reach(shape)>(profile.maxReach or 32)
		or not Guard.Integer(profile.maxTargets or 1,1,256) then return nil,"invalid_profile" end
	if profile.eligible~=nil and type(profile.eligible)~="function" then return nil,"invalid_profile" end
	if profile.world~=nil and type(profile.world)~="boolean" then return nil,"invalid_profile" end
	if profile.world and (not s.world or shape.kind~="sweep") then return nil,"world_provider_or_shape" end
	if type(profile.targets)~="table" then return nil,"target_kinds_required" end
	local kinds,count={},0
	for _,kind in profile.targets do
		if not name(kind) then return nil,"invalid_target_kind" end kinds[kind]=true count+=1
	end
	if count==0 or count>32 then return nil,"target_kinds_required" end
	local rewind=0
	if s.resolveRewind then
		local resolved,value=call(s,s.resolveRewind,actorId,approvedContext,s.time)
		if not resolved or not bounded(value,0,s.maxRewind) then return nil,"rewind_rejected" end rewind=value
	end
	local source,reason=actor.history:Sample(s.time-rewind,now)
	if not source then return nil,"source_"..reason end
	local actorActions=0 for _,a in s.actions do if a.actor==actorId then actorActions+=1 end end
	if s.actionCount>=512 or actorActions>=4 then return nil,"action_capacity" end
	local token=table.freeze({})
	s.actions[token]={actor=actorId,epoch=actor.history.epoch,roster=s.roster,started=s.time,
		open=opening,close=closing,shape=shape,kinds=table.freeze(kinds),eligible=profile.eligible,
		world=profile.world==true,maxTargets=profile.maxTargets or 1,rewind=rewind,hit={},totalHits=0}
	s.actionCount+=1
	return token
end
function Methods:EndAction(token)
	local s=session(self) if not s.actions[token] then return false end
	s.actions[token]=nil s.actionCount-=1 return true
end
function Methods:Query(token)
	local s=session(self) s.stats.queries+=1
	local action=s.actions[token] if not action then return failure(s,"invalid_action") end
	local now,err=fresh(s) if not now then return failure(s,err) end
	if action.roster~=s.roster then return failure(s,"roster_changed") end
	local actor=s.actors[action.actor]
	if not actor or actor.history.epoch~=action.epoch then return failure(s,"source_epoch_changed") end
	local elapsed=s.time-action.started
	if elapsed<action.open then return failure(s,"not_active") end
	if elapsed>action.close then return failure(s,"action_expired") end
	if action.lastTime==s.time then return failure(s,"duplicate_query") end
	if action.totalHits>=action.maxTargets then return failure(s,"action_spent") end
	local time=s.time-action.rewind
	local source,reason=actor.history:Sample(time,now)
	if not source then return failure(s,"source_"..reason) end
	local transformed,query=Contract.Call(Shapes.At,action.shape,source.root)
	if not transformed then return failure(s,"shape_out_of_bounds") end
	local fraction=1 local blocked=false
	if action.world then
		local called,cover=call(s,s.world,time,now,query)
		if not called or type(cover)~="table" or cover.covered~=true or type(cover.blocked)~="boolean"
			or not bounded(cover.fraction,0,1) then return failure(s,"world_unknown") end
		blocked=cover.blocked fraction=if blocked then cover.fraction else 1
	end
	local contacts={}
	for id,target in s.actors do
		if id==action.actor or not action.kinds[target.kind] or action.hit[id] then continue end
		-- A missing target can hide a closer contact. Never return a partial success.
		if target.trust=="unverified" then return failure(s,"unverified_target",{actor=id}) end
		local snapshot,why=target.history:Sample(time,now)
		if not snapshot then return failure(s,"target_"..why,{actor=id}) end
		if action.eligible then
			local called,allowed=call(s,action.eligible,source.state,snapshot.state,id,target.kind)
			if not called or type(allowed)~="boolean" then return failure(s,"rules_fault",{actor=id}) end
			if not allowed then continue end
		end
		local best,zoneName=nil,nil
		for zone,volume in snapshot.zones do
			local t=Shapes.Intersect(query,volume)
			-- Cover wins exact ties. With no cover callback, include sweep endpoint tangency.
			if t and (t<fraction or (not blocked and t<=fraction)) and (not best or t<best or (t==best and zone<zoneName)) then best=t zoneName=zone end
		end
		if best then
			local distance=if query.kind=="sweep" then (query.finish-query.start).Magnitude*best else 0
			table.insert(contacts,table.freeze({id=id,kind=target.kind,zone=zoneName,distance=distance,fraction=best,
				time=time,epoch=snapshot.epoch,state=snapshot.state,root=snapshot.root}))
		end
	end
	table.sort(contacts,function(a,b) if a.fraction~=b.fraction then return a.fraction<b.fraction end return a.id<b.id end)
	while #contacts>action.maxTargets-action.totalHits do table.remove(contacts) end
	-- Commit duplicate suppression only after every relevant provider/rule/world check passed.
	for _,contact in contacts do action.hit[contact.id]=true end
	action.totalHits+=#contacts action.lastTime=s.time
	s.stats.accepted+=1 s.stats.contacts+=#contacts
	return frozenResult(true,"covered",{time=time,capturedAt=s.time,rewind=action.rewind,source=source,
		contacts=table.freeze(contacts),shape=query})
end
function Methods:Inspect()
	local s=session(self) local actors={}
	for id,a in s.actors do
		local row=a.history:Latest()
		table.insert(actors,table.freeze({id=id,kind=a.kind,declaredTrust=a.trust,status=a.status,
			captured=row~=nil,latest=if row then row.time else nil,epoch=a.history.epoch,faults=a.faults}))
	end
	table.sort(actors,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
	return table.freeze({version=API.Version,time=s.time,actors=table.freeze(actors),activeActions=s.actionCount,
		stats=table.freeze(table.clone(s.stats)),worldEnabled=s.world~=nil,maxRewind=s.maxRewind})
end
function Methods:Destroy() session(self) private[self]=nil end
return table.freeze(API)

--!strict
-- These guards contain yielding adapters. They cannot preempt an infinite CPU loop.
local Guard = require(script.Parent.Guard)
local Contract = {}
function Contract.Call(callback, ...)
	if type(callback) ~= "function" then return false, "callback_missing" end
	local thread = coroutine.create(callback)
	local result = table.pack(coroutine.resume(thread, ...))
	if not result[1] then return false, tostring(result[2]) end
	if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then
		coroutine.close(thread)
		return false, "callback_yielded"
	end
	return true, table.unpack(result, 2, result.n)
end
function Contract.State(state)
	if type(state) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local result, count = {}, 0
	for key, value in state do
		count += 1
		if count > 32 or type(key) ~= "string" or #key > 64 then return nil end
		if type(value) == "number" then
			if not Guard.Number(value) or math.abs(value) > 1e12 then return nil end
		elseif type(value) == "string" then
			if #value > 128 then return nil end
		elseif type(value) ~= "boolean" then return nil end
		result[key] = value
	end
	return table.freeze(result)
end
function Contract.SameState(a, b)
	for k, v in a do if b[k] ~= v then return false end end
	for k in b do if a[k] == nil then return false end end
	return true
end
return table.freeze(Contract)

--!strict
local Guard = require(script.Parent.Guard)
local Geometry = {}
local EPSILON = 1e-9

function Geometry.SegmentDistanceSquared(start: Vector3,finish: Vector3,point: Vector3): number
	local delta=finish-start
	local lengthSquared=delta:Dot(delta)
	local alpha=if lengthSquared>1e-12 then math.clamp((point-start):Dot(delta)/lengthSquared,0,1) else 0
	local offset=point-(start+delta*alpha)
	return offset:Dot(offset)
end

function Geometry.RayOBB(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, length: number, frame: CFrame, size: Vector3): number?
	if not Guard.Vector(origin) or not Guard.Unit(direction) or not Guard.Number(length) or length < 0
		or not Guard.Frame(frame) or not Guard.Size(size) then return nil end
	local o, d, half = frame:PointToObjectSpace(origin), frame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction), size * 0.5
	local enter, leave = 0, length
	for _, axis in {"X", "Y", "Z"} do
		local start, delta, extent = o[axis], d[axis], half[axis]
		if math.abs(delta) < EPSILON then
			if math.abs(start) > extent then return nil end
		else
			local a, b = (-extent - start) / delta, (extent - start) / delta
			if a > b then a, b = b, a end
			enter, leave = math.max(enter, a), math.min(leave, b)
			if enter > leave then return nil end
		end
	end
	return enter
end

-- Exact moving sphere vs a stationary OBB, including rounded edges/corners.
-- Split the ray at box-plane crossings; point-to-box distance is quadratic on each interval.
function Geometry.SphereSweepOBB(start: Vector3, finish: Vector3, radius: number, frame: CFrame, size: Vector3): number?
	if not Guard.Vector(start) or not Guard.Vector(finish) or not Guard.Number(radius) or radius < 0 or radius > 32
		or not Guard.Frame(frame) or not Guard.Size(size) then return nil end
	local origin = frame:PointToObjectSpace(start)
	local delta = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(finish - start)
	local half = size * 0.5
	local cuts = {0, 1}
	for _, axis in {"X", "Y", "Z"} do
		if math.abs(delta[axis]) > EPSILON then
			for _, sign in {-1, 1} do
				local t = (sign * half[axis] - origin[axis]) / delta[axis]
				if t > 0 and t < 1 then table.insert(cuts, t) end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(cuts)
	for i = 1, #cuts - 1 do
		local lower, upper = cuts[i], cuts[i + 1]
		local midpoint = (lower + upper) * 0.5
		local a, b, c = 0, 0, -radius * radius
		for _, axis in {"X", "Y", "Z"} do
			local p = origin[axis] + delta[axis] * midpoint
			if math.abs(p) > half[axis] then
				local offset = origin[axis] - (if p > 0 then half[axis] else -half[axis])
				a += delta[axis] * delta[axis]
				b += 2 * delta[axis] * offset
				c += offset * offset
			end
		end
		if (a * lower + b) * lower + c <= EPSILON then return lower end
		if a > EPSILON then
			local discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c
			if discriminant >= -EPSILON then
				local root = (-b - math.sqrt(math.max(discriminant, 0))) / (2 * a)
				if root >= lower - EPSILON and root <= upper + EPSILON then return math.clamp(root, lower, upper) end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

return table.freeze(Geometry)

--!strict
local Guard = {}

function Guard.Number(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

function Guard.Integer(value: any, minimum: number, maximum: number): boolean
	return Guard.Number(value) and value % 1 == 0 and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end

function Guard.Vector(value: any, limit: number?): boolean
	if typeof(value) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
	local bound = limit or 1e7
	return Guard.Number(value.X) and Guard.Number(value.Y) and Guard.Number(value.Z)
		and math.abs(value.X) <= bound and math.abs(value.Y) <= bound and math.abs(value.Z) <= bound
end

function Guard.Frame(value: any, limit: number?): boolean
	if typeof(value) ~= "CFrame" or not Guard.Vector(value.Position, limit) then return false end
	for _, component in {value:GetComponents()} do
		if not Guard.Number(component) then return false end
	end
	-- CFrame.new accepts explicit matrix entries. Reject scaled/sheared/reflected matrices.
	local x,y,z=value.RightVector,value.UpVector,value.ZVector
	return math.abs(x.Magnitude-1)<1e-4 and math.abs(y.Magnitude-1)<1e-4
		and math.abs(z.Magnitude-1)<1e-4 and math.abs(x:Dot(y))<1e-4
		and math.abs(y:Dot(z))<1e-4 and math.abs(z:Dot(x))<1e-4
		and x:Cross(y):Dot(z)>0.9999
end

function Guard.Size(value: any, maximum: number?): boolean
	return Guard.Vector(value, maximum or 512) and value.X > 0 and value.Y > 0 and value.Z > 0
end

function Guard.Unit(value: any): boolean
	return Guard.Vector(value, 1.01) and math.abs(value.Magnitude - 1) <= 0.001
end

return table.freeze(Guard)

-- Help text only. Looking up a message never changes a hit check or trusts a position.
local Help={}
local terms={
	{"authoritative","Server decides","The server makes or checks the value used to decide a hit. A player cannot make a position valid just by sending it.","A tackle uses a position your server movement code has checked."},
	{"server","Server","The computer running the shared game rules for all players. In Studio Play, you can switch between the server and a player's client.","The server decides who gets the ball."},
	{"client","Client","One player's running copy of the game. It handles input, the camera and what that player sees.","A LocalScript reads the tackle button."},
	{"history","Saved past positions","A short list of earlier positions, hitboxes and game values, with the time of each record. Chrono keeps these in memory and later removes old records.","Keep the last 0.6 seconds so a check can use an earlier position."},
	{"snapshot","One saved record","The position, hitboxes and game values of one object at one time.","At time 10.2, the ball was here and the player was on team 2."},
	{"actor","Tracked object","Anything Chrono checks: a player, a ball, an NPC or another game object. It does not have to be a character.","Register the football as kind ball."},
	{"provider","Function that supplies data","A function you write. Chrono calls it to get an object's position, hitboxes and game values.","Read a ball position calculated by your server and return a sphere around it."},
	{"adapter","Connection to your game code","A small piece of code that connects Chrono calls to the scripts your game already uses. Bindings is the generated module for these connections.","When your move script accepts a tackle, start a Chrono action."},
	{"bindings","Connections to your game code","The functions that connect your players, moves and rules to Chrono. The setup creates a Bindings module for you to edit.","Call Bindings.Track when your game adds a player."},
	{"callback","Function given to another function","A function Chrono calls when it needs data or a rule result. The function must finish without task.wait or waiting for an event.","eligible = function(source, target) return source.team ~= target.team end"},
	{"root","Reference position","The main position and direction from which an object's hitboxes are measured. It is a CFrame value; it need not be a part named HumanoidRootPart.","For a ball, its center can be the root."},
	{"cframe","Position and direction (CFrame)","A Roblox value that stores both where something is and which way it faces.","CFrame.new(0, 0, -3) places a local hitbox 3 studs in front."},
	{"local space","Relative to an object","Measure a shape from the object's reference position and facing direction. It moves with that object.","A tackle box stays 3 studs in front of the player."},
	{"world space","Position in the map","Measure a shape in the map's coordinate system, rather than from one object.","A provider returns the ball hitbox at the ball's map position."},

function Help.Explain(value)
	local code=if type(value)=="table" then value.reason else value
	if type(code)~="string" then code="unknown" end
	local key,subject=code,nil
	if code:sub(1,7)=="source_" and messages[code]==nil then key=code:sub(8) subject="Object doing the move"
	elseif code:sub(1,7)=="target_" and messages[code]==nil then key=code:sub(8) subject="Possible target" end
	local entry=messages[key]
	return table.freeze({code=code,known=entry~=nil,subject=subject,
		title=if entry then entry[1] else "More information is needed",
		meaning=if entry then entry[2] else "This message is not in the built-in help list. Keep the original code when reporting it.",
		fix=if entry then entry[3] else "Check Studio Output and the documentation. Include the original message and a small example when asking for help."})
end
function Help.FindTerms(query)
	local result={} local q=string.lower(if type(query)=="string" then query else "")
	for _,entry in terms do if q=="" or (string.lower(table.concat(entry," "))):find(q,1,true) then table.insert(result,entry) end end
	return result
end

local Guard=require(script.Parent.Guard)
local Contract=require(script.Parent.Contract)
local Shapes=require(script.Parent.Shapes)
local H={} H.__index=H
function H.new(options)
	return setmetatable({rows=table.create(options.capacity),head=1,count=0,capacity=options.capacity,
		epoch=1,maxAge=options.seconds,maxGap=options.maxGap,maxSpeed=options.maxSpeed,
		maxRadius=options.maxRadius,boundary=-math.huge},H)
end
function H:_at(i) return self.rows[(self.head+i-2)%self.capacity+1] end
function H:Latest() return if self.count>0 then self:_at(self.count) else nil end
function H:Break(time)
	self.epoch+=1 self.boundary=time
end
function H:Push(time,snapshot)
	if type(snapshot)~="table" or not Guard.Frame(snapshot.root) or type(snapshot.zones)~="table" then return false,"invalid_snapshot" end
	local state=Contract.State(snapshot.state or {})
	if not state then return false,"invalid_state" end
	local zones,count={},0
	for name,shape in snapshot.zones do
		count+=1
		if count>32 or type(name)~="string" or #name>64 then return false,"invalid_zones" end
		local zone=Shapes.Copy(shape,true)
		if not zone then return false,"invalid_zone" end
		if (zone.frame.Position-snapshot.root.Position).Magnitude+Shapes.Radius(zone)>self.maxRadius+1e-5 then return false,"zone_out_of_bounds" end
		zones[name]=zone
	end
	if count==0 then return false,"empty_zones" end
	local latest=self:Latest()
	if time<self.boundary or (latest and time<=latest.time) then return false,"non_monotonic" end
	if latest and latest.epoch==self.epoch and (snapshot.root.Position-latest.root.Position).Magnitude>self.maxSpeed*(time-latest.time)+1e-4 then return false,"speed_bound" end
	local row=table.freeze({time=time,root=snapshot.root,zones=table.freeze(zones),state=state,epoch=self.epoch})
	if self.count<self.capacity then self.count+=1 self.rows[(self.head+self.count-2)%self.capacity+1]=row
	else self.rows[self.head]=row self.head=self.head%self.capacity+1 end
	return true
end
function H:Sample(time,now)
	if not Guard.Number(time) or not Guard.Number(now) then return nil,"invalid_time" end
	if time>now+1e-6 then return nil,"future" end
	if now-time>self.maxAge then return nil,"expired" end
	if self.count==0 then return nil,"empty" end
	if time<self:_at(1).time then return nil,"too_old" end
	if time>self:Latest().time then return nil,"not_recorded" end
	local low,high=1,self.count
	while low<=high do local mid=(low+high)//2 if self:_at(mid).time<time then low=mid+1 else high=mid-1 end end
	local after=self:_at(low)
	if after.time==time then
		if after.epoch~=self.epoch then return nil,"epoch_changed" end
		return after
	end
	local before=self:_at(low-1)
	if before.epoch~=after.epoch or after.epoch~=self.epoch then return nil,"discontinuity" end
	if after.time-before.time>self.maxGap then return nil,"sample_gap" end
	if not Contract.SameState(before.state,after.state) then return nil,"state_boundary" end
	local alpha=(time-before.time)/(after.time-before.time)
	local zones={}
	for name,zone in before.zones do
		local nextZone=after.zones[name]
		if not nextZone or not Shapes.SameDimensions(zone,nextZone) then return nil,"geometry_boundary" end
		zones[name]=Shapes.Lerp(zone,nextZone,alpha)
	end
	for name in after.zones do if not before.zones[name] then return nil,"geometry_boundary" end end
	return table.freeze({time=time,root=before.root:Lerp(after.root,alpha),state=before.state,
		zones=table.freeze(zones),epoch=before.epoch})
end
return H

-- Geometry uses studs, seconds, world CFrames, and closed volumes (tangency counts).
local Guard = require(script.Parent.Guard)
local G = require(script.Parent.Geometry)
local S = {}
local EPS = 1e-7
local function positive(v, maximum)
	return Guard.Number(v) and v > 0 and v <= maximum
end
function S.Copy(s, targetOnly)
	if type(s) ~= "table" then return nil end
	if s.kind == "box" and Guard.Frame(s.frame) and Guard.Size(s.size, 512) then
		return table.freeze({kind="box", frame=s.frame, size=s.size})
	elseif s.kind == "sphere" and Guard.Frame(s.frame) and positive(s.radius,32) then
		return table.freeze({kind="sphere", frame=s.frame, radius=s.radius})
	elseif s.kind == "capsule" and Guard.Frame(s.frame) and positive(s.radius,32)
		and positive(s.height,512) and s.height >= s.radius*2 then
		return table.freeze({kind="capsule", frame=s.frame, radius=s.radius, height=s.height})
	elseif not targetOnly and s.kind == "sweep" and Guard.Vector(s.start) and Guard.Vector(s.finish)
		and Guard.Number(s.radius) and s.radius >= 0 and s.radius <= 32
		and (s.finish-s.start).Magnitude <= 4096 then
		return table.freeze({kind="sweep", start=s.start, finish=s.finish, radius=s.radius})
	end
	return nil
end
local function checked(s) return assert(S.Copy(s), "invalid Chrono shape") end
function S.Box(frame, size) return checked({kind="box",frame=frame,size=size}) end
function S.Sphere(frame, radius) return checked({kind="sphere",frame=frame,radius=radius}) end
function S.Capsule(frame, radius, height) return checked({kind="capsule",frame=frame,radius=radius,height=height}) end
function S.Sweep(start, finish, radius) return checked({kind="sweep",start=start,finish=finish,radius=radius}) end
function S.Ray(start, finish) return S.Sweep(start,finish,0) end
function S.At(shape, frame)
	assert(Guard.Frame(frame), "invalid reference frame")
	local out = table.clone(shape)
	if out.kind == "sweep" then
		out.start, out.finish = frame:PointToWorldSpace(out.start), frame:PointToWorldSpace(out.finish)
	else out.frame = frame*out.frame end
	return checked(out)
end
function S.Radius(s)
	if s.kind == "box" then return s.size.Magnitude*0.5 end
	if s.kind == "capsule" then return s.height*0.5 end
	return s.radius
end
function S.Reach(s)
	if s.kind == "sweep" then return math.max(s.start.Magnitude,s.finish.Magnitude)+s.radius end
	return s.frame.Position.Magnitude+S.Radius(s)
end
function S.SameDimensions(a,b)
	return a.kind==b.kind and a.size==b.size and a.radius==b.radius and a.height==b.height
end
function S.Lerp(a,b,alpha)
	local out=table.clone(a) out.frame=a.frame:Lerp(b.frame,alpha)
	return table.freeze(out)
end
local function ends(c)
	local offset=c.frame.UpVector*(c.height*0.5-c.radius)
	return c.frame.Position-offset,c.frame.Position+offset
end
-- Closest distance between two closed segments, including zero length segments.
local function segmentPair(p1,q1,p2,q2)
	local d1,d2,r=q1-p1,q2-p2,p1-p2
	local a,e,f=d1:Dot(d1),d2:Dot(d2),d2:Dot(r)
	local s,t=0,0
	if a<=1e-12 and e<=1e-12 then return r:Dot(r) end
	if a<=1e-12 then t=math.clamp(f/e,0,1)
	else
		local c=d1:Dot(r)
		if e<=1e-12 then s=math.clamp(-c/a,0,1)
		else
			local b=d1:Dot(d2) local denominator=a*e-b*b
			if denominator>1e-12 then s=math.clamp((b*f-c*e)/denominator,0,1) end
			t=(b*s+f)/e
			if t<0 then t=0 s=math.clamp(-c/a,0,1)
			elseif t>1 then t=1 s=math.clamp((b-c)/a,0,1) end
		end
	end
	local delta=r+d1*s-d2*t
	return delta:Dot(delta)
end
local function raySphere(p,q,center,radius)
	local d,m=q-p,p-center
	local a,c=d:Dot(d),m:Dot(m)-radius*radius
	if c<=EPS then return 0 end
	if a<1e-12 then return nil end
	local b=m:Dot(d) local h=b*b-a*c
	if h<0 then return nil end
	local t=(-b-math.sqrt(h))/a
	if t>=0 and t<=1 then return t end
	return nil
end
-- Point swept against a capsule. Split where projection onto its axis clamps.
-- On each piece, squared distance to the segment is a quadratic in t.
local function rayCapsule(p,q,a,b,radius)
	local axis,d,m=b-a,q-p,p-a
	local length2=axis:Dot(axis)
	if length2<1e-12 then return raySphere(p,q,a,radius) end
	local u0,du=m:Dot(axis)/length2,d:Dot(axis)/length2
	local cuts={0,1}
	if math.abs(du)>1e-12 then
		for _,u in {0,1} do local t=(u-u0)/du if t>0 and t<1 then table.insert(cuts,t) end end
	end
	table.sort(cuts)
	for i=1,#cuts-1 do
		local lower,upper=cuts[i],cuts[i+1]
		local u=u0+du*(lower+upper)*0.5
		local v,w
		if u<0 then v,w=m,d elseif u>1 then v,w=p-b,d
		else v,w=m-axis*u0,d-axis*du end
		local aa,bb,cc=w:Dot(w),2*v:Dot(w),v:Dot(v)-radius*radius
		if (aa*lower+bb)*lower+cc<=EPS then return lower end
		if aa>1e-12 then
			local discriminant=bb*bb-4*aa*cc
			if discriminant>=0 then
				local t=(-bb-math.sqrt(discriminant))/(2*aa)
				if t>=lower-EPS and t<=upper+EPS then return math.clamp(t,lower,upper) end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local function boxBox(a,b)
	local aa={a.frame.RightVector,a.frame.UpVector,a.frame.ZVector}
	local ba={b.frame.RightVector,b.frame.UpVector,b.frame.ZVector}
	local axes={aa[1],aa[2],aa[3],ba[1],ba[2],ba[3]}
	for _,u in aa do for _,v in ba do table.insert(axes,u:Cross(v)) end end
	local halfA,halfB=a.size*0.5,b.size*0.5
	local dimsA,dimsB={halfA.X,halfA.Y,halfA.Z},{halfB.X,halfB.Y,halfB.Z}
	local delta=b.frame.Position-a.frame.Position
	for _,axis in axes do
		if axis.Magnitude>1e-7 then
			axis=axis.Unit local ra,rb=0,0
			for i=1,3 do ra+=dimsA[i]*math.abs(axis:Dot(aa[i])) rb+=dimsB[i]*math.abs(axis:Dot(ba[i])) end
			if math.abs(delta:Dot(axis))>ra+rb+EPS then return false end
		end
	end
	return true
end
-- Returns the first travel fraction for a sweep, or zero for volume overlap.
-- This is exact for supplied primitives at one time; it is not continuous actor motion.
function S.Intersect(a,b)
	if a.kind=="sweep" then
		if b.kind=="box" then return G.SphereSweepOBB(a.start,a.finish,a.radius,b.frame,b.size) end
		if b.kind=="sphere" then return raySphere(a.start,a.finish,b.frame.Position,a.radius+b.radius) end
		local p,q=ends(b) return rayCapsule(a.start,a.finish,p,q,a.radius+b.radius)
	end
	local hit=false
	if a.kind=="box" and b.kind=="box" then hit=boxBox(a,b)
	elseif a.kind=="sphere" and b.kind=="sphere" then
		hit=(a.frame.Position-b.frame.Position).Magnitude<=a.radius+b.radius+EPS
	elseif a.kind=="capsule" and b.kind=="capsule" then
		local p,q=ends(a) local r,s=ends(b)
		hit=segmentPair(p,q,r,s)<=(a.radius+b.radius)^2+EPS
	elseif a.kind=="box" or b.kind=="box" then
		local box,other=if a.kind=="box" then a else b,if a.kind=="box" then b else a
		local p,q=other.frame.Position,other.frame.Position
		if other.kind=="capsule" then p,q=ends(other) end
		hit=G.SphereSweepOBB(p,q,other.radius,box.frame,box.size)~=nil
	else
		local sphere,cap=if a.kind=="sphere" then a else b,if a.kind=="sphere" then b else a
		local p,q=ends(cap)
		hit=G.SegmentDistanceSquared(p,q,sphere.frame.Position)<=(sphere.radius+cap.radius)^2+EPS
	end
	return if hit then 0 else nil
end
return table.freeze(S)

const function CheckVersion()
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			const url = "https://api.github.com/repos/VertimaXx/ChronoFork-V3.1/releases/latest"
			const success, result = pcall(function()
				return HTTPS:GetAsync(url)
			end)
			if not success then
				return
			end
			const data = HTTPS:JSONDecode(result) :: { tag_name: string? }
			const latestVersion = data.tag_name
			const currentVersion = Config._GetConfig("__VERSION")
			if latestVersion and latestVersion ~= currentVersion then
				warn(
					("Chrono: A new version is available! You are using version %s, but the latest version is %s."):format(
						currentVersion,
						latestVersion
					)
				)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local startupState="idle"
return {
	Start = function(config: ModuleScript?)
		if STARTED then
			warn("Chrono: Already Started. Ignoring subsequent calls.")
			return
		end
		assert(startupState=="idle","ChronoFork startup is "..startupState..". Stop Play before retrying a failed startup.")
		startupState="starting"
		local ok,reason=xpcall(function()
		if config then

		if IS_SERVER then
			require(script.Server.Replicate)
		else
			require(script.Client.Replicate)

		STARTED = true

export type AlignDriver = {
	part: BasePart,
	container: Camera,
	driverPart: BasePart,
	alignPosition: AlignPosition,
	alignOrientation: AlignOrientation,
	velocity: Vector3?,
	lastPosition: Vector3?,
	lastTime: number?,
}

const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)

const CONTAINER_NAME = "__CHRONO_ALIGN"
const DRIVER_PART_NAME = "__CHRONO_ALIGN_PART"

const ROOT_PRIORITY = 127

const MAX_RESPONSIVENESS = 200

const MAX_SPEED = 1000

local velocityUpdates: { AlignDriver } = {}
const AlignDriver = {}

const function Create(part: BasePart): AlignDriver
	const previous = part:FindFirstChild(CONTAINER_NAME)
	if previous then
		previous:Destroy()
	end

	const initCF = part.CFrame

	const container = Instance.new("Camera")
	container.Archivable = false
	container.Name = CONTAINER_NAME
	container.Parent = part

	const driverPart = Instance.new("Part")
	driverPart.Name = DRIVER_PART_NAME

	driverPart.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.0001, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	driverPart.Massless = false
	driverPart.RootPriority = ROOT_PRIORITY
	driverPart.Size = Vector3.zero
	driverPart.CanCollide = false
	driverPart.CanQuery = false
	driverPart.CanTouch = false
	driverPart.Transparency = 1
	driverPart.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

	driverPart.CFrame = initCF
	driverPart.Parent = container

	const weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "__CHRONO_ALIGN_WELD"
	weld.Part0 = driverPart
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.Parent = container

	const attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "__CHRONO_ALIGN_ATTACHMENT"
	attachment.Parent = driverPart

	const alignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
	alignPosition.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	alignPosition.Attachment0 = attachment

	alignPosition.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = false
	alignPosition.ReactionForceEnabled = false

	alignPosition.ForceRelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	alignPosition.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.Magnitude

	alignPosition.MaxForce = math.huge
	alignPosition.MaxVelocity = math.huge
	alignPosition.Responsiveness = MAX_RESPONSIVENESS

	alignPosition.RigidityEnabled = true
	alignPosition.Position = initCF.Position
	alignPosition.Parent = driverPart

	const alignOrientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	alignOrientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	alignOrientation.Attachment0 = attachment

	alignOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
	alignOrientation.PrimaryAxisOnly = false
	alignOrientation.ReactionTorqueEnabled = false
	alignOrientation.MaxTorque = math.huge
	alignOrientation.MaxAngularVelocity = math.huge
	alignOrientation.Responsiveness = MAX_RESPONSIVENESS
	alignOrientation.RigidityEnabled = true
	alignOrientation.CFrame = initCF.Rotation
	alignOrientation.Parent = driverPart

	part.CFrame = initCF

	return {
		part = part,
		container = container,
		driverPart = driverPart,
		alignPosition = alignPosition,
		alignOrientation = alignOrientation,
	}
end

const function Update(driver: AlignDriver, cframe: CFrame)
	driver.alignPosition.Position = cframe.Position
	driver.alignOrientation.CFrame = cframe.Rotation
end

const function Destroy(driver: AlignDriver)
	if driver.container then
		driver.container:Destroy()
	end

	driver.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Mimics roblox's replication for velocity
const function UpdateVelocity(driver: AlignDriver, position: Vector3, renderTime: number)
	const lastTime = driver.lastTime
	const lastPosition = driver.lastPosition
	if lastTime and lastPosition and renderTime > lastTime and renderTime - lastTime < 0.5 then
		const velocity = (position - lastPosition) / (renderTime - lastTime)
		if vector.magnitude(velocity :: any) < MAX_SPEED then
			driver.velocity = velocity
			table.insert(velocityUpdates, driver)
		end
	end
	driver.lastPosition = position
	driver.lastTime = renderTime
end

const function Step(entity: Types.Entity, part: BasePart, cframe: CFrame, renderTime: number)
	local existing = entity._alignDriver
	if existing and existing.part ~= part then
		Destroy(existing)
		existing = nil
	end
	if not existing then
		part.CFrame = cframe
	end
	const driver = existing or Create(part)
	entity._alignDriver = driver
	Update(driver, cframe)
	UpdateVelocity(driver, cframe.Position, renderTime)
end

const function Clear(entity: Types.Entity)
	const driver = entity._alignDriver
	if driver then
		Destroy(driver)
		entity._alignDriver = nil
	end
end

const function ApplyVelocities()
	for _, driver in velocityUpdates do
		if driver.velocity and driver.container.Parent then
			driver.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = driver.velocity
		end
	end
	velocityUpdates = {}
end

AlignDriver.Create = Create
AlignDriver.Update = Update
AlignDriver.Destroy = Destroy
AlignDriver.Step = Step
AlignDriver.Clear = Clear
AlignDriver.ApplyVelocities = ApplyVelocities

return AlignDriver

const Warn = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Warn)
const Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Config)
const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)
const BufferTracker = require(script.Parent.InterpolationBuffer)

const ClientClocks: { [Types.ClientClock]: boolean } = {}
const _ServerOwnedClocks: { [Types.ClientClock]: boolean } = {}

const function GetBuffer(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): number
	if clientClock.buffer then
		return BufferTracker.GetBuffer(clientClock.buffer, clientClock.tickRate)
	else
		return clientClock.bufferConst or 0
	end
end

const function Clear(clientClock: Types.ClientClock)
	clientClock.lastClockAt = nil
	clientClock.lastClockDuration = 0
	clientClock.renderAt = nil

	if clientClock.buffer then
		BufferTracker.Reset(clientClock.buffer)
	end
end

const function GetEstimatedServerTime(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): number
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		Warn.low("ClientClock: Estimated server time not yet established for", clientClock.name)
		return 0
	end

	return clientClock.lastClockAt + (os.clock() - clientClock.lastClockDuration)
end

const function GetTargetRenderTime(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): number
	if not clientClock.renderAt then
		if clientClock.lastClockAt then
			return GetEstimatedServerTime(clientClock) - GetBuffer(clientClock)
		end
		Warn.low("ClientClock: Render time not yet established for", clientClock.name)
		return 0
	end

	return clientClock.renderAt
end

const function CheckHasLastClockAt(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, sendTime: number)
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		clientClock.lastClockAt = sendTime
		clientClock.lastClockDuration = os.clock()
		clientClock.renderAt = nil
	end
end

const function Refresh(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, currentSendTime: number): boolean
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		CheckHasLastClockAt(clientClock, currentSendTime)
		return false
	end

	if currentSendTime > clientClock.lastClockAt then
		clientClock.lastClockAt = currentSendTime
		clientClock.lastClockDuration = os.clock()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function OnSnapShot(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, currentSendTime: number)
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		CheckHasLastClockAt(clientClock, currentSendTime)
		return
	end

	if clientClock.buffer then
		BufferTracker.Register(clientClock.buffer, currentSendTime)
	end

	if Refresh(clientClock, currentSendTime) and not clientClock.renderAt then
		clientClock.renderAt = currentSendTime - GetBuffer(clientClock)
	end
end

const function OnStop(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, stopTime: number)
	if clientClock.buffer then
		BufferTracker.MarkIdle(clientClock.buffer, stopTime)
	end
end

const function SetTickRate(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, tickRate: number)
	if clientClock.tickRate == tickRate then
		return
	end
	clientClock.tickRate = tickRate
end

const function Destroy(clientClock: Types.ClientClock)
	ClientClocks[clientClock] = nil
	if _ServerOwnedClocks[clientClock] then
		_ServerOwnedClocks[clientClock] = nil
	end
end

const function Update(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, dt: number)
	const now = os.clock()
	const delay = GetBuffer(clientClock)
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		return
	end
	const estimatedServerTime = clientClock.lastClockAt + (now - clientClock.lastClockDuration)
	local renderAt = (clientClock.renderAt or (estimatedServerTime - delay)) + dt

	const renderTimeError = delay - (estimatedServerTime - renderAt)

	if math.abs(renderTimeError) > 0.1 then
		renderAt = estimatedServerTime - delay
	elseif renderTimeError > 0.01 then
		renderAt = math.max(estimatedServerTime - delay, renderAt - 0.1 * dt)
	elseif renderTimeError < -0.01 then
		renderAt = math.min(estimatedServerTime - delay, renderAt + 0.1 * dt)
	end

	clientClock.renderAt = renderAt
end

const function UpdateBuffer(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, buffer: number?)
	buffer = if buffer and buffer <= 0 then nil else buffer
	const currentBuffer = clientClock.bufferConst
	if currentBuffer == buffer then
		return
	end
	if not buffer then
		if not clientClock.buffer then
			clientClock.buffer = BufferTracker.new(clientClock)
		end
	else
		clientClock.buffer = nil
	end
	clientClock.bufferConst = buffer
	clientClock.renderAt = nil
end

const function new(tickRate: number, name: string, bufferNumber: number?, networkOwner: Player?): Types.ClientClock
	bufferNumber = if bufferNumber and bufferNumber <= 0 then nil else bufferNumber
	const self: Types.ClientClock = {
		name = name,
		lastClockAt = nil,
		lastClockDuration = 0,
		renderAt = nil,
		tickRate = tickRate,
		_baseTickRate = tickRate,
		_owner = networkOwner,
		buffer = nil,
		bufferConst = bufferNumber,

		OnSnapShot = OnSnapShot,
		OnStop = OnStop,
		Refresh = Refresh,
		GetEstimatedServerTime = GetEstimatedServerTime,
		GetTargetRenderTime = GetTargetRenderTime,
		Clear = Clear,
		SetTickRate = SetTickRate,
		UpdateBuffer = UpdateBuffer,
		Destroy = Destroy,
	}
	if not bufferNumber then
		self.buffer = BufferTracker.new(self)
	end

	if not networkOwner then
		_ServerOwnedClocks[self] = true
	end

	ClientClocks[self] = true
	return self
end

const function UpdateAll(dt: number)
	for clientClock, _ in ClientClocks do
		Update(clientClock, dt)
	end
end

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	for name, config in Config._EntityConfigs do
		const clientClocks = config.CLIENT_CLOCK
		if not clientClocks then
			Warn.high("Entity Config", name, "is missing client clocks")
			return
		end
		clientClocks.NORMAL = new(config.TICK_RATE, name .. "_NORMAL", config.BUFFER)
		if (config.HALF_TICK_DISTANCE or math.huge) < math.huge then
			clientClocks.HALF = new(config.TICK_RATE * 2, name .. "_HALF", config.BUFFER)
		end
	end
end)

return {
	_getBuffer = GetBuffer,
	new = new,
	clientClocks = ClientClocks,
	serverOwnedClocks = _ServerOwnedClocks,
	UpdateAll = UpdateAll,
}

const idMap = Holder.idMap

const function UpdateEntityStats()
	if not StatsALL.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE or Stats._PAUSE then
		return
	end
	const entities = {}
	for _, entity in idMap do
		const id = entity.id
		const config = entity.entityConfig
		const configName = config and config.NAME or "DEFAULT"
		const networkOwner = entity.networkOwner
		const isCharacter = entity._player ~= nil

		const lastRecvTime = entity.latestTime or 0
		const lastReplicatedTime = entity.lastReplicatedTime or 0

		local renderCache = entity._clientClock

		if not renderCache then
			const RenderCaches = entity.entityConfig.CLIENT_CLOCK
			if RenderCaches then
				renderCache = entity.isHalfTicked and RenderCaches.HALF or RenderCaches.NORMAL
			end
		end

		local targetRender = 0
		local averageLatency = 0
		local deviation = 0
		local bufferedTime = 0

		if renderCache then
			targetRender = renderCache:GetTargetRenderTime()
			const interpolationBuff = renderCache.buffer
			if interpolationBuff then
				averageLatency = interpolationBuff.averageLatency
				deviation = interpolationBuff.deviation
			end
			bufferedTime = ClientClock._getBuffer(renderCache)
		end
		const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
		const snapshot = entity.snapshot
		const currentPosition = primaryPart and primaryPart.Position
		const snapshots: { SnapshotData } = {}
		if snapshot then
			for _, snap in snapshot.cache do
				table.insert(snapshots, { t = snap.t, value = snap.value, velocity = snap.velocity })
			end
			table.sort(snapshots, function(a: SnapshotData, b: SnapshotData)
				return a.t > b.t
			end)
		end
		const data = {
			id = id,
			entity = entity,
			networkOwner = networkOwner,
			isCharacter = isCharacter,
			config = configName,
			lastReceivedTime = lastRecvTime,
			lastReplicatedTime = lastReplicatedTime,
			targetTime = targetRender,
			averageLatency = averageLatency,
			deviation = deviation,
			bufferedTime = bufferedTime,
			currentPosition = currentPosition,
			snapshots = snapshots,
		}
		table.insert(entities, data)
	end
	Stats.CLIENT_ENTITIES = entities :: any
end

return UpdateEntityStats

const Shared = script.Parent.Parent.Shared

const Types = require(Shared.Types)
const Stats = require(Shared.Stats).CLIENT

const TICKS = 4

local FrustumLookVector = vector.create(0, 0, -1)
local FrustumRightVector = vector.create(1, 0, 0)
local FrustumUpVector = vector.create(0, 1, 0)
local FrustumPosition = vector.create(0, 0, 0)
local TanHorizontal = 0
local TanVertical = 0

local CurrentTick = 0
local OutOfBroadPhaseTick = 0
local TotalCulled = 0

const Frustum = {}

const function Prepare()
	const cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	const cframe: CFrame = cam.CFrame
	FrustumLookVector = cframe.LookVector :: any
	FrustumRightVector = cframe.RightVector :: any
	FrustumUpVector = cframe.UpVector :: any

	FrustumPosition = cframe.Position :: any

	const halfFov = math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2)
	const aspectRatio = math.max(1,cam.ViewportSize.X) / math.max(1,cam.ViewportSize.Y)
	TanHorizontal = math.tan(halfFov) * aspectRatio
	TanVertical = math.tan(halfFov)
end

const function CheckPoint(pos: vector)
	const diff = pos - FrustumPosition

	const magnitude = vector.magnitude(diff)

	if magnitude == 0 then
		return true
	end

	const forwardDis = vector.dot(diff, FrustumLookVector)

	const forwardDot = forwardDis / magnitude
	if forwardDot < 0 then
		return false
	end
	if forwardDis < 1 then
		return true
	end
	const unit = diff / magnitude
	const rightDot = vector.dot(unit, FrustumRightVector)

	if math.abs(rightDot) > forwardDot * TanHorizontal then
		return false
	end

	const upDot = vector.dot(unit, FrustumUpVector)
	if math.abs(upDot) > forwardDot * TanVertical then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

const function CheckBroadPhase(center: vector, size: vector, rotation: CFrame?)
	-- Conservative plane/support-radius test. An intersecting box need not have
	-- any corner inside the camera, particularly when the camera is inside it.
	const delta = center - FrustumPosition
	const half = size * 0.5
	const axes = if rotation then {rotation.RightVector, rotation.UpVector, rotation.ZVector}
		else {Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis}
	const dimensions = {half.x, half.y, half.z}
	const planes = {
		FrustumLookVector,
		FrustumRightVector + FrustumLookVector * TanHorizontal,
		-FrustumRightVector + FrustumLookVector * TanHorizontal,
		FrustumUpVector + FrustumLookVector * TanVertical,
		-FrustumUpVector + FrustumLookVector * TanVertical,
	}
	for _, plane in planes do
		local radius = 0
		for index, axis in axes do radius += dimensions[index] * math.abs(vector.dot(axis :: any, plane)) end
		if vector.dot(delta, plane) + radius < -1e-5 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

-- Runs every 4 frames at 60hz so this runs at ~15hz
const function Update()
	CurrentTick += 1
	if CurrentTick % TICKS == 0 then
		Stats.TOTAL_ENTITIES_CULLED = TotalCulled
		TotalCulled = 0
		CurrentTick = 0
	end
end

const function IsThrottled(entity: Types.Entity): boolean
	const slot = entity._outofBroadPhaseTick
	return slot ~= nil and slot ~= CurrentTick
end

const function IsCulled(entity: Types.Entity, targetCFrame: CFrame): boolean
	const broadPhase = entity.broadPhase :: vector
	const toCheck = targetCFrame :: any
	const lastCheckedCFrame = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
	debug.profilebegin("Prepare Frustum")
	const passed = CheckBroadPhase(toCheck.Position, broadPhase, targetCFrame)
	debug.profileend()
	if not passed then
		if lastCheckedCFrame and lastCheckedCFrame.Position ~= toCheck.Position then
			debug.profilebegin("Check Last CFrame")
			const passLast = CheckBroadPhase(lastCheckedCFrame.Position :: any, broadPhase,lastCheckedCFrame)
			debug.profileend()
			if not passLast then
				TotalCulled += 1
				return true
			end
		else
			if not lastCheckedCFrame then
				entity.lastCheckedCFrame = toCheck
			end
			if not entity._outofBroadPhaseTick then
				entity._outofBroadPhaseTick = OutOfBroadPhaseTick
				OutOfBroadPhaseTick += 1
				if OutOfBroadPhaseTick % TICKS == 0 then
					OutOfBroadPhaseTick = 0
				end
			end
			TotalCulled += 1
			return true
		end
	end
	entity.lastCheckedCFrame = nil
	entity._outofBroadPhaseTick = nil
	return false
end

Frustum.Prepare = Prepare

const Warn = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Warn)
const Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Config)
const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)

local MIN_BUFFER: number
local MAX_BUFFER: number

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	MIN_BUFFER = Config._GetConfig("MIN_BUFFER")
	MAX_BUFFER = Config._GetConfig("MAX_BUFFER")
end)
const Buffer = {}

function Buffer.new(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): Types.InterpolationBuffer
	return {
		init = false,
		averageLatency = 0,
		deviation = 0,
		lastLatency = 0,
		lastSendTime = nil,
		maxSendGap = 0,
		idle = false,
		arrival = nil,
		intervals = {},
		intervalHead = 1,
		interval95 = 0,

		clientClock = clientClock,
	}
end

function Buffer.Register(data: Types.InterpolationBuffer, time: number)
	const clientClock = data.clientClock
	local arrival = os.clock()
	local elapsed = if data.arrival then math.max(0, arrival-data.arrival) else clientClock.tickRate
	local wasIdle = data.idle
	if data.lastSendTime and time <= data.lastSendTime then return end
	if data.arrival and not wasIdle then
		data.intervals[data.intervalHead] = elapsed
		data.intervalHead = data.intervalHead % 64 + 1
		local sorted=table.clone(data.intervals) table.sort(sorted)
		data.interval95=sorted[math.max(1,math.ceil(#sorted*0.95))]
	end
	data.arrival = arrival
	local alpha = 1-math.exp(-elapsed/0.5)
	const clientNow = clientClock:GetEstimatedServerTime()
	const latency = clientNow - time

	if math.abs(latency) > 1 then
		clientClock:Clear()
		Warn.low(data.clientClock.name, ` latency too high, cleared cache to repredict in case of error:! {latency}`)
	end

	const lastSendTime = data.lastSendTime
	if lastSendTime and time > lastSendTime and not data.idle then
		const gap = time - lastSendTime
		if gap <= clientClock.tickRate * 3 then
			data.maxSendGap = if gap > data.maxSendGap
				then gap
				else gap + (data.maxSendGap-gap)*math.exp(-elapsed/3)
		end
	end
	if not lastSendTime or time > lastSendTime then
		data.lastSendTime = time
		data.idle = false
	end

	if not data.init then
		--using the difference between current and last latency, i could smooth out the deviation (the variation in latency, which correlates to packet loss)
		--this is using statistics https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moving_average
		data.averageLatency = latency
		data.deviation = 0
		data.lastLatency = latency
		data.init = true
		return
	end

	if data.lastLatency then
		const delta = math.abs(latency - data.lastLatency)
		--deviation is essentially jitter, and we calculate that using RFC 3550 jitter estimation
		--see: https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/tech/tech3337.pdf
		data.deviation = data.deviation + (delta - data.deviation) * alpha
	end

	data.averageLatency = data.averageLatency + (latency - data.averageLatency) * alpha
	data.lastLatency = latency
end

function Buffer.MarkIdle(data: Types.InterpolationBuffer, time: number)
	const lastSendTime = data.lastSendTime
	if lastSendTime and time < lastSendTime then
		return
	end
	data.lastSendTime = time
	data.idle = true
end

function Buffer.GetBuffer(data: Types.InterpolationBuffer, tickRate: number)
	if not data then
		return MIN_BUFFER
	end

	const deviationMargin = data.deviation * 2
	local interval = data.interval95 or tickRate
	const rawBuffer = math.max(tickRate, data.maxSendGap, interval) + deviationMargin

	local buffer = if rawBuffer < MIN_BUFFER then MIN_BUFFER + (MIN_BUFFER - rawBuffer) * 0.2 else rawBuffer
	if buffer > MAX_BUFFER then
		Warn.low(`Interpolation buffer exceeded max! Was {buffer}, clamped to {MAX_BUFFER} for`, data.clientClock.name)
		buffer = MAX_BUFFER
	end

	return buffer
end

function Buffer.Reset(data)
	data.init=false data.averageLatency=0 data.deviation=0 data.lastLatency=0
	data.lastSendTime=nil data.maxSendGap=0 data.idle=false data.arrival=nil
	data.intervals={} data.intervalHead=1 data.interval95=0
end
return Buffer

const binClears: { [Types.Entity]: () -> () } = {}

const function IsAutomatic(): boolean
	return Config._GetConfig("PLAYER_REPLICATION") == "AUTOMATIC"
end

const function SetLocalCharacter(model: Model | BasePart?)
	if not model then
		return
	end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		Warn.high(`Model for {LocalPlayer} is not a Model instance.`)
		return
	end
	LocalPlayer.Character = model
	const cf = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or model.PrimaryPart
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = cf
	-- This was to a fix to resolve custom mode
	for _, v in model:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
		if v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Disabled == false then
			v.Disabled = true
			v.Disabled = false
		end
	end
end

const function OnCharacterRegistered(player: Player, entity: Types.Entity)
	if not IsAutomatic() or Entity.GetModelReplicationType(entity) ~= "CUSTOM" then
		return
	end
	const model = entity.model
	if not model then
		return Warn.high(`No model found for {player}`)
	end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		return Warn.high(`Model for {player} is not a Model instance.`)
	end
	player.Character = model

	if player == LocalPlayer then
		Entity.GetEvent(entity, "ModelChanged"):Connect(function(_, newModel)
			SetLocalCharacter(newModel)
		end)
		SetLocalCharacter(model)
	end
end

const function StopWatch(entity: Types.Entity)
	const clear = binClears[entity]
	if clear then
		binClears[entity] = nil
		clear()
	end
end

const function WatchDeath(player: Player, entity: Types.Entity)
	if player ~= LocalPlayer or binClears[entity] then
		return
	end
	const add, clear = Bin()
	const addDied, clearDied = Bin()

	const function CheckHumanoid(_, model: Model | BasePart?)
		clearDied()
		if not model or not entity.isContextOwner or not model:IsA("Model") then
			return
		end
		const humanoid = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			addDied(humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				if entity.isContextOwner then
					DeathRemote:FireServer(entity.id)
				end
			end))
		end
	end

	add(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "ModelChanged"):Connect(CheckHumanoid))
	add(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "Destroying"):Connect(function()
		StopWatch(entity)
	end))
	add(clearDied)
	binClears[entity] = clear
	CheckHumanoid(entity, entity.model)
end

const function Die(id: number)
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
	if not entity or entity.isContextOwner then
		return
	end
	const model = entity.model
	if not model then
		return
	end
	task.wait()
	const humanoid = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
		humanoid.Health = 0
		humanoid.Health = 10
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end

Events.PlayerCharacterRegistered:Connect(OnCharacterRegistered)

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	if not IsAutomatic() then
		return
	end
	Events.PlayerOwnedAdded:Connect(WatchDeath)
	Events.PlayerOwnedRemoved:Connect(function(_, entity)
		StopWatch(entity)
	end)
end)

DeathRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(Die)

return nil

const function HandleRemoved(id: number, generation: number?, preserveModel: boolean?, anchored: boolean?)
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
	if entity then
		if generation and entity.generation~=generation then return end
		Entity.Destroy(entity,preserveModel,anchored)
		return
	end
	Warn.high("Tried to remove non existent entity with id", id)

const function SetMountId(entity: Types.Entity, mountParentId: number?)

	entity.mountOffset = mountOffset or CFrame.identity

-- This maps SetValue keys to their functions
const ChangedLookUp = {
	networkOwner = Entity._SetEntityNetworkOwner,
	ownershipRevision = function(entity, revision)
		entity.ownershipRevision = revision entity._receivedSequence = nil entity._sendSequence = 0
	end,
	isHalfTicked = SetTickMode,
	_data = Entity.SetData,
	entityConfig = Entity.SetConfig,
	autoUpdatePosition = Entity.SetAutoUpdatePos,
	mountParentId = SetMountId,
	mountOffset = SetMountOffset,
	broadPhase = Entity.SetBroadPhase,
	_interpolationMode = Entity.SetInterpolationMode,
	_humanoidDisabledStates = Entity._SetHumanoidDisabledStates,
	_humanoidState = Entity._SetHumanoidState,
}

const function HandleChanges(changes: { id: number, data: { { any } } })
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(changes.id)
	if not entity then
		return
	end
	local modelData
	local modelChanged = false
	for _, pair in changes.data do
		const key = pair[1]
		const value = pair[2]

		const handler = ChangedLookUp[key]
		if handler then
			handler(entity, value)
		elseif key == "latestCFrame" then
			Entity.SetCFrame(entity, value)
		elseif key == "model" then
			modelData = value
			modelChanged = true -- value is nil when the model was cleared
		elseif key == "_player" then
			if value then
				Holder.SetAsCharacter(value, entity)
			else
				Holder.RemovePlayerCharacter(entity)
			end
		elseif key == "paused" then
			if value then
				Entity.PauseReplication(entity)
			else
				Entity.ResumeReplication(entity)
			end
		elseif key == "_lockedCFReplication" then
			entity._lockedCFReplication = value
			if not value then
				const part = Entity._GetPart(entity)
				if part then
					Entity._UnlockPartPhysicsReplication(part)
				end
			else
				Entity.SyncOwnerShip(entity)
			end
		else
			Warn.high("Unhandled entity change key:", key)
		end
	end

	if modelChanged then
		const model, modelType, handle = ModelHelper.CreateModelFromData(modelData)
		Entity.SetModel(entity, model, modelType :: any)
		entity._modelHandle = handle
	end
end

const function HandleNewEntity(data: Types.EntityReceivePacket)
	const model, modelType, handle = ModelHelper.CreateModelFromData(data.model)
	local cframe = data.cframe
	const localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	-- initializes cframe for local character just in case client loads in a different spot
	if data.networkOwner == localPlayer and model and model == localPlayer.Character then
		const root = (model :: Model).PrimaryPart
		if root then
			cframe = root.CFrame
		end
	end
	const entity = Entity._new(data.config, model, modelType :: any, cframe)

	entity.id = data.id
	entity.generation = data.generation
	entity.ownershipRevision = data.ownershipRevision or 0
	entity._sendSequence = 0
	entity._receivedSequence = data.sequence
	entity._player = data._player
	entity._modelHandle = handle
	entity.paused = data.paused or false
	entity.autoUpdatePosition = data.autoUpdatePosition or false
	entity.isHalfTicked = data.isHalfTicked
	entity._data = data._data
	entity.mountParentId = data.mountParentId
	entity.mountOffset = data.mountOffset or CFrame.identity
	entity.broadPhase = data.broadPhase or entity.broadPhase
	entity._lockedCFReplication = data._lockedCFReplication or false
	entity._interpolationMode = data._interpolationMode

	Entity._Push(entity, data.time, cframe)

	Entity._SetEntityNetworkOwner(entity, data.networkOwner)
	entity._receivedSequence=data.sequence -- ownership setup may reset the stream

	Entity._SetHumanoidDisabledStates(entity, data._humanoidDisabledStates)
	Entity._SetHumanoidState(entity, data._humanoidState)
	SetTickMode(entity, data.isHalfTicked)
	Holder.RegisterEntity(entity)
end

const function PushCFrameFor(
	id: number,
	clientOwned: boolean,
	cframe: CFrame,
	time: number,
	isHalfTick: boolean,
	teleport: boolean?,
	isStop: boolean?,
	generation: number, ownershipRevision: number, sequence: number
): boolean
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
	if not entity then
		Warn.high("Received update for non existent entity with id", id)
		return false
	end
	
	if entity.isContextOwner or clientOwned ~= (entity.networkOwner ~= nil)
		or not StateGate.Check(entity,{generation=generation,ownershipRevision=ownershipRevision,sequence=sequence}) then
		return false
	end

	const withinTeleportThreshold = entity._teleport and os.clock() - entity._teleport < 0.5
	if withinTeleportThreshold then
		if teleport then
			entity._teleport = nil
		else
			return false
		end
	end
	if teleport then
		entity._ownerChangedAt = nil
		entity._ownerSmoothing = nil
	end

	if clientOwned then
		const renderCache = entity._clientClock
		if renderCache then
			if isHalfTick then
				renderCache:SetTickRate(renderCache._baseTickRate * 2)
			else
				renderCache:SetTickRate(renderCache._baseTickRate)
			end
			if isStop then
				renderCache:OnStop(time)
			else
				renderCache:OnSnapShot(time)
			end
		end
	else
		const renderCaches = entity.entityConfig.CLIENT_CLOCK
		if renderCaches then
			const renderCache = isHalfTick and renderCaches.HALF or renderCaches.NORMAL
			if renderCache and isStop then
				renderCache:OnStop(time)
			elseif renderCache then
				renderCache:OnSnapShot(time)
			end
		end
	end

	if entity.isHalfTicked ~= isHalfTick then
		SetTickMode(entity, isHalfTick)
	end
	entity.isHalfTicked = isHalfTick

	entity._receivedSequence = sequence
	if isStop then
		Entity._PushStopped(entity, time, cframe)
	else
		Entity._Push(entity, time, cframe)
	end
	ExperimentalPrediction.Observe(entity,time,cframe,if isStop then Vector3.zero else nil,
		if clientOwned then "owner-clock" else "server-clock",teleport)
	return true
end

const function HandlePacket(b, clientOwned, forceStop)
	local rows, reason = Protocol.Decode(b)
	if not rows then Stats.REJECTED_PACKETS = (Stats.REJECTED_PACKETS or 0)+1 Stats.LAST_PACKET_REJECTION = reason return end
	BytesReceived += buffer.len(b)
	for _, row in rows do
		PushCFrameFor(row.id, clientOwned, row.frame, row.time, row.half, row.teleport,
			forceStop or row.stop, row.generation, row.ownershipRevision, row.sequence)
	end
end
const function HandleClientOwned(b) HandlePacket(b, true, false) end
const function HandleServerOwned(b, isStop) HandlePacket(b, false, isStop) end

const function HandleUnreliable(id: string, data: buffer)
	if id == "X" then -- Server Owned
		HandleServerOwned(data)
	elseif id == "O" then -- Client Owned
		HandleClientOwned(data)
	else
		Warn.high("Unknown unreliable replicate id", id)
	end
end

const function HandleReliable(newEntities: { any }, removedEntities: { number }, entityChanges: { any })
	if removedEntities then
		for _, data in removedEntities do
			if type(data)=="table" then HandleRemoved(data.id,data.generation,data.preserveModel,data.anchored)
			else HandleRemoved(data) end
		end
		RemovedPerSec += #removedEntities
	end

	if newEntities then
		for _, data: any in newEntities do
			HandleNewEntity(data)
		end
		NewPerSec += #newEntities
	end

	if entityChanges then
		for _, changeData in entityChanges do
			HandleChanges(changeData)
		end
		ChangesPerSec += #entityChanges
	end
end

UnreliableEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(HandleUnreliable)
ReliableEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(HandleReliable)
Shared.Remotes.SafeReplicate.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id: string, data: buffer)
	if id == "X" then
		HandleServerOwned(data, true)
	elseif id == "O" then
		HandleClientOwned(data)
	else
		Warn.high("Unknown replicate id", id)
	end
end)

	const unwrapped = ClockUnwrap.seatFull(ServerWrap, time)

ClientClockRelayRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(list: { { player: Player, raw: number, offset: number } })
	if type(list) ~= "table" then

	end
	for _, entry in list do

		const raw = entry.raw
		const offset = entry.offset
		if player and player.Parent and type(raw) == "number" and type(offset) == "number" then
			local state = ClientOwnedWrap[player]
			if not state then
				state = ClockUnwrap.new()
				ClientOwnedWrap[player] = state
			end
			state.lastRaw = raw
			state.offset = math.max(state.offset, offset)
		end
	end
end)

	ClientOwnedWrap[player] = nil

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

		BytesReceived = 0

end)

const CLIENT_CLOCK_SYNC_RATE = 15 -- should be fine having lower then server
const MAX_OWNER_SMOOTH_DELAY = 2 -- seconds after an ownership change 
require(script.Parent.Player)
require(script.Parent.Receiver)

const idMap = Holder.idMap

local TotalInterpolationTime = 0
local AmtInterpolations = 0

local CheckedThisFrame = 0
local MovedThisFrame = 0

local LastClockUpdate = os.clock()

const function GetMode(entity: Types.Entity): Types.INTERPOLATION_MODE?
	const config = entity.entityConfig
	const mode: Types.INTERPOLATION_MODE? = entity._interpolationMode or config.INTERPOLATION_MODE

	if not mode or not entity.interpolation or config.CUSTOM_INTERPOLATION or mode == "NONE" then
		return nil
	end
	return mode
end

const function CanInterpolate(entity: Types.Entity, primaryPart: BasePart): boolean
	if entity.isContextOwner then
		return false
	end

	if entity.entityConfig.ASSEMBLY_ROOT_PART_CHECK and not entity._alignDriver then
		if primaryPart.AssemblyRootPart ~= primaryPart then
			Warn.low(
				"Primary part for entity "
					.. entity.id
					.. " is not the assembly root part. Skipping interpolation for this entity."
			)
			return false
		end
	end

	if Frustum.IsThrottled(entity) then
		return false
	end

	if not entity.snapshot then
		Warn.medium("No snapshot for entity", entity)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

const function SmoothOwnerChange(entity: Types.Entity, primaryPart: BasePart, targetCFrame: CFrame): CFrame
	const changedAt = entity._ownerChangedAt
	if changedAt then
		entity._ownerChangedAt = nil
		if os.clock() - changedAt < MAX_OWNER_SMOOTH_DELAY then
			const drawn = primaryPart.CFrame
			entity._ownerSmoothing = {
				offset = drawn.Position - targetCFrame.Position,
				rotation = drawn.Rotation * targetCFrame.Rotation:Inverse(),
				start = os.clock(),
			}
		end
	end
	return Entity._ApplyOwnerSmoothing(entity, targetCFrame)
end

const function Interpolate(entity: Types.Entity, mode: Types.INTERPOLATION_MODE)
	const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
	if not primaryPart or not CanInterpolate(entity, primaryPart) then
		return
	end
	const snapshot = entity.snapshot :: Types.Snapshot<CFrame, Vector3>
	CheckedThisFrame += 1
	debug.profilebegin("Get Render CFrame")
	local targetTime = Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(entity)
	if mode == "ALIGN" then
		targetTime += os.clock() - LastClockUpdate
	end
	local targetCFrame, renderInfo
	local experimental=Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION") and Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DRAW")
	if experimental then
		targetTime+=Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_LEAD")
		targetCFrame,renderInfo=ExperimentalPrediction.Estimate(entity,targetTime)
	end
	if not targetCFrame then
		local refusal=if renderInfo then renderInfo.status else nil
		targetCFrame,renderInfo=VisualSampling.Sample(snapshot, targetTime, Config._GetConfig("VISUAL_CURVE"),
			if experimental then 0 else Config._GetConfig("VISUAL_PREDICTION_SECONDS"), Config._GetConfig("VISUAL_PREDICTION_DISTANCE"), Config._GetConfig("VISUAL_PREDICTION_SPEED"))
		if experimental then renderInfo.experimental=true renderInfo.predictionRefusal=refusal end
	end
	entity.renderInfo = renderInfo
	debug.profileend()
	if not targetCFrame then
		return
	end
	targetCFrame = SmoothOwnerChange(entity, primaryPart, targetCFrame)
	if entity.broadPhase and Frustum.IsCulled(entity, targetCFrame) then
		return
	end
	debug.profilebegin("Set CFrame")
	if targetCFrame == targetCFrame then
		if mode == "ALIGN" then
			AlignDriver.Step(entity, primaryPart, targetCFrame, targetTime)
		else
			AlignDriver.Clear(entity)
			-- Using cframe here instead of bulkmoveto as there were some issues relating to moving the character via bmt.
			-- SEE in ROSS https://discord.com/channels/385151591524597761/1406041519747764374/1408085390618919104
			primaryPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
		end
	end
	MovedThisFrame += 1
	debug.profileend()
end

const Shared = script.Parent.Parent.Shared
const Holder = require(Shared.Holder)
const Types = require(Shared.Types)
const Entity = require(Shared.Entity)
const Protocol = require(Shared.Protocol)
const Sequence = require(Shared.Sequence)
local records = {}
const ServerReplicate = require(script.Parent.Parent.Server.Replicate)
const UnreliableEvent = Shared.Remotes.Replicate
const SafeReplicateEvent = Shared.Remotes.SafeReplicate

const ClientOwned = Holder._clientOwned
if not ClientOwned[LocalPlayer] then
	ClientOwned[LocalPlayer] = {}
end
const PlayerEntities = ClientOwned[LocalPlayer]

local clock = 0
local hasTeleport = false
local hasStop = false

const function FireEvent(entity: Types.Entity, eventName: string, ...: any)
	const events = entity._events
	if not events then
		return
	end
	const signal = events[eventName]
	if signal then
		signal:Fire(entity, ...)
	end
end

const function Flush()
	for _, packet in Protocol.Pack(records) do
		if hasTeleport or hasStop then SafeReplicateEvent:FireServer(packet) else UnreliableEvent:FireServer(packet) end
	end
	table.clear(records)
end
const function WriteEntity(id, cf, fullCFrame, halfTicked, teleport, stop)
	local entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
	if not entity or not entity.generation then return end
	entity._sendSequence = Sequence.Next(entity._sendSequence)
	table.insert(records, Protocol.Record(entity, clock, cf, fullCFrame, halfTicked, teleport, stop))
end
--//This is to catch an edge case where the primarypart hasn't been replicated
const function CheckLocker(entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity._cfLockFailed then
		if entity._lockedCFReplication and entity.isContextOwner and not entity._player then
			const part = Entity._GetPart(entity)
			if part then
				Entity._LockPartPhysicsReplication(part)
				entity._cfLockFailed = nil
			end
		else
			entity._cfLockFailed = nil
		end
	end
end

const function CheckEntity(entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity.destroyed or entity.paused then
		return
	end

	const config = entity.entityConfig
	local tickRate = config.TICK_RATE

	if entity.isHalfTicked then
		tickRate = tickRate * 2
	elseif entity.isHalfTicked == nil then
		return
	end

	const now = clock
	const lastTime = entity.lastReplicatedTime or 0
	const difference = now - lastTime

	if difference < tickRate then
		return
	end
	CheckLocker(entity)
	FireEvent(entity, "Ticked", difference)
	const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)

	if entity.autoUpdatePosition and primaryPart then
		Entity._Push(entity, now, primaryPart.CFrame)
	end

	const currentCFrame = entity.latestCFrame
	const lastCFrame = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
	if currentCFrame and ServerReplicate.HasCFrameChanged(lastCFrame, currentCFrame) then
		entity.lastReplicatedTime = now
		const fullCFrame = config.FULL_ROTATION
		entity.lastCheckedCFrame = currentCFrame
		const teleport = entity._teleport ~= nil
		hasTeleport = hasTeleport or teleport
		WriteEntity(entity.id, currentCFrame, fullCFrame, entity.isHalfTicked, teleport)
		entity._teleport = nil
		const step = if lastCFrame then currentCFrame.Position - lastCFrame.Position else Vector3.zero
		const paused = (entity._idleTicks or 0) > 0
		Entity._RecordMove(entity, step, if paused then math.max(math.round(difference / tickRate), 2) else 1)
	elseif currentCFrame then
		const idleTicks = difference // tickRate
		const stopAfter = entity._stopAfter or 1
		if idleTicks >= stopAfter and (entity._idleTicks or 0) < stopAfter then
			hasStop = true
			WriteEntity(entity.id, currentCFrame, config.FULL_ROTATION, entity.isHalfTicked, false, true)
		end
		entity._idleTicks = idleTicks
	end
end

const function Update()
	clock = os.clock()
	for entity in PlayerEntities do
		CheckEntity(entity)
	end

	Flush()
	hasTeleport = false
	hasStop = false
end

return {
	Update = Update,
}
