local MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE = 0.0005

local lastUpdate = 0

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	UPDATE_INTERVAL = Config._GetConfig("GRID_UPDATE_INTERVAL") or UPDATE_INTERVAL
	MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE = Config._GetConfig("GRID_MAX_UPDATE_TIME") or MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE
end)

local FULL_TICKED = 0
local HALF_TICKED = 0
local UN_TICKED = 0

type PlayerEntityHolder = Types.PlayerEntityHolder

const entities = Holder.idMap
const playerTablePositionPair: { [PlayerEntityHolder]: vector } = {}
const playerToHolder: { [Player]: PlayerEntityHolder } = {}
const viewerIndex=require(Shared.ViewerIndex).new(64)

const function Check(entity: Entity)
	const part = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
	const cframe = part and part.CFrame or entity.latestCFrame
	if not cframe or entity.destroyed then
		return
	end
	if entity.id < 1 then
		Warn.high(entity, " has invalid id, cannot check for proximity")
		return
	end
	const position: vector = cframe.Position :: any
	const entityConfig = entity.entityConfig
	local hasNormalTickers = false
	local hasHalfTickers = false
	const halfTickDistance = entityConfig.HALF_TICK_DISTANCE or math.huge
	const normalTickDistance = entityConfig.NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE or math.huge
	const networkOwner = entity.networkOwner
	const ownedHolder = networkOwner and playerToHolder[networkOwner]

	const isLocked = entity._lockedCFReplication
	const isNotNative = isLocked or entity.modelReplicationMode ~= "NATIVE"
	local candidates=viewerIndex.all
	if isNotNative and halfTickDistance<math.huge then
		candidates=viewerIndex:Query(position,halfTickDistance)
		if ownedHolder and viewerIndex.all[ownedHolder] then candidates[ownedHolder]=viewerIndex.all[ownedHolder] end
	end
	for holder, playerPos in candidates do
		const viewer = holder.PLAYER
		const allowed = RuleAllows(entity, viewer)
		if not allowed then
			continue
		end

		const distance = vector.magnitude(position - playerPos)

		-- if entity is native then we keep it half ticked else remove it
		if distance > halfTickDistance and isNotNative then
			if holder == ownedHolder then -- always replicate to the owner
				hasNormalTickers = true
				table.insert(holder._TEMP_NORMAL, entity)
			end
			continue
		end

		if distance <= normalTickDistance then
			hasNormalTickers = true
			table.insert(holder._TEMP_NORMAL, entity)
		else
			hasHalfTickers = true
			table.insert(holder._TEMP_HALF, entity)
		end
	end

	const configTicker = entityConfig.TICKER
	if not configTicker then
		return
	end

	const currentTicker = entity._ticker
	if hasHalfTickers and not hasNormalTickers then
		SetTickMode(entity, true)
		HALF_TICKED += 1
	elseif hasNormalTickers then
		SetTickMode(entity, false)
		FULL_TICKED += 1
	else
		UN_TICKED += 1
	end
	if (hasNormalTickers or hasHalfTickers) and entity._ticker ~= configTicker then
		Ticker.move(entity, configTicker)
	elseif not (hasNormalTickers or hasHalfTickers) and currentTicker then
		SetTickMode(entity, nil)
		Ticker.Remove(currentTicker, entity)
	end
end

local yielded: thread? = nil
local totalTime = 0
const function DoLoop()
	viewerIndex:Rebuild(playerTablePositionPair)
	totalTime = 0
	FULL_TICKED = 0
	HALF_TICKED = 0
	UN_TICKED = 0
	for holder, _ in playerTablePositionPair do
		table.clear(holder._TEMP_HALF)
		table.clear(holder._TEMP_NORMAL)
	end
	debug.profilebegin("EntityGrid.Update")
	local count = 0
	local start = os.clock()
	local sections = 1
	-- clone as the table could be mutated
	for _, entity in table.clone(entities) do
		debug.profilebegin(`Check One`)
		Check(entity)
		count += 1
		debug.profileend()
		if os.clock() - start > MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE then
			sections += 1
			debug.profileend()
			totalTime += os.clock() - start
			yielded = coroutine.running()
			coroutine.yield()
			yielded = nil
			start = os.clock()
			debug.profilebegin("EntityGrid.ResumeUpdate")
		end
	end
	debug.profileend()
	totalTime += os.clock() - start
	Stats.SERVER.GRID_UPDATE_SECTIONS = sections
	Stats.SERVER.ENTITY_GRID_UPDATE_TIME_MS = totalTime * 1000
	Stats.SERVER.NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES = count
	Stats.SERVER.ENTITIES_FULL_TICKED = FULL_TICKED
	Stats.SERVER.ENTITIES_HALF_TICKED = HALF_TICKED
	Stats.SERVER.NON_TICKED = UN_TICKED

	for _, holder in playerToHolder do
		table.clear(holder.HALF)
		table.clear(holder.NORMAL)
		for _, entity in holder._TEMP_NORMAL do
			table.insert(holder.NORMAL, entity)
		end
		for _, entity in holder._TEMP_HALF do
			table.insert(holder.HALF, entity)
		end
	end

	if Stats.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE then
		const gridStats = {}
		for _, holder in playerToHolder do
			const entry = { HALF = {}, NORMAL = {} }
			for _, entity in holder.NORMAL do
				table.insert(entry.NORMAL, entity.id)
			end
			for _, entity in holder.HALF do
				table.insert(entry.HALF, entity.id)
			end
			gridStats[holder.PLAYER.Name] = entry
		end
		Stats.SERVER.GRID_STATS = gridStats
	end
end

-- this might be able to be optimized more later
const function Update()
	if yielded then

	end

const function RegisterPlayer(
	player: Player,
	character: Model,
	configuration: {
		config: string?,
		modelRepMode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE?,
	}
): Types.Entity
	const entity = playerEntities[player]

	if entity then
		Entity.Destroy(entity)
	end

	const config = configuration.config or "PLAYER"
	local modelRepMode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE? = configuration.modelRepMode
	const configData = Config._EntityConfigs[config] or {} :: any
	modelRepMode = modelRepMode or configData.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE
	character.Archivable = true

	const humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	const hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if humanoid and hrp then
		const rigType = humanoid.RigType
		if rigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and character.PrimaryPart == character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			Config.SetModelPrimaryForChrono(character, "HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end

	const newEntity = Entity.new(config, character, modelRepMode :: any)

	Holder.SetAsCharacter(player, newEntity)
	Entity.SetNetworkOwner(newEntity, player)

	return newEntity
end

const function UnregisterPlayer(player: Player)
	const entity = playerEntities[player]
	if entity then
		Entity.Destroy(entity)
	end
end

const function OnCharacterAdded(character: Model, player: Player)
	if Config.FLAGS.CHARACTER_WAIT_DELAY then
		const start = os.clock()
		while
			loadedAppearance[player] ~= character
			and player.Character == character
			and os.clock() - start < APPEARANCE_TIMEOUT
		do
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	if player.Character ~= character or not player.Parent then
		return
	end -- edge case
	const existing = playerEntities[player]
	if existing and existing.model == character then
		return 
	end
	RegisterPlayer(player, character, {
		config = "PLAYER",
	})
end

const function OnPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	const appearanceConnection = player.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		loadedAppearance[player] = character
	end)
	const connection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		OnCharacterAdded(character, player)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		if player:HasAppearanceLoaded() then
			loadedAppearance[player] = player.Character
		end
		task.spawn(OnCharacterAdded, player.Character, player)
	end
	local connection2: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	connection2 = player.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not player:IsDescendantOf(game) then
			loadedAppearance[player] = nil
			appearanceConnection:Disconnect()
			connection:Disconnect()
			if connection2 then
				connection2:Disconnect()
			end
		end
	end)
end

	if not RunService:IsServer() then

	end
	if Config._GetConfig("PLAYER_REPLICATION") ~= "AUTOMATIC" then

		return
	end
	const deathRemote = script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Remotes.Death
	const ReplicateMode: "NONE" | "PLAYER_ENTITIES" | "PLAYER_CHARACTERS" = Config._GetConfig("REPLICATE_DEATHS")
	if ReplicateMode ~= "NONE" then
		deathRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, id)
			const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
			if not entity then
				return
			end

			if entity.networkOwner ~= plr then
				return
			end
			if ReplicateMode == "PLAYER_CHARACTERS" and not entity._player then
				return
			end

			const model = entity.model
			if model then
				const humanoid: Humanoid? = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
				task.wait()
				if humanoid and humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then

							humanoid.Health = 0

							humanoid.Health = 0
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			deathRemote:FireAllClients(id)
		end)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(UnregisterPlayer)

	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		OnPlayerAdded(player)
	end
end)

const function HandleEntity(

			buffer.writeu8(copyB, 2, bit32.band(packed, bit32.bnot(4)))
		end
	elseif withinTeleportThreshold then
		return
	end

	if entity.lastClientClock and clientClock < entity.lastClientClock then
		return
	end

	if isStop and entity.snapshot and entity.snapshot.stoppedAt then
		isStop = false
		const packed = buffer.readu8(copyB, 2)
		buffer.writeu8(copyB, 2, bit32.band(packed, bit32.bnot(8)))
	end

	debug.profilebegin("HandleEntity.FireMiddleMans")
	if FireMiddleMans(player, entity, cframe, serverClock) then
		debug.profileend()
		return
	end
	debug.profileend()
	local velocity = nil
	if Config.FLAGS.SERVER_VELOCITY_FIX and entity.snapshot and entity.lastClientClock then
		const latest = entity.snapshot:GetLatest()
		const lastClientClock = entity.lastClientClock
		const baseTickRate = entity.entityConfig.TICK_RATE
		const tickrate = if entity.isHalfTicked then baseTickRate * 2 else baseTickRate
		if latest then
			velocity = InterpolationMath.CalculateVelocity(
				latest.value.Position,
				lastClientClock,
				cframe.Position,
				clientClock,
				tickrate
			)
		end
	end
	entity._receivedSequence = sequence
	entity.sourceTime = clientClock
	entity.receivedAt = serverClock
	entity.sourceGrade = "observed"
	const pushed = if isStop
		then Entity._PushStopped(entity, serverClock, cframe)
		else Entity._Push(entity, serverClock, cframe, velocity)
	if pushed then
		ExperimentalPrediction.Observe(entity,clientClock,cframe,if isStop then Vector3.zero else nil,"owner-clock",isTeleport)
		entity.arriveFrame = Ticker.GetGlobalTick()

		entity.lastClientClock = clientClock
		entity.cframeBuffer = copyB
		-- If we update the model on native this will cause the client to also update the model
		if entity.modelReplicationMode == "NATIVE" and not entity._lockedCFReplication then
			return true
		end
		Entity._SetPartCFrame(entity, cframe)
	end
	return pushed
end

const function OnReceive(player: Player, data: buffer)
	if typeof(data) ~= "buffer" or player.Parent == nil then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local budget = budgets[player]
	if not budget then budget = RateBudget.New(CalculateMaxThroughputForPlayer(player)*60, Protocol.MaxPayload*4, now) budgets[player] = budget end
	budget.rate=CalculateMaxThroughputForPlayer(player)*60
	if not RateBudget.Allow(budget, buffer.len(data), now) then refused("packet_rate") return end
	local rows, reason = Protocol.Decode(data)
	if not rows then refused(reason) return end
	BytesReceived += buffer.len(data)
	-- No clock/history/model is touched until the complete packet decoded successfully.
	local acceptedTime
	for _, row in rows do
		local thread=coroutine.create(HandleEntity)
		local ok, accepted = coroutine.resume(thread, player, row.id, now, row.time, row.frame, row.record,
			row.teleport, row.stop, row.generation, row.ownershipRevision, row.sequence)
		if not ok then refused("packet_handler")
		elseif coroutine.status(thread)~="dead" then coroutine.close(thread) refused("packet_handler_yielded")
		elseif accepted then acceptedTime=if acceptedTime then math.max(acceptedTime,row.time) else row.time end
	end
	if acceptedTime then ServerClock.Store(player, acceptedTime) end
end

const function SortMiddleMans()
	SortedMiddleMans = {}
	for _, data in MiddleMans do
		table.insert(SortedMiddleMans, data)
	end
	table.sort(SortedMiddleMans, function(a: MiddleMan, b: MiddleMan)
		return a.priority > b.priority
	end)
end

--[=[
	Registers a middle man function that can intercept incoming entity updates.

	@param name The unique name of the middle man
	@param priority The priority of the middle man ( higher priority runs first )
	@param func The function to call. Should return true to block the update, else allow it.
]=]
function Receiver.RegisterMiddleMan(
	name: string,
	priority: number,
	func: (
		player: Player,
		entity: Types.Entity,
		cframe: CFrame,
		arriveTime: number
	) -> boolean
)
	MiddleMans[name] = { priority = priority, func = func }
	SortMiddleMans()
end

--[=[
	Unregisters a middle man function.
	@param name The unique name of the middle man
]=]
function Receiver.UnregisterMiddleMan(name: string)
	MiddleMans[name] = nil
	SortMiddleMans()
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local lastByteCheckTime = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

		if os.clock() - lastByteCheckTime > 1 then
			Stats.BYTES_RECEIVED_PER_SEC = BytesReceived
			BytesReceived = 0
			lastByteCheckTime = os.clock()
		end
	end)
	UnreliableEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(OnReceive)
	SafeReplicateEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(OnReceive)

	Shared.Remotes.ClientHeartbeat.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, seconds: number)
		if type(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds ~= seconds or seconds < 0 or seconds > 1e12 or player.Parent == nil then
			return
		end
		local b = heartbeats[player] if not b then b = RateBudget.New(1, 4, os.clock()) heartbeats[player] = b end
		if not RateBudget.Allow(b, 1, os.clock()) then return end
		const clientClock = ClockUnwrap.seatFullFor(ClientClockWrap, player, seconds)
		ServerClock.Store(player, clientClock)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		ClientClockWrap[player] = nil
		budgets[player], heartbeats[player] = nil, nil
	end)
end

function Receiver._GetClientClockRaws(): { { player: Player, raw: number, offset: number } }
	const out = {}
	for player, state in ClientClockWrap do
		if state.lastRaw then
			table.insert(out, { player = player, raw = state.lastRaw, offset = state.offset })
		end
	end
	return out
end

return Receiver

const POSITION_EPSILON = 0.001
const ROTATION_EPSILON = 0.001

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	for _, entityConfig in Config._EntityConfigs do

		end

const function HasCFrameChanged(cframe1: CFrame?, cframe2: CFrame?): boolean
	if cframe1 == cframe2 then
		return false
	end
	if cframe1 == nil or cframe2 == nil then
		return true
	end
	return vector.magnitude((cframe1.Position - cframe2.Position) :: any) > POSITION_EPSILON
		or vector.magnitude((cframe1.LookVector - cframe2.LookVector) :: any) > ROTATION_EPSILON
		or vector.magnitude((cframe1.UpVector - cframe2.UpVector) :: any) > ROTATION_EPSILON
end

const function FireEvent(entity: Types.Entity, eventName: string, ...: any)
	const events = entity._events
	if not events then
		return
	end
	const signal = events[eventName]
	if signal then
		signal:Fire(entity, ...)
	end
end

const function SerializeEntityCFrame(entity, time: number, cframe: CFrame, useFull: boolean, stop: boolean?): buffer
	entity._sendSequence = Sequence.Next(entity._sendSequence)
	return Protocol.Record(entity, time, cframe, useFull, entity.isHalfTicked, false, stop)
end

const function PushLatest(entity: Types.Entity, time: number)
	if entity.autoUpdatePosition and entity.isContextOwner and entity.model then
		const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
		if not primaryPart then
			Warn.low("Entity", entity, "has no primary part")
			return
		end
		const cframe = primaryPart.CFrame
		Entity._Push(entity, time, cframe)
		-- Derive from captured poses. Lock helpers/constraints can have unrelated
		-- physics velocities even when the game's authored transform is well behaved.
		ExperimentalPrediction.Observe(entity,time,cframe,nil,"server-clock")
	end
end

const function CheckForChanges(entity: Types.Entity): CFrame?
	const lastCFrame = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
	const currentCFrame = entity.latestCFrame

	if HasCFrameChanged(lastCFrame, currentCFrame) then
		entity.lastCheckedCFrame = currentCFrame
		return currentCFrame
	end
	return nil
end

const function CheckEntity(entity: Types.Entity, ticker: Types.Ticker, useFull: boolean, isHalfTick: boolean)
	if entity.destroyed then
		Ticker.Remove(ticker, entity)
		return
	end

	if not entity.isContextOwner then
		return
	end

	const entityIsHalf = entity.isHalfTicked
	entity._halfBuffer = nil
	if (entityIsHalf and not isHalfTick) or entity.paused then
		entity.cframeBuffer = nil
		return
	end
	if entityIsHalf then
		FireEvent(entity, "Ticked", ticker.halfdt)
	else
		FireEvent(entity, "Ticked", ticker.dt)
	end

	PushLatest(entity, ticker.lastTicked)
	const previous = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
	const changes = CheckForChanges(entity)

	if changes then
		if entity.id == 0 then
			Warn.high(entity, "has an id of 0, skipping replication")
			entity.cframeBuffer = nil
			return
		end
		entity.cframeBuffer = SerializeEntityCFrame(entity, ticker.lastTicked, changes, useFull)
		const step = if previous then changes.Position - previous.Position else Vector3.zero
		Entity._RecordMove(entity, step, (entity._idleTicks or 0) + 1)
	else
		entity.cframeBuffer = nil
		const idleTicks = (entity._idleTicks or 0) + 1
		entity._idleTicks = idleTicks
		const resting = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
		if resting and idleTicks == (entity._stopAfter or 1) then
			entity.cframeBuffer = SerializeEntityCFrame(entity, ticker.lastTicked, resting, useFull, true)
		elseif resting and isHalfTick and idleTicks == 1 and not entityIsHalf then
			entity._halfBuffer = SerializeEntityCFrame(entity, ticker.lastTicked, resting, useFull, true)
		end
	end
end

const Changes: { Types.Entity } = {}

--In the future we can optimize this so it uses buffers if really needed
const function CheckEntityChanges()
	for entity, changes in Holder._entityChangedFields do
		const newChanges = { id = entity.id, data = {} }
		for key, data in changes do
			data = data or (entity :: any)[key]
			table.insert(newChanges.data, { key, data })
		end
		Holder._entityChangedFields[entity] = nil
		entity._changes = newChanges
		table.insert(Changes, entity)
	end
end

local TotalTickerTime = 0
local CountTicker = 0

const function UpdateTickers()
	debug.profilebegin("UpdateTickers")
	const starts = os.clock()
	for _, ticker in tickers do
		if not next(ticker.objects) then
			continue
		end
		debug.profilebegin(`{ticker.config.NAME}`)
		if Ticker.CheckUpdate(ticker) then
			const useFull = ticker.config.FULL_ROTATION == true
			const isHalfTick = ticker.tickedHalf
			for _, object in ticker.objects do
				CheckEntity(object, ticker, useFull, isHalfTick)
			end
		end
		debug.profileend()
	end
	debug.profileend()
	const diff = os.clock() - starts
	TotalTickerTime += diff
	CountTicker += 1
	Stats.AVG_TICKER_TIME_MS = (TotalTickerTime / CountTicker) * 1000
	if CountTicker >= 60 then
		TotalTickerTime = 0
		CountTicker = 0
	end
end

const function UpdatePlayerPositions()
	for _, entity: Types.Entity in Holder._playerChars do
		const player = entity.networkOwner
		const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
		const cframe = primaryPart and primaryPart.CFrame or entity.latestCFrame

		if player and cframe then
			EntityGrid.UpdatePlayerPosition(player, cframe.Position :: any)
		end
	end
end

const function UpdateHeartbeat()
	const now = os.clock()
	if now - lastHeartbeat >= HEARTBEAT_RATE then
		lastHeartbeat = now
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if not EntityGrid.GetEntityHolder(player) then
				continue
			end
			HeartbeatRemote:FireClient(player, now)
		end
	end
end

const function UpdateClientClockRelay()
	const now = os.clock()
	if now - lastClientClockRelay < CLIENT_CLOCK_SYNC_RATE then
		return
	end
	lastClientClockRelay = now

	const raws = _Receiver._GetClientClockRaws()
	if #raws == 0 then
		return
	end

	ClientClockRelayRemote:FireAllClients(raws)
end

const function Update()
	EntityGrid.Update()
	UpdatePlayerPositions()
	ApplyMounts()
	UpdateTickers()
	CheckEntityChanges()
	UpdateHeartbeat()
	UpdateClientClockRelay()

	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Sender.ReplicatePlayer(player)
	end
	for _, entity in Changes do
		entity._changes = nil
	end
	table.clear(Changes)
	UpdateEntityStats()
	Ticker._IncrementGlobalTick()
end

const function HandleEntity(plr: Player, entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity.destroyed or entity.networkOwner ~= plr then
		return
	end
	const addModel, clearModel = Bin()

	const function HandleModel()
		if not entity.model then
			return
		end

		const partToUse = Entity._GetRootPart(entity)

		if not partToUse then
			return
		end

		const function CFrameChanged()
			const cframe = partToUse.CFrame
			if entity.mountParentId then
				entity.latestCFrame = cframe
				return
			end
			if cframe == entity.latestCFrame then
				return
			end

			Entity.SetCFrame(entity, cframe)
		end

		addModel(partToUse:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(CFrameChanged))
	end
	const function Rebind()
		clearModel()
		HandleModel()
	end
	const addEntity, clearEntity = Bin()
	const function Cleanup()
		clearModel()
		clearEntity()
	end
	addEntity(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "ModelChanged"):Connect(Rebind))
	addEntity(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "LockChanged"):Connect(Rebind))
	addEntity(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "NetworkOwnerChanged"):Once(Cleanup))
	addEntity(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "Destroying"):Once(Cleanup))

	HandleModel()
end

const function HandleCFrameSetters()
	const mode: "NONE" | "PLAYER_ENTITIES" | "PLAYER_CHARACTERS" = Config._GetConfig("REPLICATE_CFRAME_SETTERS")
	if mode == "NONE" then
		return
	end
	if mode == "PLAYER_ENTITIES" then
		Events.PlayerOwnedAdded:Connect(HandleEntity, true)
	else
		Events.PlayerCharacterRegistered:Connect(HandleEntity, true)
	end

	for _, entity in Holder.idMap do
		if mode == "PLAYER_ENTITIES" and entity.networkOwner then
			HandleEntity(entity.networkOwner, entity)
		elseif mode == "PLAYER_CHARACTERS" and entity._player then
			HandleEntity(entity._player, entity)
		end
	end
end

const function PlayerAdded(plr: Player)
	const raws = _Receiver._GetClientClockRaws()
	ClientClockRelayRemote:FireAllClients(raws)
end

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	HandleCFrameSetters()
	Events._Signals.PlayerLoaded.Event:Connect(PlayerAdded)
	RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(Update)
end)

return {
	HasCFrameChanged = HasCFrameChanged,
}

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Ticker = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Ticker)
const Entity = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Entity)

const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)

const ModelHelper = require(Shared.ModelHelper)
const Stats = require(Shared.Stats).SERVER
const Protocol = require(Shared.Protocol)

local BytesSentPerSec = 0
local PacketsSentPerSec = 0


type BufferHolder = { [Types.Ticker]: { buffer } }
const UnreliableEvent = Shared.Remotes.Replicate
const ReliableEvent = Shared.Remotes.ReplicateFull
const SafeReplicateEvent = Shared.Remotes.SafeReplicate

const function SendRecords(player, rows, kind, event)
	for _, packet in Protocol.Pack(rows) do
		(event or UnreliableEvent):FireClient(player, kind, packet)
		BytesSentPerSec += buffer.len(packet)
		PacketsSentPerSec += 1
	end
end
const function FlushClientOwned(player, groups, event)
	local rows = {}
	for _, records in groups do for _, record in records do table.insert(rows, record) end end
	SendRecords(player, rows, "O", event)
end
const function FlushEntities(player, groups, isHalf, event)
	local rows = {}
	for _, records in groups do for _, record in records do table.insert(rows, Protocol.WithHalf(record, isHalf == true)) end end
	SendRecords(player, rows, "X", event)
end

const function AddBuffer(holder: BufferHolder, ticker: Types.Ticker, b: buffer)
	local bufferTable = holder[ticker]
	if not bufferTable then
		bufferTable = {}
		holder[ticker] = bufferTable
	end
	table.insert(bufferTable, b)
end

--//honestly tables should beeeee fine for nowww, could buffer it later if reallllly needed
const function GetEntityFullData(player: Player, entity: Types.Entity): Types.EntityReceivePacket?
	if entity.destroyed then
		return nil
	end
	const modelData = ModelHelper.ReadyModelFromRep(entity, player)

	local configName: string? = entity.entityConfig.NAME
	if configName == "DEFAULT" then
		configName = nil
	end

	local cframe = entity.latestCFrame or CFrame.identity
	local time = entity.lastClientClock or 0

	if entity.isContextOwner then
		const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
		if primaryPart then
			cframe = primaryPart.CFrame
		end

		time = os.clock()
	end

	return {
		id = entity.id,
		generation = entity.generation, ownershipRevision = entity.ownershipRevision or 0,
		sequence = entity._receivedSequence or entity._sendSequence or 0,
		_player = entity._player,
		networkOwner = entity.networkOwner,
		cframe = cframe,
		time = time,
		config = configName,

		model = modelData,

		paused = entity.paused,
		autoUpdatePosition = entity.autoUpdatePosition,
		isHalfTicked = entity.isHalfTicked,
		_data = entity._data,
		_lockedCFReplication = entity._lockedCFReplication,
		_interpolationMode = entity._interpolationMode,
		_humanoidState = entity._humanoidState,
		_humanoidDisabledStates = entity._humanoidDisabledStates,

		mountParentId = entity.mountParentId,
		mountOffset = entity.mountOffset,
		broadPhase = entity.broadPhase :: any,
	}
end

local playerReplicateTotal = 0
local playerReplicateCount = 0
const function ReplicatePlayer(player: Player)
	const holder = EntityGrid.GetEntityHolder(player)
	if not holder then
		return
	end
	debug.profilebegin("ReplicatePlayer")
	const replicatedOLD = holder.REPLICATED -- Leftovers will be removed
	const replicated = table.clone(replicatedOLD)
	holder.REPLICATED = replicated

	const holderEntityAdded = holder.EntityAdded
	const holderEntityRemoving = holder.EntityRemoving
	const normal = holder.NORMAL
	const half = holder.HALF

	const toSendFull = {}
	const toRemove = {}
	const clientOwned = {}
	const clientReliable = {}
	const entityChanges = {}

	const normalBuffers: BufferHolder = {}
	const halfBuffers: BufferHolder = {}
	const normalStops: BufferHolder = {}
	const halfStops: BufferHolder = {}
	const frameTimeNow = Ticker.GetGlobalTick()

	const function HandleClientEntities(entity: Types.Entity)
		if entity.arriveFrame ~= frameTimeNow then -- (time will be the same during the same frame)
			return
		end
		if entity.networkOwner == player then
			return
		end
		const clientTime = entity.lastClientClock or 0
		const cframeBuffer = entity.cframeBuffer :: buffer
		const reliable = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(cframeBuffer, 2), 12) ~= 0 -- teleport or stop
		const target = if reliable then clientReliable else clientOwned
		if not target[clientTime] then
			target[clientTime] = {}
		end

		table.insert(target[clientTime], cframeBuffer)
	end

	const function Handle(entity: Types.Entity, isNormal: boolean)
		if entity.destroyed then
			return
		end
		replicated[entity] = true
		if not replicatedOLD[entity] then
			holderEntityAdded:Fire(entity)
			table.insert(toSendFull, GetEntityFullData(player, entity))
			return
		end
		if entity._changes then
			table.insert(entityChanges, entity._changes)
		end
		replicatedOLD[entity] = nil
		if entity.paused then
			return
		end

		const isServerOwned = entity.isContextOwner
		if not isServerOwned then
			HandleClientEntities(entity)
			return
		end

		const ticker = entity._ticker
		if not (ticker and ticker.tickedFrame == frameTimeNow) then
			return
		end

		const isHalf = entity.isHalfTicked or not isNormal
		const cframeBuffer = entity.cframeBuffer

		if cframeBuffer and (entity._idleTicks or 0) > 0 then
			AddBuffer(isHalf and halfStops or normalStops, ticker, cframeBuffer)
			return
		end

		if isHalf and not ticker.tickedHalf then
			return
		end

		const toSend = if isHalf then cframeBuffer or entity._halfBuffer else cframeBuffer
		if toSend then
			AddBuffer(isHalf and halfBuffers or normalBuffers, ticker, toSend)
		end
	end
	const startTime = os.clock()
	for _, entity in normal do
		Handle(entity, true)
	end
	for _, entity in half do
		Handle(entity, false)
	end

	for entity, _ in replicatedOLD do
		replicated[entity] = nil
		holderEntityRemoving:Fire(entity)
		table.insert(toRemove,{id=entity._lastId or entity.id,generation=entity.generation,
			preserveModel=entity._preserveModelOnRemoval==true,anchored=entity._removalAnchor})
	end

	FlushClientOwned(player, clientOwned)
	FlushEntities(player, normalBuffers)
	FlushEntities(player, halfBuffers, true)

	FlushClientOwned(player, clientReliable, SafeReplicateEvent)
	FlushEntities(player, normalStops, false, SafeReplicateEvent)
	FlushEntities(player, halfStops, true, SafeReplicateEvent)

	if #toRemove > 0 or #toSendFull > 0 or #entityChanges > 0 then
		ReliableEvent:FireClient(player, toSendFull, toRemove, entityChanges)
	end
	debug.profileend()
	const endTime = os.clock()
	playerReplicateTotal += endTime - startTime
	playerReplicateCount += 1
end

local lastStatTime = os.clock()

if RunService:IsServer() then
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		Stats.REPLICATE_PLAYER_TIME_MS = playerReplicateTotal / math.max(playerReplicateCount, 1) * 1000
		if os.clock() - lastStatTime > 1 then
			Stats.BYTES_SENT_PER_SEC = BytesSentPerSec
			Stats.PACKETS_SENT_PER_SEC = PacketsSentPerSec
			BytesSentPerSec = 0
			PacketsSentPerSec = 0
			lastStatTime = os.clock()
			playerReplicateTotal = 0
			playerReplicateCount = 0
		end
	end)
end

return {
	ReplicatePlayer = ReplicatePlayer,
}

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)


const ServerClockData = {} :: { [Player]: {
	arrivalOffset: number,
} }

const SMOOTHING = 0.2
const DEFAULT_MAX_REWIND = 1

const function Store(player: Player, clientClockTime: number)
	const measured = os.clock() - clientClockTime
	const data = ServerClockData[player]
	if not data then
		ServerClockData[player] = { arrivalOffset = measured }
		return
	end
	data.arrivalOffset += SMOOTHING * (measured - data.arrivalOffset)
end

const function ConvertTo(player: Player, clock: number, environment: "Server" | "Client")
	const data = ServerClockData[player]
	if not data then
		return clock
	end

	if environment == "Server" then
		return clock + data.arrivalOffset
	else
		return clock - data.arrivalOffset
	end
end

--[=[
	Converts a client's render time for an entity 
	into the server's timeline, ready for Entity.GetAt. Clamped to the last maxRewind seconds.

	@param maxRewind How far back to allow, in seconds. Defaults to 1.
]=]
const function ToServerTime(entity: Types.Entity?, renderTime: number, maxRewind: number?): number?
	if not entity or type(renderTime) ~= "number" or renderTime ~= renderTime then
		return nil
	end
	local serverTime = renderTime
	const owner = entity.networkOwner
	if owner then
		const data = ServerClockData[owner]
		if not data then
			return nil
		end
		serverTime += data.arrivalOffset
	end
	local window = maxRewind or DEFAULT_MAX_REWIND
	if not (window >= 0) then -- negative or NaN
		window = DEFAULT_MAX_REWIND
	end
	const now = os.clock()
	return math.clamp(serverTime, now - window, now)
end

const function Remove(player: Player)
	ServerClockData[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(Remove)

return {
	Store = Store,
	ConvertTo = ConvertTo,
	ToServerTime = ToServerTime,
	Remove = Remove,
}

const IS_SERVER = game:GetService("RunService"):IsServer()

const Entity = require(script.Parent.Entity)
const Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
const Holder = require(script.Parent.Holder)
const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

local timestamp = 0
const visited = {} :: { [Types.Entity]: number }
const dp = {} :: { [Types.Entity]: number }
const world = {} :: { [Types.Entity]: CFrame }

const path = {} :: { Types.Entity }
const mountedEntities = {} :: { [Types.Entity]: true }

const function SetCFrame(entity: Types.Entity, cframe: CFrame)
	const root = Entity._GetRootPart(entity)
	if root then
		root.CFrame = cframe
		if entity.isContextOwner then
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end
end
const function ResolveWorldCFrame(entity: Types.Entity): CFrame
	const currentTime = timestamp
	if dp[entity] == currentTime then
		return world[entity]
	end

	local n = 0
	local current = entity
	local rootCFrame = CFrame.identity

	while true do
		if dp[current] == currentTime then
			rootCFrame = world[current]
			break
		end

		if visited[current] == currentTime then
			--cycle detected
			rootCFrame = Entity.GetAt(current, Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(current))
				or current.latestCFrame
				or CFrame.identity
			dp[current] = currentTime
			world[current] = rootCFrame
			SetCFrame(current, rootCFrame)
			break
		end

		visited[current] = currentTime

		const parentId = current.mountParentId
		if not parentId then
			if current.isContextOwner then
				const part = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(current)
				rootCFrame = if part then part.CFrame else (current.latestCFrame or CFrame.identity)
			else
				const at = Entity.GetAt(current, Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(current))
				const part = if at then nil else Entity.GetPrimaryPart(current)
				rootCFrame = if at
					then Entity._ApplyOwnerSmoothing(current, at)
					elseif part then part.CFrame
					else (current.latestCFrame or CFrame.identity)
			end
			dp[current] = currentTime
			world[current] = rootCFrame
			break
		end

		const parent = Holder.GetEntityFromId(parentId)
		if not parent or parent.destroyed then
			rootCFrame = Entity.GetAt(current, Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(current))
				or current.latestCFrame
				or CFrame.identity
			dp[current] = currentTime
			world[current] = rootCFrame
			SetCFrame(current, rootCFrame)
			break
		end

		n += 1
		path[n] = current
		current = parent
	end

	local out = rootCFrame or CFrame.identity
	for i = n, 1, -1 do
		const child = path[i]
		out = out * (child.mountOffset or CFrame.identity)
		dp[child] = currentTime
		world[child] = out
		SetCFrame(child, out)
		path[i] = nil
	end

	if dp[entity] ~= currentTime then
		dp[entity] = currentTime
		world[entity] = out
		SetCFrame(entity, out)
	end

	return world[entity]
end

Events.EntityAdded:Connect(function(entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity.mountParentId then
		mountedEntities[entity] = true
	end
end, true)

Events.EntityMountChanged:Connect(function(entity: Types.Entity, mountParentId: number?)
	if mountParentId then
		mountedEntities[entity] = true
	else
		mountedEntities[entity] = nil
	end
end, true)

Events.EntityRemoved:Connect(function(entity: Types.Entity)
	visited[entity] = nil
	dp[entity] = nil
	world[entity] = nil
	mountedEntities[entity] = nil

	if IS_SERVER then
		const id = entity._lastId or entity.id
		const children = {}
		for child in mountedEntities do
			if child.mountParentId == id and not child.destroyed then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end
		for _, child in children do
			Entity.ClearMount(child)
		end
	end
end, true)

const function ApplyMounts()
	debug.profilebegin("ApplyMounts")
	for entity in mountedEntities do
		if entity.destroyed or dp[entity] == timestamp then
			continue
		end
		ResolveWorldCFrame(entity)
	end
	timestamp += 1
	debug.profileend()
end

return ApplyMounts

const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

type BinItem =
	Instance
	| RBXScriptConnection
	| thread
	| (() -> ...any)
	| Types.Connection
	| Types.Signal<any, ...any>
	| { _binCleanup: (...any) -> () }

export type Add = <T>(Item: T & BinItem) -> T
export type Clear = () -> ()

return function(): (Add, Clear)
	const Bin: { BinItem } = {}

	return function<T>(Item: T & BinItem)
		table.insert(Bin, Item :: any)

		return Item
	end :: any,
		function()
			for _, Item in Bin do
				if typeof(Item) == "Instance" then
					Item:Destroy()
				elseif typeof(Item) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
					Item:Disconnect()
				elseif typeof(Item) == "function" then
					task.spawn(Item)
				elseif typeof(Item) == "thread" then
					pcall(task.cancel, Item) -- must pcall or could error when passing its own thread in
				elseif typeof(Item) == "table" and Item._binCleanup and type(Item._binCleanup) == "function" then
					(Item :: any):_binCleanup()
				end
			end

			table.clear(Bin)
		end
end

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const IS_SERVER = RunService:IsServer()
const LOCKER_NAME = "__CHRONO_LOCKER"

const function SafeSetNetworkOwner(part: BasePart, player: Player?)
	if part:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
		part:SetNetworkOwner(player)
	end
end

const function GetLockedRoot(part: BasePart): BasePart?
	const locker = part:FindFirstChild(LOCKER_NAME)
	if not locker then
		return nil
	end
	return locker:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or part
end

const function LockCFReplication(part: BasePart?): BasePart?
	if not part then
		return nil
	end
	const initCF = part.CFrame
	const previousLocker = part:FindFirstChild(LOCKER_NAME)
	if previousLocker then
		const weld = previousLocker:FindFirstChild("__CHRONO_WELD") :: Motor6D
		if weld then
			weld.Part1 = part
			part.CFrame = initCF
			return weld.Part0
		else
			pcall(previousLocker.Destroy, previousLocker)
		end
	end
	--[[
		This trick helps disable roblox's cf replication by create a part that
		take priority and acts like the root part which we call the locker.
		The locker part will be hidden on the server in a camera which will
		cause roblox to not replicate the locker to the client which will
		disable roblox's cf replication.
	]]
	const camera = Instance.new("Camera", part)
	camera.Archivable = false
	camera.Name = LOCKER_NAME
	const weld = Instance.new("Weld", camera)
	weld.Name = "__CHRONO_WELD"
	const locker = Instance.new("Part")
	locker.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.0001, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	locker.Name = "__CHRONO_LOCKER_PART"
	locker.Parent = camera
	locker.CanCollide = false
	locker.CanQuery = false
	locker.CanTouch = false
	locker.Transparency = if IS_SERVER then 0 else 1
	locker.Color = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
	locker.Massless = false
	locker.RootPriority = 126
	locker.Size = Vector3.zero
	weld.Part0 = locker
	weld.Part1 = part
	part.CFrame = initCF
	return locker
end

const function UnlockCFReplication(part: BasePart?)
	if not part then
		return
	end
	const cf = part.CFrame
	const locker = part:FindFirstChild(LOCKER_NAME)
	if locker then
		-- Safer to destroy and recreate than to reuse the weld
		locker:Destroy()
		part.CFrame = cf
	end
end

return {
	Lock = LockCFReplication,
	Unlock = UnlockCFReplication,
	GetLockedRoot = GetLockedRoot,
	SafeSetNetworkOwner = SafeSetNetworkOwner,
}

const CLOCK_SCALE = 10000
const TWO32 = 2 ^ 32
const TWO31 = 2 ^ 31
const CLOCK_WRAP = TWO32 / CLOCK_SCALE

export type State = { lastRaw: number?, offset: number }
export type Store = { [any]: State }

const ClockUnwrap = {}
ClockUnwrap.SCALE = CLOCK_SCALE
ClockUnwrap.WRAP = CLOCK_WRAP

function ClockUnwrap.quantize(seconds: number): number
	return math.floor(seconds * CLOCK_SCALE) % TWO32
end

function ClockUnwrap.new(): State
	return { lastRaw = nil, offset = 0 }
end

-- for u32
function ClockUnwrap.unwrap(state: State, raw: number): number
	raw %= TWO32
	const lastRaw = state.lastRaw
	if lastRaw then
		const diff = (raw - lastRaw) % TWO32
		if diff < TWO31 then
			if raw < lastRaw then
				state.offset += CLOCK_WRAP
			end
			state.lastRaw = raw
		else
			return (lastRaw + state.offset * CLOCK_SCALE - (TWO32 - diff)) / CLOCK_SCALE
		end
	else
		state.lastRaw = raw
	end
	return raw / CLOCK_SCALE + state.offset
end

function ClockUnwrap.unwrapFor(store: Store, key: any, raw: number): number
	local state = store[key]
	if not state then
		state = ClockUnwrap.new()
		store[key] = state
	end
	return ClockUnwrap.unwrap(state, raw)
end

-- for f64 syncing
function ClockUnwrap.seatFull(state: State, seconds: number): number
	const scaled = math.floor(seconds * CLOCK_SCALE)
	const raw = scaled % TWO32
	state.lastRaw = raw
	state.offset = (scaled - raw) / CLOCK_SCALE
	return scaled / CLOCK_SCALE
end

function ClockUnwrap.seatFullFor(store: Store, key: any, seconds: number): number
	local state = store[key]
	if not state then
		state = ClockUnwrap.new()
		store[key] = state
	end
	return ClockUnwrap.seatFull(state, seconds)
end

return ClockUnwrap

const function CheckOption(name: string, value: any, options: { string })
	assert(table.find(options, value), `Chrono: {name} must be {table.concat(options, ", ")}, got {tostring(value)}`)
end

const function CheckEntityType(name: string, config: Types.EntityConfigInput)
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "Chrono: entity type name must be a non-empty string")
	assert(type(config) == "table", `Chrono: entity type "{name}" must be a table`)
	assert(
		type(config.TICK_RATE) == "number" and config.TICK_RATE > 0 and config.TICK_RATE < math.huge,
		`Chrono: entity type "{name}" needs a finite TICK_RATE greater than 0, such as 1 / 20`
	)
	if config.BUFFER ~= nil then
		assert(
			type(config.BUFFER) == "number" and math.abs(config.BUFFER) < math.huge,
			`Chrono: entity type "{name}" BUFFER must be a finite number`
		)
	end
	for _, field in { "NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE", "HALF_TICK_DISTANCE" } do
		const value = (config :: any)[field]
		assert(
			value == nil or (type(value) == "number" and value >= 0),
			`Chrono: entity type "{name}" {field} must be a non-negative number`
		)
	end
	for _, field in {
		"FULL_ROTATION",
		"AUTO_UPDATE_POSITION",
		"STORE_SNAPSHOTS",
		"ASSEMBLY_ROOT_PART_CHECK",
		"CUSTOM_INTERPOLATION",
	} do
		const value = (config :: any)[field]
		assert(value == nil or type(value) == "boolean", `Chrono: entity type "{name}" {field} must be a boolean`)
	end
	if config.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE ~= nil then
		CheckOption(`entity type "{name}" MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE`, config.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE, MODEL_MODES)
	end
	if config.INTERPOLATION_MODE ~= nil then
		CheckOption(`entity type "{name}" INTERPOLATION_MODE`, config.INTERPOLATION_MODE, INTERPOLATION_MODES)
	end
end

		error(`Chrono: Config.SetConfig got unknown config "{name}"`, 2)
	end
	assert(type(value) == type(BASE_CONFIG[name]), `Chrono: Config.{name} must be a {type(BASE_CONFIG[name])}`)
	if type(value) == "number" then
		if name == "DEFAULT_NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE" or name == "DEFAULT_HALF_TICK_DISTANCE" then
			assert(value >= 0, `Chrono: Config.{name} must be 0 or greater (math.huge is allowed)`)
		else
			assert(value >= 0 and value < math.huge, `Chrono: Config.{name} must be a finite number, 0 or greater`)
		end
		local bounds=EXPERIMENT_BOUNDS[name]
		if bounds then assert(value>=bounds[1] and value<=bounds[2], "Experimental prediction setting outside bounds: "..name) end
		if name == "MAX_SNAPSHOT_COUNT" then
			assert(value >= 1 and value % 1 == 0, "Chrono: Config.MAX_SNAPSHOT_COUNT must be a positive integer")
		elseif name == "GRID_MAX_UPDATE_TIME" then
			assert(value > 0, "Chrono: Config.GRID_MAX_UPDATE_TIME must be greater than 0")
		elseif name == "VISUAL_PREDICTION_SECONDS" then
			assert(value<=0.25,"Display prediction is limited to 250 ms")
		elseif name == "VISUAL_PREDICTION_DISTANCE" then
			assert(value<=32,"Display prediction is limited to 32 studs")
		elseif name == "VISUAL_PREDICTION_SPEED" then
			assert(value<=4096,"Display prediction speed must be at most 4096 studs/s")
		end
	elseif CONFIG_OPTIONS[name] then
		CheckOption(`Config.{name}`, value, CONFIG_OPTIONS[name])
	end
	BASE_CONFIG[name] = value
end :: SetConfig

const function GetEntityType(name: string?): Types.EntityConfig
	return name and ENTITY_TYPES[name] or ENTITY_TYPES["DEFAULT"]
end

const function GetEntityModel(name: string): Model | BasePart | false?
	if ENTITY_MODELS[name] == nil then
		warn(`Entity model {name} not found in Config.`)
		return nil
	end
	return ENTITY_MODELS[name] :: any
end

const function GetBroadPhase(name: string): vector?
	return MODEL_BROAD_PHASES[name] :: any
end

const function GetConfig(name: Configs): any
	return BASE_CONFIG[name]
end

const waiting: { () -> () } = {}
const function WaitForLock(fx: () -> ())
	if LOCKED then
		fx()
	else
		table.insert(waiting, fx)
	end
end

const function SetWarningSeverity(level: WarningLevels)
	if level ~= "NONE" and level ~= "LOW" and level ~= "MEDIUM" and level ~= "HIGH" then
		error(`Chrono: Config.SetWarningSeverity expected "NONE", "LOW", "MEDIUM" or "HIGH", got {level}`, 2)
	end
	BASE_CONFIG.WARNING_SEVERITY = level
end

const function Lock()
	assert(BASE_CONFIG.MIN_BUFFER <= BASE_CONFIG.MAX_BUFFER, "Chrono: Config.MIN_BUFFER must not exceed MAX_BUFFER")
	for name, config in ENTITY_TYPES do
		CheckEntityType(name, config)
	end
	(require)(script.Parent.Warn).low("Config is now locked")

	LOCKED = true
	const DEFAULT_NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE = BASE_CONFIG.DEFAULT_NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE
	const DEFAULT_HALF_TICK_DISTANCE = BASE_CONFIG.DEFAULT_HALF_TICK_DISTANCE
	for i, v in ENTITY_TYPES do
		const cloned = table.clone(v)
		cloned.NAME = i
		cloned.AUTO_UPDATE_POSITION = cloned.AUTO_UPDATE_POSITION ~= false
		cloned.FULL_ROTATION = cloned.FULL_ROTATION or false
		cloned.NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE = cloned.NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE or DEFAULT_NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE
		cloned.HALF_TICK_DISTANCE = cloned.HALF_TICK_DISTANCE or DEFAULT_HALF_TICK_DISTANCE
		cloned.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE = cloned.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE
			or BASE_CONFIG.DEFAULT_MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE :: any
		cloned.INTERPOLATION_MODE = cloned.INTERPOLATION_MODE or BASE_CONFIG.DEFAULT_INTERPOLATION_MODE :: any
		if IS_SERVER then
			cloned.TICKER = (require)(script.Parent.Ticker).new(cloned)
		else
			cloned.CLIENT_CLOCK = {} :: any
			cloned.UpdateBuffer = function(self: Types.EntityConfig, buffer: number)
				if not self.CLIENT_CLOCK or not next(self.CLIENT_CLOCK :: any) then
					error("Config not initialized yet, cannot update buffer for entity type: " .. self.NAME)
				end
				self.BUFFER = buffer
				if self.CLIENT_CLOCK.NORMAL then
					self.CLIENT_CLOCK.NORMAL:UpdateBuffer(buffer)
				end
				if self.CLIENT_CLOCK.HALF then
					self.CLIENT_CLOCK.HALF:UpdateBuffer(buffer)
				end

				const Holder = (require)(script.Parent.Holder)
				const Entity = (require)(script.Parent.Entity)
				for _, entity in Holder.idMap do
					if entity.entityConfig == self then
						Entity._UpdateClockBuffer(entity)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		ENTITY_TYPES[i] = cloned
	end
	for _, fx in waiting do
		fx()
	end
end

return {
	SetConfig = SetConfig,
	RegisterEntityType = RegisterEntityType,
	RegisterEntityModel = RegisterEntityModel,
	FLAGS = {
		["CHARACTER_WAIT_DELAY"] = true, -- Waits for CharacterAppearanceLoaded before loading
		["SERVER_VELOCITY_FIX"] = true, -- Fixes velocity calculation on the server when two packets are received next to each other
		["VELOCITY_CALC_FIX"] = true, -- Fixes velocity calculation when dt is less then tickrate
		["SNAPSHOT_INTERPOLATION_FIX"] = true, -- Fixes interpolation of snapshots when replication is stopped briefly and resumed rapidly which can cause slight jitter due to velocity.
		["SET_CFRAME_FIX"] = true, -- Adds a teleport flag to packets
		["FIX_TELEPORT_JITTER"] = true, -- Resolves jitter issue when clearing snapshots then settings cframe/teleporting can cause a bouncing effect. Uses a locking mechanism when getting the snapshot buffer to prevent old snapshots from being retrieved.
	},

	_EntityConfigs = ENTITY_TYPES,
	_GetEntityType = GetEntityType, --// For internal use only
	GetEntityType = GetEntityType,
	_GetEntityModel = GetEntityModel,
	_GetConfig = GetConfig,
	_Lock = Lock,
	_WaitForLock = WaitForLock,
	_GetBroadPhase = GetBroadPhase,
	_Base_Config = BASE_CONFIG, --//Modifying this after locking may not change behaviors of some config options.
	SetModelPrimaryForChrono = function(model: Model, primaryName: string)
		model:SetAttribute(CHRONO_PRIMARY, primaryName)
	end,
	SetWarningSeverity = SetWarningSeverity,
}

const Entity = {}

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
const Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
const Snapshot = require(script.Parent.Snapshots)
const InterpolationMath = require(script.Parent.InterpolationMath)
const ClientClock = require(script.Parent.Parent.Client.ClientClock)
const Holder = require(script.Parent.Holder)
const Signal = require(script.Parent.Signal)
const Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
const ModelHelper = require(script.Parent.ModelHelper)
const AlignDriver = require(script.Parent.Parent.Client.AlignDriver)
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Warn)
const HumanoidState = require(script.Parent.HumanoidState)
const CFrameLock = require(script.Parent.CFrameLock)
const ExperimentalPrediction = require(script.Parent.ExperimentalPrediction)

const clientOwned = Holder._clientOwned
const IS_SERVER = RunService:IsServer()
const LOCAL_PLAYER = if IS_SERVER then nil else Players.LocalPlayer

const CHRONO_PRIMARY = "__CHRONO_PRIMARY"
const OWNER_SMOOTH_TIME = 0.3
const INTERPOLATION_MODES = { CFRAME = true, ALIGN = true, NONE = true }
const EVENT_NAMES = {
	Destroying = true,
	NetworkOwnerChanged = true,
	PushedSnapShot = true,
	TickChanged = true,
	DataChanged = true,
	Ticked = true,
	ModelChanged = true,
	LockChanged = true,
}

type Entity = Types.Entity

local READY = false

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	READY = true
end)

const RegisterChange = Holder.RegisterChange

--// Part helpers
const function SafeDestroy(instance: Instance?)
	if instance then
		pcall(instance.Destroy, instance)
	end
end

const function GetPart(self: Types.Entity): BasePart?
	const model = self.model
	if not model then
		return nil
	end
	if model:IsA("BasePart") then
		return model
	end
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		const chronoPrimary = self._chronoPrimary
		if chronoPrimary then
			const primary = model:FindFirstChild(chronoPrimary)
			if primary and primary:IsA("BasePart") then
				return primary
			else
				Warn.low(
					`Chrono primary part {chronoPrimary} not found or not a BasePart in model {model:GetFullName()} for entity id {self.id}. Falling back to default PrimaryPart.`
				)
			end
		end
		const primaryPart = model.PrimaryPart
		if primaryPart then
			return primaryPart
		end
	end
	return nil
end

const function GetRootPart(entity: Entity): BasePart?
	const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
	if primaryPart and IS_SERVER and entity._lockedCFReplication then
		return CFrameLock.GetLockedRoot(primaryPart)
	end
	return primaryPart
end

const function SetPartCFrame(entity, cframe: CFrame)
	const part = GetRootPart(entity)
	if part then
		part.CFrame = cframe
	end
end

--anchors depending on interpolation mode,config type and ownership
const function UpdateClientAnchor(self: Entity)
	if IS_SERVER or not (self.modelReplicationMode == "CUSTOM" or self._lockedCFReplication) then
		return
	end
	const part = GetPart(self)
	if not part then
		return
	end
	const mode = self._interpolationMode or self.entityConfig.INTERPOLATION_MODE
	const anchored = not self.isContextOwner and mode ~= "ALIGN"
	if anchored and not part.Anchored then
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
	part.Anchored = anchored
end

--// Events
const function FireEvent(entity: Entity, eventName: string, ...: any)
	const events = entity._events
	if not events then
		return
	end
	const signal = events[eventName]
	if signal then
		signal:Fire(entity, ...)
	end
end

const function GetEvent(self: Entity, eventName: string): Types.Event<any>
	if not EVENT_NAMES[eventName] then
		error(`Chrono: Entity.GetEvent got unknown event "{eventName}"`, 2)
	end
	if not self._events then
		self._events = {}
	end
	const events = self._events :: { [string]: Types.Signal<any, any> }
	if not events[eventName] then
		events[eventName] = Signal.new()
	end
	return events[eventName].Event
end

--// Ownership & clock
-- If buffer is given then it will create a client clock for the entity as well.
const function SetClock(self: Entity, buffer: number | false?)
	if self._clientClock then
		self._clientClock:Destroy()
		self._clientClock = nil
	end
	if buffer == false then
		self._clockBuffer = nil
		buffer = nil
	end
	buffer = buffer or self._clockBuffer
	self._clockBuffer = buffer :: any
	const entityBuffer = buffer or self.entityConfig.BUFFER or 0
	if self.networkOwner or buffer then
		const networkOwner = self.networkOwner
		self._clientClock = ClientClock.new(
			self.entityConfig.TICK_RATE,
			`Entity id: {self.id} plr: {networkOwner and networkOwner.Name or "SERVER"}`,
			entityBuffer,
			networkOwner
		)
	end
end

const function CheckNetworkOwner(self: Entity, prev: Player?)
	self.isContextOwner = self.networkOwner == LOCAL_PLAYER
	const isSameOwner = self.networkOwner == prev
	if not isSameOwner then
		if IS_SERVER then
			self.lastClientClock = nil
		else
			self.latestTime = 0
			self.lastClientClock = 0
			self._ownerChangedAt = if self.isContextOwner or not self.registered then nil else os.clock()
			self._ownerSmoothing = nil
		end
	end
	if IS_SERVER then
		const part = GetPart(self)
		if part then
			const locked = self._lockedCFReplication

			if locked then
				CFrameLock.Unlock(part)
			end
			-- this is done to ensure the network owner is set correctly
			CFrameLock.SafeSetNetworkOwner(part, self.networkOwner)
			if locked then
				-- if it was locked again it could mess up ownership
				CFrameLock.Lock(part)
				const root = GetRootPart(self)
				if root then
					CFrameLock.SafeSetNetworkOwner(root, self.networkOwner)
					-- Anchors the player on the server,
					-- if the player was unanchored then it could cause weird issues
					-- where roblox takes back ownership and sets it to auto.
					root.Anchored = not isSameOwner
				end
			end
		end

		if self.isContextOwner and not self.entityConfig.STORE_SNAPSHOTS then
			self.snapshot = nil
		elseif not self.snapshot then
			self.snapshot = Snapshot(InterpolationMath.Hermite)
		end
	else
		if self.isContextOwner then
			AlignDriver.Clear(self)
		end
		const locked = self._lockedCFReplication

		if locked and self.isContextOwner then
			const part = GetPart(self)
			if part then
				CFrameLock.Lock(part)
				self._cfLockFailed = nil
			else
				-- delay the lock this is checked in client/sender::CheckLocker
				self._cfLockFailed = true
			end
			if self._player then
				CFrameLock.Unlock(part)
			end
		end
		UpdateClientAnchor(self)
	end

	if isSameOwner then
		return
	elseif self.snapshot and not IS_SERVER then
		self.snapshot:Clear()
	end

	if not IS_SERVER then
		SetClock(self)
	end

	FireEvent(self, "NetworkOwnerChanged", self.networkOwner, prev)

	if prev then
		const ownedEntities = clientOwned[prev]

		if ownedEntities then
			ownedEntities[self] = nil

			Events._Signals.PlayerOwnedRemoved:Fire(prev, self)
		end
	end
	if self.networkOwner then
		const ownedEntities = clientOwned[self.networkOwner]

		if not ownedEntities then
			return
		end
		ownedEntities[self] = true

		Events._Signals.PlayerOwnedAdded:Fire(self.networkOwner, self)
	end
end

const function SetEntityNetworkOwner(self: Entity, player: Player?)
	if player ~= self.networkOwner then
		ExperimentalPrediction.Reset(self)
		if IS_SERVER then
			local revision = (self.ownershipRevision or 0) + 1
			assert(revision < 4294967296, "Ownership counter exhausted")
			RegisterChange(self, "ownershipRevision", revision)
		end
		self._receivedSequence = nil
		self._sendSequence = 0
		const prev = self.networkOwner
		RegisterChange(self, "networkOwner", player)
		CheckNetworkOwner(self, prev)
		if not IS_SERVER then
			Entity.Clear(self)
		end
	end
	self.lastCheckedCFrame = nil
	UpdateClientAnchor(self)
end

--// Model
const function CheckModelReplicationMode(entity: Entity, mode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE?): "NATIVE" | "CUSTOM"
	if not mode then
		mode = entity.modelReplicationMode
	end
	if not mode then
		const config = entity.entityConfig
		mode = config.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE
	end
	mode = (mode :: any):upper()
	if mode ~= "NATIVE" and mode ~= "CUSTOM" and mode ~= "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK" then
		Warn.medium(`Invalid model replication mode {mode} for entity id {entity.id}, defaulting to NATIVE`)
		mode = "NATIVE"
	end
	entity._lockedCFReplication = false
	if mode == "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK" then
		mode = "NATIVE"
		entity._lockedCFReplication = true
	end
	return mode :: any
end

const function SetModel(
	self: Entity,
	model: Model | BasePart | string?,
	modelReplicationMode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE?,
	noDestroy: boolean?
): ()
	const wasCustom = self.modelReplicationMode == "CUSTOM"

	if IS_SERVER then
		if self.modelReplicationMode == "NATIVE" and self._lockedCFReplication then
			const part = GetPart(self)
			self._lockedCFReplication = false
			CFrameLock.Unlock(part)
		end
		if not noDestroy then
			SafeDestroy(self.model)
		end
		self.model = nil
	elseif not IS_SERVER and wasCustom then
		SafeDestroy(self.model)
		self.model = nil
	elseif not IS_SERVER and self._lockedCFReplication then
		const part = GetPart(self)
		self._lockedCFReplication = false
		CFrameLock.Unlock(part)
	end
	local modelString
	if type(model) == "string" then
		modelString = model
		model = Config._GetEntityModel(model :: string) :: any
		if model then
			model = (model :: any):Clone()
		end

		if model then
			(model :: any).Parent = workspace
		end
	end
	const _model: Model? = model :: any
	const broadPhase = Config._GetBroadPhase(modelString :: string)

	const replicationMode: "NATIVE" | "CUSTOM" = CheckModelReplicationMode(self, modelReplicationMode)
	self.modelString = modelString
	self.model = _model

	if IS_SERVER or not self.broadPhase then
		self.broadPhase = broadPhase
	end

	if _model then
		if replicationMode == "CUSTOM" then
			_model.Parent = Holder.GetEntityStorageInstance()
		end

		const chronoPrimary = _model:GetAttribute(CHRONO_PRIMARY)
		if chronoPrimary and type(chronoPrimary) == "string" then
			self._chronoPrimary = chronoPrimary
		end
	end

	self.modelReplicationMode = replicationMode

	const primaryPart = GetPart(self)
	if _model and not primaryPart then
		const warn = IS_SERVER and Warn.high or Warn.low
		warn(`{_model:GetFullName()} must have a PrimaryPart set for things like autoReplication and movement.`)
	elseif _model and not _model.Archivable then
		Warn.low(
			`{_model:GetFullName()} is not Archivable. It is recommended to set Archivable to true for entity models to prevent potential issues when cloning. Archivable has been set to true automatically.`
		)
		_model.Archivable = true
	end

	if not primaryPart then
		return
	end

	if not self.latestCFrame then
		Entity.SetCFrame(self, primaryPart.CFrame)
	end
	if self.latestCFrame then
		primaryPart.CFrame = self.latestCFrame
	end

	self.modelReplicationMode = Entity.GetModelReplicationType(self) :: any
	if self.modelReplicationMode :: any == "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK" then
		self._lockedCFReplication = true
		self.modelReplicationMode = "NATIVE"
	end
	UpdateClientAnchor(self)
end

--// Construction
function Entity._new(
	entityConfig: string?,
	model: Model | BasePart | string?,
	modelReplicationMode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE?,
	initCFrame: CFrame?
): Entity
	local config = Config._GetEntityType(entityConfig)
	if not config then
		Warn.medium(`Entity config {entityConfig} not found. Using DEFAULT config.`)
		config = Config._GetEntityType("DEFAULT")
	end

	-- If the model doesn't exist and there's no init cframe then it won't be able to find a starting cframe
	if initCFrame == nil and typeof(model) == "string" then
		const _model = Config._GetEntityModel(model :: string)
		if _model == false then
			Warn.medium(`Entity's model doesn't exist, initCFrame is required. DEFAULTING to CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)`)
			initCFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
		end
	end

	const self: Entity = {
		id = -1,

		registered = false,
		autoUpdatePosition = config.AUTO_UPDATE_POSITION ~= false,
		isContextOwner = false,
		networkOwner = nil,
		latestCFrame = initCFrame,
		paused = false,

		entityConfig = config,
		destroyed = false,

		interpolation = not IS_SERVER and true,
	}

	if LOCAL_PLAYER then
		self.snapshot = Snapshot(InterpolationMath.Hermite)
	end
	SetModel(self, model, modelReplicationMode)
	HumanoidState.Refresh(self, true)
	CheckNetworkOwner(self, nil)

	return self
end

--[=[
	Creates a new Entity instance and registers.

	@param entityConfig The entity configuration name to use. Defaults to "DEFAULT" if not provided or invalid.
	@param model The model to use for the entity. Can be a Model, BasePart, or a string representing a registered model name.
	@param modelReplicationMode The model replication mode to use. Will default of the entity config if not provided.
	@param initCFrame The initial CFrame for the entity. Optional.

	@return The newly created Entity instance.
]=]
function Entity.new(
	entityConfig: string?,
	model: Model | BasePart | string?,
	modelReplicationMode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE?,
	initCFrame: CFrame?
): Entity
	if not READY then
		error("Chrono: Entity.new cannot be called until Chrono.Start() is called", 2)
	end
	const self = Entity._new(entityConfig, model, modelReplicationMode, initCFrame)
	Holder.RegisterEntity(self)
	return self
end

--[=[
	Destroys the entity, unregistering it and cleaning up resources. Does nothing if already destroyed.
]=]
function Entity.Destroy(self: Entity, preserveModel: boolean?, preserveAnchor: boolean?)
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	ExperimentalPrediction.Reset(self)
	if IS_SERVER and preserveModel then
		self._preserveModelOnRemoval=true
		local part=GetPart(self) self._removalAnchor=if part then part.Anchored else nil
	end
	FireEvent(self, "Destroying")
	Holder.UnregisterEntity(self)
	if self._clientClock then
		self._clientClock:Destroy()
	end

	const owner = self.networkOwner
	if owner then
		const ownedEntities = clientOwned[owner]
		if ownedEntities and ownedEntities[self] then
			ownedEntities[self] = nil
			Events._Signals.PlayerOwnedRemoved:Fire(owner, self)
		end
	end

	HumanoidState.Stop(self)

	AlignDriver.Clear(self)

	if not IS_SERVER then
		const modeType = self.modelReplicationMode
		const primaryPart = GetPart(self)
		if modeType == "CUSTOM" then
			-- destroys the model on the client
			SafeDestroy(self.model)
		elseif primaryPart then
			if self._lockedCFReplication then
				CFrameLock.Unlock(primaryPart)
			end
			if preserveModel then
				if type(preserveAnchor)=="boolean" then primaryPart.Anchored=preserveAnchor end
			else
				-- Ordinary despawns retain original Chrono's hide behavior.
				primaryPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 1000000, 0)
			end
		end
	else
		if preserveModel then
			local part=GetPart(self) if part and self._lockedCFReplication then CFrameLock.Unlock(part) end
		else SafeDestroy(self.model) end
	end

	for _, signal: Types.Signal<any> in (self._events or {}) :: any do
		signal:DisconnectAll()
	end
	self.model = nil
end

--// Model API
--[=[
	Sets the model for the entity.

	@param model The model to set for the entity. Can be a Model, BasePart, or a string representing a registered model name.
	@param modelReplicationMode The model replication mode to use. Will default to the last used mode or the entity config if not provided.
	@param noDestroy If true, will not destroy the previous model. Defaults to false.
]=]
function Entity.SetModel(
	self: Entity,
	model: Model | BasePart | string?,
	modelReplicationMode: Types.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE?,
	noDestroy: boolean?
)
	const old = self.model
	SetModel(self, model, modelReplicationMode, noDestroy)
	Holder._UpdateModel(self, old)
	if IS_SERVER then
		const toReplicate = ModelHelper.ReadyModelFromRep(self, nil)
		RegisterChange(self, "model", self.model, true, toReplicate or false)
		CheckNetworkOwner(self, self.networkOwner)
	end
	HumanoidState.Refresh(self, true)
	FireEvent(self, "ModelChanged", self.model, old)
end

--[=[
	Gets the model associated with the entity.

	@return The model associated with the entity.
]=]
function Entity.GetModel(self: Entity): Model | BasePart?
	return self.model
end

--[=[
	Gets the primary part of the entity's model. If the model is a BasePart, returns the model itself.

	@return The primary part of the entity's model, or nil if no model or primary part exists.
]=]
function Entity.GetPrimaryPart(self: Entity): BasePart?
	if self.model then
		return GetPart(self)
	end
	return nil
end

--[=[
	Returns the current model replication type of the entity, which can be "NATIVE", "CUSTOM", or "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK".

]=]
function Entity.GetModelReplicationType(self: Entity): "NATIVE" | "CUSTOM" | "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK"
	local mode = self.modelReplicationMode

	if not mode then
		mode = self.entityConfig.MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE
	end
	if mode == "CUSTOM" then
		return "CUSTOM"
	end
	if self._lockedCFReplication then
		return "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK"
	end
	return "NATIVE"
end

--[=[
	Locks the native server CFrame replication for the entity.

	Only works if the entity's model replication mode is "NATIVE".

	Throws an error if called on the client or if the model replication mode is not "NATIVE".
]=]
function Entity.LockNativeServerCFrameReplication(self: Entity)
	if IS_SERVER then
		if self.modelReplicationMode ~= "NATIVE" then
			error(
				"Chrono: Entity.LockNativeServerCFrameReplication can only be called on NATIVE model replication mode entities",
				2
			)
		end
		if self._lockedCFReplication then
			return
		end
		RegisterChange(self, "_lockedCFReplication", true)

		CheckNetworkOwner(self, self.networkOwner)

		FireEvent(self, "LockChanged", true)
	else
		error("Chrono: Entity.LockNativeServerCFrameReplication can only be called on the server", 2)
	end
end

--[=[
	Unlocks the native server CFrame replication for the entity.

	Only works if the entity's model replication mode is "NATIVE".

	Throws an error if called on the client or if the model replication mode is not "NATIVE".
]=]
function Entity.UnlockNativeServerCFrameReplication(self: Entity)
	if IS_SERVER then
		if self.modelReplicationMode ~= "NATIVE" then
			error(
				"Chrono: Entity.UnlockNativeServerCFrameReplication can only be called on NATIVE model replication mode entities",
				2
			)
		end
		if not self._lockedCFReplication then
			return
		end
		RegisterChange(self, "_lockedCFReplication", false)
		const part = GetPart(self)
		CFrameLock.Unlock(part)
		CheckNetworkOwner(self, self.networkOwner)
		FireEvent(self, "LockChanged", false)
	else
		error("Chrono: Entity.UnlockNativeServerCFrameReplication can only be called on the server", 2)
	end
end

--// CFrame & snapshots
@native
const function PushSnapshot(self: Entity, time: number, value: CFrame, velocity: Vector3?, stopped: boolean?): boolean
	const snapshot = self.snapshot
	const newer = not self.latestTime or time > self.latestTime
	if newer then
		self.latestTime = time
		self.latestCFrame = value
	end
	if snapshot then
		const latest = snapshot:GetLatest()
		if not IS_SERVER and newer and latest and time - latest.t < 5 and not self.isContextOwner then
			const targetTime = Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(self)
			if math.abs(targetTime - latest.t) > 5 then
				snapshot:Clear()
				Warn.low(`Clearing Snapshot due to large time difference`)
			end
		end
		const baseTickRate = self.entityConfig.TICK_RATE
		const tickrate = if self.isHalfTicked then baseTickRate * 2 else baseTickRate
		-- for 2.2.4+ velocity calculation is done in the snapshot rather here
		snapshot:PushWithCheck(time, value, velocity, tickrate, stopped)
	end
	FireEvent(self, "PushedSnapShot", time, value, newer)
	return newer
end

--[=[
	Pushes a new CFrame value into the entity's snapshot.

	@param time The time associated with the CFrame value.
	@param value The CFrame value to push.
	@param velocity Optional velocity to push with the snapshot. If not provided, will be calculated based on the latest snapshot value.

	@return Whether the pushed value is the newest.
]=]
function Entity.Push(self: Entity, time: number, value: CFrame, velocity: Vector3?): boolean
	if type(time) ~= "number" or time ~= time then
		error(`Chrono: Entity.Push expected time to be a number, got {if time ~= time then "NaN" else typeof(time)}`, 2)
	end
	if typeof(value) ~= "CFrame" then
		error(`Chrono: Entity.Push expected value to be a CFrame, got {typeof(value)}`, 2)
	end
	local newest=PushSnapshot(self, time, value, velocity)
	if newest then ExperimentalPrediction.Observe(self,time,value,velocity,if IS_SERVER then "server-clock" else "owner-clock") end
	return newest
end

-- pushes a stopped snapshot
function Entity._PushStopped(self: Entity, time: number, value: CFrame): boolean
	return PushSnapshot(self, time, value, nil, true)
end

-- Records a replicated change for stop events
function Entity._RecordMove(self: Entity, step: Vector3, gap: number)
	if gap > 1 then
		const lastStep = self._lastStep
		const repeats = lastStep ~= nil
			and vector.magnitude((step - lastStep) :: any) < vector.magnitude(lastStep :: any) * 0.25
		self._pausedSteps = if repeats then (self._pausedSteps or 0) + 1 else 0
	end
	self._stopAfter = if (self._pausedSteps or 0) >= 2 then gap + 1 else nil
	self._lastStep = step
	self._idleTicks = 0
end

--[=[
	Gets the CFrame value at a specific time from the entity's snapshot.

	@param time The time to get the CFrame value for.

	@return The CFrame value at the specified time, or the latest CFrame if no snapshot exists.
]=]
function Entity.GetAt(self: Entity, time: number): CFrame?
	const snapshot = self.snapshot
	if snapshot then
		return snapshot:GetAt(time)
	else
		return self.latestCFrame
	end
end

function Entity._ApplyOwnerSmoothing(self: Entity, cframe: CFrame): CFrame
	const smoothing = self._ownerSmoothing
	if not smoothing then
		return cframe
	end
	const left = 1 - (os.clock() - smoothing.start) / OWNER_SMOOTH_TIME
	if left <= 0 then
		self._ownerSmoothing = nil
		return cframe
	end
	return CFrame.new(cframe.Position + smoothing.offset * left)
		* CFrame.identity:Lerp(smoothing.rotation, left)
		* cframe.Rotation
end

--[=[
	Gets the entity's client clock. First checks _clientClock then falls back to entity config

	@return The client clock, or nil if no clock is available
]=]
function Entity.GetClock(self: Entity): Types.ClientClock?
	if self._clientClock then
		return self._clientClock
	end
	const clocks = self.entityConfig.CLIENT_CLOCK
	if not clocks then
		return nil
	end
	return self.isHalfTicked and clocks.HALF or clocks.NORMAL
end

--[=[
	Gets the target render time from the entity's client clock.

	@return The target render time, or -1 if no clock is available.
]=]
function Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(self: Entity): number
	const clock = Entity.GetClock(self)
	if not clock then
		return -1
	end
	return clock:GetTargetRenderTime()
end

--[=[
	Gets the current CFrame of the entity.

	@return The current CFrame of the entity.
]=]
function Entity.GetCFrame(self: Entity): CFrame?
	const part = GetPart(self)
	return self.latestCFrame or (part and part.CFrame)
end

--[=[
	Sets the current CFrame of the entity and locks the snapshot to the new time.

	@param cframe The CFrame to set for the entity.
]=]
function Entity.SetCFrame(self: Entity, cframe: CFrame)
	if typeof(cframe) ~= "CFrame" then
		error(`Chrono: Entity.SetCFrame expected a CFrame, got {typeof(cframe)}`, 2)
	end
	ExperimentalPrediction.Reset(self)
	-- A teleport is also a new state stream. Delayed pre-teleport packets must fail
	-- the revision check even after the visual lock's timeout has expired.
	if IS_SERVER and self.registered then
		local revision=(self.ownershipRevision or 0)+1
		assert(revision<4294967296,"State revision exhausted")
		RegisterChange(self,"ownershipRevision",revision)
		self._receivedSequence=nil self._sendSequence=0 self.cframeBuffer=nil
	end
	const latestTime = (self.latestTime or 0) + 0.00002
	if Config.FLAGS.SET_CFRAME_FIX then
		if IS_SERVER or self.networkOwner then
			self._teleport = os.clock()
		end
		if not IS_SERVER and not self.isContextOwner then
			Entity.Clear(self)
		end
	end

	self._ownerChangedAt = nil
	self._ownerSmoothing = nil
	if self.snapshot and Config.FLAGS.FIX_TELEPORT_JITTER then
		self.snapshot.lockedTime = latestTime
	end
	PushSnapshot(self, latestTime, cframe)
	RegisterChange(self, "latestCFrame", cframe, true)

	if self.isContextOwner or not IS_SERVER then
		SetPartCFrame(self, cframe)
	end
end

--[=[
	Clears the entity's snapshot and latest CFrame/time.
]=]
function Entity.Clear(self: Entity)
	ExperimentalPrediction.Reset(self)
	const snapshot = self.snapshot
	self.latestTime = nil
	self.lastClientClock = nil
	if snapshot then
		snapshot:Clear()
	end
end

	Sets whether the entity should auto update its position to the model's primary part CFrame.

function Entity.SetAutoUpdatePos(self: Entity, autoUpdate: boolean)

--[=[

	@param player The player to set as the network owner. If nil, will clear the network owner.

function Entity.SetNetworkOwner(self: Entity, player: Player?)

		RegisterChange(self, "isHalfTicked", self.isHalfTicked, true)

--// Config, clock & interpolation
--[=[
	Sets the entity configuration for the entity.

	@param entityConfig The entity configuration name to set.
]=]
function Entity.SetConfig(self: Entity, entityConfig: string)
	local config = Config._GetEntityType(entityConfig)
	if not config then
		Warn.medium(`Entity config {entityConfig} not found. Using Default config.`)
		config = Config._GetEntityType("DEFAULT")
	end
	RegisterChange(self, "entityConfig", config, false, config.NAME)
	HumanoidState.Refresh(self)
	if IS_SERVER then
		if self.isContextOwner then
			if not config.STORE_SNAPSHOTS then
				self.snapshot = nil
			elseif not self.snapshot then
				self.snapshot = Snapshot(InterpolationMath.Hermite)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	UpdateClientAnchor(self)
	const clientClock = self._clientClock
	if clientClock then
		const tickRate = config.TICK_RATE
		clientClock._baseTickRate = tickRate
		clientClock:SetTickRate(if self.isHalfTicked then tickRate * 2 else tickRate)
		clientClock:UpdateBuffer(self._clockBuffer or config.BUFFER or 0)
	else
		SetClock(self)
	end
end

--[=[
	Sets the client clock buffer for the entity. 

	@param buffer? The buffer to set for the client clock. If nil, will use the entity config's buffer. 
]=]
function Entity.SetClockBuffer(self: Entity, buffer: number?)
	if IS_SERVER then
		error("Chrono: Entity.SetClockBuffer can only be called on the client", 2)
	end
	const clientClock = self._clientClock
	if clientClock and (self.networkOwner or buffer ~= nil) then
		self._clockBuffer = buffer
		clientClock:UpdateBuffer(buffer or self.entityConfig.BUFFER or 0)
		return
	end

	const sharedClocks = self.entityConfig.CLIENT_CLOCK
	const sharedClock = sharedClocks and (self.isHalfTicked and sharedClocks.HALF or sharedClocks.NORMAL)
	SetClock(self, buffer ~= nil and buffer or false)

	const newClock = self._clientClock
	if newClock and not self.networkOwner and sharedClock and sharedClock.lastClockAt then
		newClock.lastClockAt = sharedClock.lastClockAt
		newClock.lastClockDuration = sharedClock.lastClockDuration
		newClock.renderAt = sharedClock.renderAt
	end
end

--[=[
	Switches how the client applies interpolated transforms to this entity.

	@param mode "CFRAME", "ALIGN" or "NONE".
]=]
function Entity.SetInterpolationMode(self: Entity, mode: Types.INTERPOLATION_MODE)
	if mode and not INTERPOLATION_MODES[mode] then
		error(`Chrono: Entity.SetInterpolationMode expected "CFRAME", "ALIGN" or "NONE", got {mode}`, 2)
	end
	RegisterChange(self, "_interpolationMode", mode)

	if mode == "ALIGN" then
		HumanoidState.Refresh(self, true)
	else
		HumanoidState.Stop(self)
		AlignDriver.Clear(self)
	end
	UpdateClientAnchor(self)
end

--[=[
	Sets the broad phase vector for the entity.

	@param broadPhase The broad phase vector to set.
]=]
function Entity.SetBroadPhase(self: Entity, broadPhase: vector?)
	RegisterChange(self, "broadPhase", broadPhase)
end

function Entity._SetTickMode(self: Entity, isHalfTicked: boolean?)
	if self.isHalfTicked == isHalfTicked then
		return
	end
	if not self.isContextOwner then
		RegisterChange(self, "isHalfTicked", isHalfTicked)
	else
		self.isHalfTicked = isHalfTicked
	end
	FireEvent(self, "TickChanged", isHalfTicked == nil and "NONE" or if isHalfTicked then "HALF" else "NORMAL")
end

--// Mounting
--[=[
	Sets the mount of the entity.

	@param parent The parent entity to mount to. If nil, will clear the mount.
	@param offset The CFrame offset from the parent entity.
]=]
function Entity.SetMount(self: Entity, parent: Entity?, offset: CFrame?)
	if not IS_SERVER then
		error("Chrono: Entity.SetMount can only be called on the server", 2)
	end

	if parent == nil then
		return Entity.ClearMount(self)
	end

	if self == parent then
		error("Chrono: Entity.SetMount cannot mount an entity to itself", 2)
	end

	if not parent.registered then
		error("Chrono: Entity.SetMount parent entity must be registered before mounting", 2)
	end

	RegisterChange(self, "mountParentId", parent.id)
	RegisterChange(self, "mountOffset", offset)
	Events._Signals.EntityMountChanged:Fire(self, parent.id)
end

--[=[
	Clears the mount of the entity.
]=]
function Entity.ClearMount(self: Entity)
	if not IS_SERVER then
		error("Chrono: Entity.ClearMount can only be called on the server", 2)
	end
	if not self.mountParentId then
		return
	end

	RegisterChange(self, "mountParentId", nil)
	RegisterChange(self, "mountOffset", nil)
	Events._Signals.EntityMountChanged:Fire(self, nil)
end
