-- VERY EXPERIMENTAL. Estimates are separate from entity/history CFrames.
-- No predicted frame is inserted into snapshots, serialized, or trusted for hits.
local Config=require(script.Parent.Config)
local Motion=require(script.Parent.MotionPredictor)
local P={}
local states=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function enabled() return Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION") end
local function options()
	local out={}
	for key,suffix in {maxHorizon="SECONDS",maxDistance="DISTANCE",maxSpeed="SPEED",maxAcceleration="ACCELERATION",
		maxTurnRate="TURN",maxAngularSpeed="ANGULAR",maxGap="GAP",teleportDistance="TELEPORT",learningSeconds="LEARNING"} do
		out[key]=Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_"..suffix)
	end
	return out
end
local function current(entity)
	local state=states[entity]
	if state and (state.generation~=entity.generation or state.revision~=entity.ownershipRevision
		or state.owner~=entity.networkOwner or state.modelObject~=entity.model) then
		states[entity]=nil state=nil
	end
	return state
end
function P.Reset(entity) states[entity]=nil end
function P.Observe(entity,time,frame,velocity,domain,discontinuity)
	if not enabled() then return false,"experimental_disabled" end
	if type(entity)~="table" or entity.destroyed or entity.paused then return false,"inactive_entity" end
	if not Motion.IsFinite(time) or not Motion.IsFrame(frame) or (velocity~=nil and not Motion.IsVector(velocity)) then return false,"invalid_sample" end
	domain=domain or "entity-time"
	if type(domain)~="string" or #domain>64 then return false,"invalid_clock_domain" end
	local state=current(entity)
	if state and state.domain~=domain then P.Reset(entity) state=nil end
	if not state then
		state={model=Motion.New(options()),domain=domain,generation=entity.generation,
			revision=entity.ownershipRevision,owner=entity.networkOwner,modelObject=entity.model,
			accepted=0,rejected=0}
		states[entity]=state
	end
	local ok,reason=state.model:Observe(time,frame,velocity,discontinuity)
	state.lastReason=reason
	if ok then state.sourceTime=time state.receivedAt=os.clock() state.accepted+=1 else state.rejected+=1 end
	return ok,reason
end
function P.Estimate(entity,targetSourceTime)
	if not enabled() then return nil,{status="experimental_disabled",experimental=true,trust="estimate"} end
	if type(entity)~="table" or entity.destroyed or entity.paused or entity.mountParentId then return nil,{status="inactive_entity",experimental=true,trust="estimate"} end
	local state=current(entity)
	if not state then return nil,{status="empty",experimental=true,trust="estimate"} end
	local frame,info=state.model:Predict(targetSourceTime)
	info.experimental=true info.trust="estimate" info.clockDomain=state.domain
	info.sourceGrade="observed-or-game-supplied; not upgraded by prediction"
	return frame,info
end
function P.EstimateCurrent(entity,sourceDelaySeconds)
	if not enabled() then return P.Estimate(entity,0) end
	if type(entity)~="table" then return nil,{status="inactive_entity",experimental=true,trust="estimate"} end
	local state=current(entity)
	if not state or not state.sourceTime then return P.Estimate(entity,0) end
	local delay=if sourceDelaySeconds==nil then Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DELAY") else sourceDelaySeconds
	if not Motion.IsFinite(delay) or delay<0 or delay>0.5 then return nil,{status="invalid_delay",experimental=true,trust="estimate"} end
	local elapsed=math.max(0,os.clock()-state.receivedAt)
	local frame,info=P.Estimate(entity,state.sourceTime+elapsed+delay)
	info.timing="elapsed since receipt + explicit source-delay assumption"
	info.assumedSourceDelay=delay info.elapsedSinceReceipt=elapsed
	return frame,info
end
function P.Inspect(entity)
	local state=if type(entity)=="table" then current(entity) else nil
	return {experimental=true,enabled=enabled(),drawing=Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DRAW"),
		active=state~=nil,accepted=if state then state.accepted else 0,rejected=if state then state.rejected else 0,
		lastReason=if state then state.lastReason else nil,
		clockDomain=if state then state.domain else nil,sourceTime=if state then state.sourceTime else nil,
		limits=options(),assumedSourceDelay=Config._GetConfig("EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DELAY"),trust="estimate"}
end
return table.freeze(P)

const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Warn)
const Signals = require(script.Parent.Events)._Signals
const IS_SERVER = game:GetService("RunService"):IsServer()

local currentId = 0 -- First Id will start at 1
const idStack: { number } = {}
local lifetime = 0
local modelMap = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
const playerChars: { [Player]: Types.Entity } = {}
const idMap: { [number]: Types.Entity } = {}
const clientOwned: { [Player]: { [Types.Entity]: true } } = {}
const entityChangedFields = {}

const function RegisterChange(entity: Types.Entity, key: string, value: any, bypass: boolean?, specialValue: any)
	if not bypass and (entity :: any)[key] == value then
		return
	end
	(entity :: any)[key] = value
	if not IS_SERVER then
		return
	end
	if not entityChangedFields[entity] then
		entityChangedFields[entity] = {}
	end
	-- any nil with replace with false so it can be serialized and sent to the client
	entityChangedFields[entity][key] = specialValue or value or false
end

const MAX_ID = 2 ^ 16 - 1

const function GetNextId(): number
	const reusedId = table.remove(idStack)
	if reusedId then
		return reusedId
	else
		if currentId >= MAX_ID then
			error("Max ID reached, please investigate.")
		end
		currentId += 1
		return currentId
	end
end

const RandomOffset = Random.new()
const function ReleaseId(id: number)
	-- Delay the reuse of the id to avoid immediate collisions
	task.delay(RandomOffset:NextNumber(5, 10), table.insert, idStack, id)
end

--[=[
	Removes the player character mapping from an entity.

	@param entity The entity to remove the player character mapping from.
]=]
const function RemovePlayerCharacter(entity: Types.Entity)
	const player: Player? = entity._player
	entity._player = nil
	if player and playerChars[player] == entity then
		playerChars[player] = nil
		RegisterChange(entity, "_player", nil)
		Signals.PlayerCharacterUnregistered:Fire(player, entity)
	end
end

--[=[
	Sets an entity as the character entity for a player.

	@param player The player to set the character for.
	@param entity The entity to set as the character.
]=]
const function SetAsCharacter(player: Player, entity: Types.Entity)
	if not idMap[entity.id] or entity.id < 1 then
		error("Chrono: Holder.SetAsCharacter entity must be registered first", 2)
	end
	const old: Types.Entity? = playerChars[player]
	if old then
		RemovePlayerCharacter(old)
	end
	playerChars[player] = entity
	RegisterChange(entity, "_player", player)
	Signals.PlayerCharacterRegistered:Fire(player, entity)
end

--[=[
	Registers an entity in the global entity map. Already registered entities will be ignored.
	Destroyed entities cannot be registered.

	@param entity The entity to register.
]=]
const function RegisterEntity(entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity.destroyed then
		error("Chrono: Holder.RegisterEntity cannot register a destroyed entity", 2)
	end
	if idMap[entity.id] then
		Warn.medium("Entity is already registered", entity)
		return
	end
	if IS_SERVER then
		const id = GetNextId()
		if idMap[id] then
			error(`Entity Collision {id}`)
		end
		entity.id = id
		lifetime += 1
		assert(lifetime < 4294967296, "Entity lifetime counter exhausted")
		entity.generation = lifetime
		entity.ownershipRevision = entity.ownershipRevision or 0
		entity._sendSequence = entity._sendSequence or 0
		idMap[id] = entity
	else
		const id = entity.id
		if idMap[id] then
			Warn.high("Entity ID collision detected for ID:", id)
		end
		idMap[id] = entity
	end
	entity.registered = true
	if entity.model then modelMap[entity.model] = entity end

	if entity._player then
		if playerChars[entity._player] then
			Warn.medium("Player already has an entity registered", entity, "overwriting")
		end
		SetAsCharacter(entity._player, entity)
	end
	Signals.EntityAdded:Fire(entity)
end

--[=[
	Unregisters an entity from the global entity map. Non-registered entities will be ignored.

	@param entity The entity to unregister.
]=]
const function UnregisterEntity(entity: Types.Entity)
	if not idMap[entity.id] then
		return
	end
	Signals.EntityRemoved:Fire(entity)
	if entity.model and modelMap[entity.model] == entity then modelMap[entity.model] = nil end
	const playerObject = entity._player
	if playerObject then
		if playerChars[playerObject] == entity then
			RemovePlayerCharacter(entity)
		else
			Warn.medium("Entity being unregistered does not match player mapping", entity, "ignoring")
		end
	end
	const id = entity.id
	if IS_SERVER then
		idMap[id] = nil
		ReleaseId(id)
		entity.id = -1
	else
		idMap[id] = nil
	end
	entity._lastId = id
	entity.registered = false
end

--[=[
	Gets the entity associated with a given model. Warning this is an O(n) operation.

	@param model The model to look up.

	@return The entity associated with the model, or nil if none exists.
]=]
const function GetEntityFromModel(model: Model): Types.Entity?
	return modelMap[model]
end
const function UpdateModel(entity, previous)
	if previous and modelMap[previous] == entity then modelMap[previous] = nil end
	if entity.registered and entity.model then modelMap[entity.model] = entity end
end

--[=[
	Gets the entity associated with a given player.
	@param player The player to look up.
	@return The entity associated with the player, or nil if none exists.
]=]
const function GetEntityFromPlayer(player: Player): Types.Entity?
	const plrCharacter = playerChars[player]
	return plrCharacter
end

--[=[
	Gets the entity associated with a given id.

	@param id The id to look up.

	@return The entity associated with the id, or nil if none exists.
]=]
const function GetEntityFromId(id: number): Types.Entity?
	return idMap[id]
end

--[=[
	Gets or creates the instance used for storing entities in the workspace.

	@return The Camera instance used for entity storage.
]=]
const function getEntityStorageInstance(): Camera
	if workspace:FindFirstChild("Chrono_EntityStorage") then
		return workspace:FindFirstChild("Chrono_EntityStorage") :: Camera
	else
		const folder = Instance.new("Camera")
		folder.Name = "Chrono_EntityStorage"
		folder.Parent = workspace
		return folder
	end
end

return {
	idMap = idMap,
	_clientOwned = clientOwned,
	_playerChars = playerChars,
	_entityChangedFields = entityChangedFields,

	RegisterChange = RegisterChange,
	_UpdateModel = UpdateModel,
	RegisterEntity = RegisterEntity,
	UnregisterEntity = UnregisterEntity,
	GetEntityStorageInstance = getEntityStorageInstance,
	SetAsCharacter = SetAsCharacter,
	RemovePlayerCharacter = RemovePlayerCharacter,
	GetEntityFromPlayer = GetEntityFromPlayer,
	GetEntityFromId = GetEntityFromId,
	GetEntityFromModel = GetEntityFromModel,
}

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
const Holder = require(script.Parent.Holder)

const IS_SERVER = RunService:IsServer()
const RegisterChange = Holder.RegisterChange

const HUMANOID_STATES: { [number]: Enum.HumanoidStateType } = {}
for _, item in Enum.HumanoidStateType:GetEnumItems() do
	HUMANOID_STATES[item.Value] = item
end

type Entity = Types.Entity

const function GetHumanoid(self: Entity): Humanoid?
	const model = self.model
	if model and model:IsA("Model") then
		return model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid", true)
	end
	return nil
end

const function GetDisabledStateMask(humanoid: Humanoid): number
	local mask = 0
	for value, state in HUMANOID_STATES do
		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.None then
			continue
		end
		if not humanoid:GetStateEnabled(state) then
			mask = bit32.bor(mask, bit32.lshift(1, value))
		end
	end
	return mask
end

const function StopHumanoidStateWatch(self: Entity)
	const connection = self._humanoidStateConn
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		self._humanoidStateConn = nil
	end
	const enabledConnection = self._humanoidStateEnabledConn
	if enabledConnection then
		enabledConnection:Disconnect()
		self._humanoidStateEnabledConn = nil
	end

	if IS_SERVER then
		RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidState", nil)
		RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidDisabledStates", nil)
	end
end

const function StartHumanoidStateWatch(self: Entity)
	if not IS_SERVER then
		return
	end
	StopHumanoidStateWatch(self)

	const humanoid = GetHumanoid(self)
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidState", humanoid:GetState().Value, true)
	self._humanoidStateConn = humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_old, new)
		RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidState", new.Value)
	end)

	RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidDisabledStates", GetDisabledStateMask(humanoid), true)
	self._humanoidStateEnabledConn = humanoid.StateEnabledChanged:Connect(function()
		RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidDisabledStates", GetDisabledStateMask(humanoid))
	end)
end

const function RefreshHumanoidStateWatch(self: Entity, force: boolean?)
	if not IS_SERVER then
		return
	end

	const config = self.entityConfig
	const mode = self._interpolationMode or (config and config.INTERPOLATION_MODE)

	if mode ~= "ALIGN" then
		StopHumanoidStateWatch(self)
		return
	end

	if self._humanoidStateConn and not force then
		return
	end
	StartHumanoidStateWatch(self)
end

const function SetHumanoidState(self: Entity, stateValue: number?)
	RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidState", stateValue)

	if IS_SERVER or self.isContextOwner or type(stateValue) ~= "number" then
		return
	end

	const humanoid = GetHumanoid(self)
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local state = HUMANOID_STATES[stateValue]
	if not state then
		return
	end

	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
		state = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
	end

	humanoid:ChangeState(state)
end

const function SetHumanoidDisabledStates(self: Entity, mask: number?)
	RegisterChange(self, "_humanoidDisabledStates", mask)
	if IS_SERVER or self.isContextOwner or type(mask) ~= "number" then
		return
	end

	const humanoid = GetHumanoid(self)
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	for value, state in HUMANOID_STATES do
		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.None then
			continue
		end
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, bit32.band(mask, bit32.lshift(1, value)) == 0)
	end
end

return {
	Refresh = RefreshHumanoidStateWatch,
	Stop = StopHumanoidStateWatch,
	SetState = SetHumanoidState,
	SetDisabledStates = SetHumanoidDisabledStates,
}

const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
const Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

const function Hermite(p0: Vector3, p1: Vector3, v0: Vector3, v1: Vector3, t: number, dt: number): Vector3
	v0 = v0 or Vector3.zero
	v1 = v1 or Vector3.zero
	if not dt or dt == 0 then
		return p0 + (p1 - p0) * t
	end

	-- Cap tangent at 3x the segment length to reduce overshoot.
	-- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monotone_cubic_interpolation

	const maxTangent = vector.magnitude((p1 - p0) :: any) * 3
	const t0Length = vector.magnitude(v0 :: any) * dt
	if t0Length > maxTangent then
		v0 *= maxTangent / t0Length
	end
	const t1Length = vector.magnitude(v1 :: any) * dt
	if t1Length > maxTangent then
		v1 *= maxTangent / t1Length
	end

	const t2 = t * t
	const t3 = t2 * t
	const h00 = 2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1
	const h10 = t3 - 2 * t2 + t
	const h01 = -2 * t3 + 3 * t2
	const h11 = t3 - t2

	return p0 * h00 + v0 * dt * h10 + p1 * h01 + v1 * dt * h11
end

const function CalculateVelocity(lP: Vector3, lT: number, cP: Vector3, cT: number, tickrate: number?): Vector3
	local rate = tickrate or 1 / 20
	local dt = cT - lT
	if dt <= 1e-6 then
		return Vector3.zero
	elseif dt > rate * 3 and Config.FLAGS.SNAPSHOT_INTERPOLATION_FIX then
		dt = rate
	end
	if Config.FLAGS.VELOCITY_CALC_FIX then
		dt = math.max(dt, rate) -- ensures that velocity is not calculated with a dt that is too small
	end
	return (cP - lP) / dt
end

const function CheckIdle(
	latest: Types.SnapshotData<CFrame, Vector3>,
	t: number,
	position: Vector3,
	tickrate: number,
	peakSpeed: number?
): boolean
	const gap = t - latest.t
	if gap <= tickrate * 3 or not Config.FLAGS.SNAPSHOT_INTERPOLATION_FIX then
		return false
	end
	const velocity = latest.velocity
	const latestSpeed = if velocity then vector.magnitude(velocity :: any) else 0
	const moved = position - latest.value.Position
	const speed = math.max(latestSpeed, peakSpeed or 0)

	const predictedTravel = latestSpeed * gap
	if
		predictedTravel > speed * tickrate * 1.5
		and vector.magnitude((moved - velocity * gap) :: any) < predictedTravel * 0.15
	then
		return false
	end
	if speed < 1e-3 then
		return true
	end

	return vector.magnitude(moved :: any) < speed * (gap + tickrate) * 0.5
end

const function VelocityAt(
	latest: Types.SnapshotData<CFrame, Vector3>?,
	t: number,
	cframe: CFrame,
	tickrate: number?,
	peakSpeed: number?
): Vector3
	if not latest then
		return Vector3.zero
	end
	const rate = tickrate or 1 / 20
	const position = cframe.Position
	if t - latest.t > rate * 3 and not CheckIdle(latest, t, position, rate, peakSpeed) then
		return (position - latest.value.Position) / (t - latest.t)
	end
	return CalculateVelocity(latest.value.Position, latest.t, position, t, rate)
end

return {
	Hermite = Hermite,
	VelocityAt = VelocityAt,
	CheckIdle = CheckIdle,
	CalculateVelocity = CalculateVelocity,
}

const Shared = script.Parent
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Warn)
const Holder = require(Shared.Holder)
const Types = require(Shared.Types)

const function ReadyModelFromRep(
	entity: Types.Entity,
	playerSpecific: Player?
): Model | string | BasePart | InstanceHandle?
	const model = entity.model
	const modelString = entity.modelString
	const replicationMode: "NATIVE" | "CUSTOM" = (entity.modelReplicationMode or "NATIVE") :: any

	if replicationMode == "NATIVE" and model then
		return InstanceHandle.new(model)
	elseif replicationMode == "CUSTOM" then
		if modelString then
			return modelString
		end
		local ModelReplicator: Instance = Shared._CUSTOM_MODEL_REP

		-- This will replicate the model to the player as player guis is not replicated to other players
		const PlayerGui = playerSpecific and playerSpecific:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
		if PlayerGui then
			local clientModels = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("_ChronoClientModels")
			if not clientModels then
				const screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
				screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
				screenGui.Name = "_ChronoClientModels"
				screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
				clientModels = screenGui
			end
			ModelReplicator = clientModels :: Instance
		end
		if model then
			const source: Instance = model
			source.Archivable = true
			const modelClone = source:Clone()
			modelClone.Parent = ModelReplicator

			task.delay(2, function()
				modelClone:Destroy()
			end)
			return modelClone :: any
		end
	elseif modelString then
		Warn.medium(`{modelString} is not a valid model string for entity {entity.id}`)
	end
	return nil
end

const function CreateTempModel(): (Model, string)
	const model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "TempModel"

	const part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Failed To Get Model"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(3, 5, 3)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Parent = model

	model.PrimaryPart = part
	model.Parent = workspace

	return model, "CUSTOM"
end

const function CreateModelFromData(
	model: Model | string | BasePart | InstanceHandle?
): (Model | string | BasePart?, string?, InstanceHandle?)
	if not model then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end

	if type(model) == "string" then
		return model, "CUSTOM", nil
	end

	if typeof(model) == "InstanceHandle" then
		return model:Get() :: any, "NATIVE", model
	end

	if
		model.Parent == Shared._CUSTOM_MODEL_REP
		or (
			model.Parent
			and model.Parent.Name == "_ChronoClientModels"
			and model.Parent.Parent
			and model.Parent.Parent:IsA("PlayerGui")
		)
	then
		const clone = model:Clone()
		if clone then
			(clone :: any).Parent = Holder.GetEntityStorageInstance()
			return clone, "CUSTOM", nil
		end
		const tempModel, tempType = CreateTempModel()
		return tempModel, tempType, nil
	end

	return model, "NATIVE", nil
end

return {
	ReadyModelFromRep = ReadyModelFromRep,
	CreateModelFromData = CreateModelFromData,
}

-- Estimates only, on either peer. A forecast never upgrades a sample's trust.
-- Source times must describe capture time, not packet receipt time.
local Motion = {}
local Model = {}
Model.__index = Model
local HORIZONS = {0.033, 0.067, 0.1, 0.15, 0.25}
local NAMES = {"hold", "straight", "acceleration", "turn", "braking"}
local DEFAULTS = {maxHorizon=0.25,maxDistance=8,maxSpeed=120,maxAcceleration=250,
	maxTurnRate=8,maxAngularSpeed=12,maxGap=0.75,teleportDistance=8,learningSeconds=0.6}
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
local function vectorOK(v)
	return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z)
end
local function frameOK(cf)
	if typeof(cf)~="CFrame" then return false end
	for _,v in {cf:GetComponents()} do if not finite(v) then return false end end
	return true
end
local function limit(v, cap)
	local length=v.Magnitude
	return if length>cap then v*(cap/length) else v
end
local function newScores()
	local scores={}
	for i=1,#HORIZONS do scores[i]={loss={0,0,0,0,0},seen=0} end
	return scores
end
local function bin(age)
	local best=1
	for i=2,#HORIZONS do
		if math.abs(age-HORIZONS[i])<math.abs(age-HORIZONS[best]) then best=i end
	end
	return best
end
local function displacement(state, h, index, config)
	local v=state.velocity
	local d
	if index==1 then d=Vector3.zero
	elseif index==2 then d=v*h
	elseif index==3 then
		local a=state.acceleration
		local speed=v.Magnitude
		-- Measured braking must not become an invented backwards launch.
		if speed<0.1 then d=Vector3.zero else
			local along=a:Dot(v/speed)
			local stop=if along<0 then math.min(h,-speed/along) else h
			d=v*stop+a*(0.5*stop*stop)
		end
	elseif index==4 then
		local w=state.turn
		if math.abs(w)<1e-4 then d=v*h else
			local a,b=math.sin(w*h)/w,(1-math.cos(w*h))/w
			d=Vector3.new(v.X*a-v.Z*b,v.Y*h,v.X*b+v.Z*a)
		end
	else d=v*(0.08*(1-math.exp(-h/0.08))) end
	return limit(d,config.maxDistance)
end
function Motion.New(options)
	local config=table.clone(DEFAULTS)
	for key,value in options or {} do
		assert(config[key]~=nil and finite(value) and value>0,"invalid motion option: "..tostring(key))
		config[key]=value
	end
	return setmetatable({config=table.freeze(config),history={},scores=newScores(),epoch=0},Model)
end
function Model:Reset()
	table.clear(self.history) self.scores=newScores() self.epoch+=1
end
function Model:Observe(t, frame, velocity, discontinuity)
	if not finite(t) or not frameOK(frame) or (velocity~=nil and not vectorOK(velocity)) then return false,"invalid_sample" end
	local previous=self.history[#self.history]
	if previous and t<=previous.t then return false,"out_of_order" end
	local dt=if previous then t-previous.t else 0
	local reset=discontinuity==true or (previous and (dt>self.config.maxGap or
		(frame.Position-previous.frame.Position).Magnitude>math.max(self.config.teleportDistance,self.config.maxSpeed*dt*1.5)))
	velocity=velocity or (if previous and not reset then (frame.Position-previous.frame.Position)/dt else Vector3.zero)
	if velocity.Magnitude>self.config.maxSpeed then return false,"speed_limit" end
	if reset then self:Reset() previous=nil end
	local acceleration,turn,angular=Vector3.zero,0,Vector3.zero
	if previous and dt<=0.25 then
		acceleration=limit((velocity-previous.velocity)/dt,self.config.maxAcceleration)
		local p,v=previous.velocity,velocity
		if Vector3.new(p.X,0,p.Z).Magnitude>1 and Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z).Magnitude>1 then
			turn=math.clamp(math.atan2(p.X*v.Z-p.Z*v.X,p.X*v.X+p.Z*v.Z)/dt,-self.config.maxTurnRate,self.config.maxTurnRate)
		end
		-- A reversal is a new movement choice, not evidence of a continuing orbit.
		if p.Magnitude>1 and v.Magnitude>1 and p:Dot(v)/(p.Magnitude*v.Magnitude)<0.5 then
			acceleration,turn=Vector3.zero,0
		end
		if v.Magnitude<0.1 then acceleration=Vector3.zero end
		local axis,angle=previous.frame.Rotation:ToObjectSpace(frame.Rotation):ToAxisAngle()
		angular=limit(previous.frame:VectorToWorldSpace(axis)*(angle/dt),self.config.maxAngularSpeed)
	end
	-- Retrospective scoring: each old state was built with information available THEN.
	-- Never use the newly calculated acceleration to score an earlier forecast.
	if previous then
		local alpha=1-math.exp(-dt/self.config.learningSeconds)
		for b,horizon in HORIZONS do
			local old,nearest
			for i=#self.history,1,-1 do
				local s=self.history[i] local distance=math.abs(t-s.t-horizon)
				if not nearest or distance<nearest then old,nearest=s,distance end
			end
			if old and nearest<=math.max(0.025,horizon*0.4) and t-old.t>0 then
				local bucket=self.scores[b]
				for k=1,#NAMES do
					local error=(old.frame.Position+displacement(old,math.min(t-old.t,self.config.maxHorizon),k,self.config)-frame.Position).Magnitude
					bucket.loss[k]+=alpha*(math.min(error*error,400)-bucket.loss[k])
				end
				bucket.seen+=dt
			end
		end
	end
	local state={t=t,frame=frame,velocity=velocity,acceleration=acceleration,turn=turn,angular=angular}
	table.insert(self.history,state)
	while #self.history>64 or (#self.history>1 and t-self.history[1].t>0.6) do table.remove(self.history,1) end
	return true,if reset then "reset" else "accepted"
end
function Model:Predict(t)
	if not finite(t) then return nil,{status="invalid_time"} end
	local state=self.history[#self.history]
	if not state then return nil,{status="empty"} end
	local age=t-state.t
	if age<0 then return nil,{status="before_source"} end
	local h=math.min(age,self.config.maxHorizon)
	local bucket=self.scores[bin(h)]
	local best=2
	-- Prefer straight motion until evidence distinguishes another model.
	-- A small cost prevents switching because of float noise alone.
	if bucket.seen>=0.15 then
		for k=1,#NAMES do
			-- History can suggest a stop is likely, but stable current velocity is
			-- not evidence that a player has chosen to stop. Require measured braking.
			local eligible=(k~=1 or state.velocity.Magnitude<0.1)
				and (k~=5 or state.acceleration:Dot(state.velocity)<-2*state.velocity.Magnitude)
			if eligible and bucket.loss[k]+0.0025<bucket.loss[best] then best=k end
		end
	end
	local travel=displacement(state,h,best,self.config)
	local angular=state.angular local speed=angular.Magnitude
	local rotation=state.frame.Rotation
	if speed>1e-5 then rotation=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(angular/speed,speed*h)*rotation end
	local candidates={}
	for k=1,#NAMES do candidates[k]=displacement(state,h,k,self.config) end
	local spread=0
	for _,d in candidates do spread=math.max(spread,(d-travel).Magnitude) end
	return CFrame.new(state.frame.Position+travel)*rotation,{
		status=if age>h+1e-6 then "capped" else "predicted",model=NAMES[best],
		sourceTime=state.t,targetTime=t,predictedTime=state.t+h,age=age,horizon=h,
		-- A heuristic warning, NOT a confidence interval or collision volume.
		uncertainty=math.sqrt(bucket.loss[best])+spread+math.max(0,age-h)*self.config.maxSpeed,
		epoch=self.epoch,trust="estimate",
	}
end
Motion.IsFinite=finite Motion.IsVector=vectorOK Motion.IsFrame=frameOK
return table.freeze(Motion)

-- Wire v2: validate the WHOLE packet before returning any decoded state.
-- API-compatible with Chrono; wire v2 peers must use the same package.
-- Full f64 source clocks remove the five-day u32 wrap ambiguity from state packets.
local P = {Version = 2, MaxPayload = 900, Header = 5, FullBytes = 41, YawBytes = 37}
local MAGIC = 0xCF32
local TAU = 2 * math.pi
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function integer(n, lo, hi) return finite(n) and n % 1 == 0 and n >= lo and n <= hi end
local function frame(cf)
	if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
	for _, n in {cf:GetComponents()} do if not finite(n) then return false end end
	local p = cf.Position
	local x,y,z=cf.RightVector,cf.UpVector,cf.ZVector
	return math.max(math.abs(p.X), math.abs(p.Y), math.abs(p.Z)) <= 1e7
		and math.abs(x.Magnitude-1)<1e-4 and math.abs(y.Magnitude-1)<1e-4 and math.abs(z.Magnitude-1)<1e-4
		and math.abs(x:Dot(y))<1e-4 and math.abs(y:Dot(z))<1e-4 and math.abs(z:Dot(x))<1e-4 and x:Cross(y):Dot(z)>0.9999
end
function P.Record(entity, time, cf, full, half, teleport, stop)
	assert(integer(entity.id, 1, 65535) and integer(entity.generation, 1, 4294967295), "invalid entity lifetime")
	assert(integer(entity.ownershipRevision or 0, 0, 4294967295), "invalid ownership revision")
	assert(integer(entity._sendSequence, 0, 4294967295), "invalid state sequence")
	assert(finite(time) and time >= 0 and time <= 1e12 and frame(cf), "invalid position or source time")
	local b = buffer.create(if full then P.FullBytes else P.YawBytes)
	buffer.writeu16(b, 0, entity.id)
	local flags = (if full then 1 else 0) + (if half then 2 else 0) + (if teleport then 4 else 0) + (if stop then 8 else 0)
	buffer.writeu8(b, 2, flags)
	buffer.writeu32(b, 3, entity.generation)
	buffer.writeu32(b, 7, entity.ownershipRevision or 0)
	buffer.writeu32(b, 11, entity._sendSequence)
	buffer.writef64(b, 15, time)
	buffer.writef32(b, 23, cf.X) buffer.writef32(b, 27, cf.Y) buffer.writef32(b, 31, cf.Z)
	local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
	local function angle(offset, value) buffer.writeu16(b, offset, math.round((value + math.pi) / TAU * 65535)) end
	if full then angle(35, rx) angle(37, ry) angle(39, rz) else angle(35, ry) end
	return b
end
function P.WithHalf(record, half)
	local out = buffer.create(buffer.len(record)) buffer.copy(out, 0, record)
	local flags = buffer.readu8(out, 2)
	buffer.writeu8(out, 2, if half then bit32.bor(flags, 2) else bit32.band(flags, bit32.bnot(2)))
	return out
end
function P.Pack(records)
	local packets, group, bytes,seen = {}, {}, P.Header,{}
	local function flush()
		if #group == 0 then return end
		local b = buffer.create(bytes)
		buffer.writeu16(b, 0, MAGIC) buffer.writeu8(b, 2, P.Version) buffer.writeu16(b, 3, #group)
		local offset = P.Header
		for _, row in group do buffer.copy(b, offset, row) offset += buffer.len(row) end
		table.insert(packets, b) group, bytes,seen = {}, P.Header,{}
	end
	for _, row in records do
		local length = buffer.len(row)
		assert(length == P.FullBytes or length == P.YawBytes, "invalid state record size")
		local id=buffer.readu16(row,0)
		if bytes + length > P.MaxPayload or seen[id] then flush() end
		seen[id]=true
		table.insert(group, row) bytes += length
	end
	flush()
	return packets
end
function P.Decode(b)
	if typeof(b) ~= "buffer" then return nil, "packet_type" end
	local length = buffer.len(b)
	if length < P.Header or length > P.MaxPayload then return nil, "packet_size" end
	if buffer.readu16(b, 0) ~= MAGIC or buffer.readu8(b, 2) ~= P.Version then return nil, "packet_version" end
	local count = buffer.readu16(b, 3)
	if count == 0 or count > 32 then return nil, "packet_count" end
	local rows, seen, offset = {}, {}, P.Header
	for _ = 1, count do
		if length - offset < 3 then return nil, "packet_truncated" end
		local flags = buffer.readu8(b, offset + 2)
		if flags > 15 then return nil, "packet_flags" end
		local full = bit32.band(flags, 1) ~= 0
		local size = if full then P.FullBytes else P.YawBytes
		if length - offset < size then return nil, "packet_truncated" end
		local id = buffer.readu16(b, offset)
		local generation = buffer.readu32(b, offset + 3)
		if id == 0 or generation == 0 or seen[id] then return nil, "packet_entity" end
		seen[id] = true
		local time = buffer.readf64(b, offset + 15)
		local x, y, z = buffer.readf32(b, offset + 23), buffer.readf32(b, offset + 27), buffer.readf32(b, offset + 31)
		if not finite(time) or time < 0 or time > 1e12 or not finite(x) or not finite(y) or not finite(z)
			or math.max(math.abs(x), math.abs(y), math.abs(z)) > 1e7 then return nil, "packet_numeric" end
		local function angle(at) return buffer.readu16(b, offset + at) / 65535 * TAU - math.pi end
		local cf = CFrame.new(x, y, z) * (if full then CFrame.fromOrientation(angle(35), angle(37), angle(39)) else CFrame.fromOrientation(0, angle(35), 0))
		local copy = buffer.create(size) buffer.copy(copy, 0, b, offset, size)
		table.insert(rows, {id = id, generation = generation,
			ownershipRevision = buffer.readu32(b, offset + 7), sequence = buffer.readu32(b, offset + 11),
			time = time, frame = cf, full = full, half = bit32.band(flags, 2) ~= 0,
			teleport = bit32.band(flags, 4) ~= 0, stop = bit32.band(flags, 8) ~= 0, record = copy})
		offset += size
	end
	if offset ~= length then return nil, "packet_trailing_bytes" end
	return rows
end
return table.freeze(P)

-- Elapsed-time budgets do not give a low-FPS sender a different allowance.
local B = {}
function B.New(rate, burst, now)
	assert(type(rate)=="number" and rate > 0 and rate < math.huge and type(burst)=="number" and burst > 0 and burst < math.huge
		and type(now)=="number" and now==now and math.abs(now)<math.huge)
	return {rate = rate, burst = burst, credit = burst, time = now}
end
function B.Allow(b, cost, now)
	if type(cost) ~= "number" or cost ~= cost or cost < 0 or cost == math.huge then return false end
	if type(now) ~= "number" or now ~= now or math.abs(now) == math.huge or now < b.time then return false end
	b.credit = math.min(b.burst, b.credit + (now - b.time) * b.rate)
	b.time = now
	if b.credit < cost then return false end
	b.credit -= cost
	return true
end
return table.freeze(B)

const Shared = script.Parent.Parent.Shared
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Warn)
const Types = require(Shared.Types)
const Holder = require(Shared.Holder)
const Events = require(Shared.Events)

export type RuleFn = (entity: Types.Entity, viewer: Player, viewerEntityId: number?) -> boolean

export type ReplicationRule = {
	filterType: "include" | "exclude",
	filterPlayers: { Player }?,
}

const ruleById = {} :: { [number]: RuleFn }

const function GetIdFrom(input: Player | Model | number | Types.Entity): number?
	if typeof(input) == "number" then
		return input
	end

	if typeof(input) == "table" then
		return (input :: Types.Entity).id
	end

	if typeof(input) ~= "Instance" then
		return nil
	end

	if input:IsA("Player") then
		const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromPlayer(input)
		return entity and entity.id or nil
	end

	if input:IsA("Model") then
		const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromModel(input)
		return entity and entity.id or nil
	end

	return nil
end

const function CompileRule(rule: ReplicationRule): RuleFn
	const filterType = rule.filterType
	const list: { Player } = rule.filterPlayers or {}
	const set = {} :: { [Player]: true }

	for _, player in list do
		set[player] = true
	end

	if filterType == "exclude" then
		if next(set) == nil then
			return function()
				return true
			end
		end

		return function(_, viewer: Player)
			return set[viewer] ~= true
		end
	else
		if next(set) == nil then
			return function()
				return false
			end
		end

		return function(_, viewer: Player)
			return set[viewer] == true
		end
	end
end

const function SetReplicationRule(
	target: Player | Model | number | Types.Entity,
	rule: ReplicationRule | RuleFn | nil
): ()
	const id = GetIdFrom(target)
	if not id then
		Warn.low("no id", target)
		return
	end

	if rule == nil then
		ruleById[id] = nil
		return
	end

	if typeof(rule) == "function" then
		ruleById[id] = rule :: any
		return
	end

	ruleById[id] = CompileRule(rule :: ReplicationRule)
end

const function Allows(entity: Types.Entity, viewer: Player): boolean
	const fn = ruleById[entity.id]
	if not fn then
		return true
	end

	const viewerEntity = Holder.GetEntityFromPlayer(viewer)
	const viewerEntityId = viewerEntity and viewerEntity.id or nil

	return fn(entity, viewer, viewerEntityId)
end

Events.EntityRemoved:Connect(function(entity: Types.Entity)
	ruleById[entity._lastId or entity.id] = nil
end)

const function Include(players: { Player }): RuleFn
	return CompileRule({ filterType = "include", filterPlayers = players })
end

const function Exclude(players: { Player }): RuleFn
	return CompileRule({ filterType = "exclude", filterPlayers = players })
end

return {
	SetReplicationRule = SetReplicationRule,
	Allows = Allows,

	Include = Include,
	Exclude = Exclude,
}

--               Batched Yield-Safe Signal Implementation                     --
-- This is a Signal class which has effectively identical behavior to a       --
-- normal RBXScriptSignal, with the only difference being a couple extra      --
-- stack frames at the bottom of the stack trace when an error is thrown.     --
-- This implementation caches runner coroutines, so the ability to yield in   --
-- the signal handlers comes at minimal extra cost over a naive signal        --
-- implementation that either always or never spawns a thread.                --
--                                                                            --
-- API:                                                                       --
--   local Signal = require(THIS MODULE)                                      --
--   local sig = Signal.new()                                                 --
--   local connection = sig:Connect(function(arg1, arg2, ...) ... end)        --
--   sig:Fire(arg1, arg2, ...)                                                --
--   connection:Disconnect()                                                  --
--   sig:DisconnectAll()                                                      --
--   local arg1, arg2, ... = sig:Wait()                                       --
--                                                                            --

export type Signal<fx, T...> = {
	Fire: (self: any, T...) -> (),
	DisconnectAll: (self: any) -> (),
	Event: Event<fx, T...>,
}

export type Connection = {
	Disconnect: (self: any) -> (),
	Connected: boolean,
}

export type Event<fx, T...> = {
	Connect: (self: any, FN: fx) -> Connection,
	Once: (self: any, FN: fx) -> Connection,
	Wait: (self: any) -> T...,
}

-- The currently idle thread to run the next handler on
local freeRunnerThread = nil

-- Function which acquires the currently idle handler runner thread, runs the
-- function fn on it, and then releases the thread, returning it to being the
-- currently idle one.
-- If there was a currently idle runner thread already, that's okay, that old
-- one will just get thrown and eventually GCed.
const function acquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(fn, ...)
	const acquiredRunnerThread = freeRunnerThread
	freeRunnerThread = nil
	fn(...)
	-- The handler finished running, this runner thread is free again.
	freeRunnerThread = acquiredRunnerThread
end

-- Coroutine runner that we create coroutines of. The coroutine can be
-- repeatedly resumed with functions to run followed by the argument to run
-- them with.
const function runEventHandlerInFreeThread()
	-- Note: We cannot use the initial set of arguments passed to
	-- runEventHandlerInFreeThread for a call to the handler, because those
	-- arguments would stay on the stack for the duration of the thread's
	-- existence, temporarily leaking references. Without access to raw bytecode
	-- there's no way for us to clear the "..." references from the stack.
	while true do
		acquireRunnerThreadAndCallEventHandler(coroutine.yield())
	end
end

-- Connection class
const Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection.new(signal, fn, defer)
	return setmetatable({
		_type_ = "Connection",
		Connected = true,
		_signal = signal,
		_fn = fn,
		_next = false,
		_defer = defer or false,
		_binCleanup = Connection.Disconnect,
	}, Connection)
end

function Connection:Disconnect()
	self.Connected = false

	-- Unhook the node, but DON'T clear it. That way any fire calls that are
	-- currently sitting on this node will be able to iterate forwards off of
	-- it, but any subsequent fire calls will not hit it, and it will be GCed
	-- when no more fire calls are sitting on it.
	if self._signal._handlerListHead == self then
		self._signal._handlerListHead = self._next
	else
		local prev = self._signal._handlerListHead
		while prev and prev._next ~= self do
			prev = prev._next
		end
		if prev then
			prev._next = self._next
		end
	end
end

-- Make Connection strict
setmetatable(Connection, {
	__index = function(tb, key)
		error(("Attempt to get Connection::%s (not a valid member)"):format(tostring(key)), 2)
	end,
	__newindex = function(tb, key, value)
		error(("Attempt to set Connection::%s (not a valid member)"):format(tostring(key)), 2)
	end,
})

const Event = {}
Event.__index = Event

function Event.new()
	return setmetatable({
		_type_ = "Event",
		_handlerListHead = false,
	}, Event)
end

function Event:Connect(fn, defer)
	const connection = Connection.new(self, fn, defer)
	if self._handlerListHead then
		connection._next = self._handlerListHead
		self._handlerListHead = connection
	else
		self._handlerListHead = connection
	end
	return connection
end

-- Implement Signal:Wait() in terms of a temporary connection using
-- a Signal:Connect() which disconnects itself.
function Event:Wait(defer)
	const waitingCoroutine = coroutine.running()
	local cn
	cn = self:Connect(function(...)
		cn:Disconnect()
		task.spawn(waitingCoroutine, ...)
	end, defer)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

-- Implement Signal:Once() in terms of a connection which disconnects
-- itself before running the handler.
function Event:Once(fn, defer)
	local cn
	cn = self:Connect(function(...)
		if cn.Connected then
			cn:Disconnect()
		end
		fn(...)
	end, defer)
	return cn
end

-- Signal class
const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
const Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

function Signal.new(): Types.Signal<any...>
	return setmetatable({
		_type_ = "Signal",
		Event = Event.new(),
		_binCleanup = Signal.DisconnectAll,
	}, Signal)
end

-- Disconnect all handlers. Since we use a linked list it suffices to clear the
-- reference to the head handler.
function Signal:DisconnectAll()
	self.Event._handlerListHead = false
end

-- Signal:Fire(...) implemented by running the handler functions on the
-- coRunnerThread, and any time the resulting thread yielded without returning
-- to us, that means that it yielded to the Roblox scheduler and has been taken
-- over by Roblox scheduling, meaning we have to make a new coroutine runner.
function Signal:Fire(...)
	local item = self.Event._handlerListHead
	debug.profilebegin("Signal.Fire")
	while item do
		if item.Connected then
			if item._defer then
				task.defer(item._fn, ...)
			else
				if not freeRunnerThread then
					freeRunnerThread = coroutine.create(runEventHandlerInFreeThread)
					-- Get the freeRunnerThread to the first yield
					coroutine.resume(freeRunnerThread)
				end
				task.spawn(freeRunnerThread, item._fn, ...)
			end
		end
		item = item._next
	end
	debug.profileend()
end

-- Make signal strict
setmetatable(Signal, {
	__index = function(tb, key)
		error(("Attempt to get Signal::%s (not a valid member)"):format(tostring(key)), 2)
	end,
	__newindex = function(tb, key, value)
		error(("Attempt to set Signal::%s (not a valid member)"):format(tostring(key)), 2)
	end,
})

return Signal

const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

type SnapshotData<Value, Velocity> = Types.SnapshotData<Value, Velocity>

type Snapshot<Value, Velocity> = Types.Snapshot<Value, Velocity>

const Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
const InterpolationMath = require(script.Parent.InterpolationMath)
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Warn)

local MAX_LENGTH: number
const PEAK_SPEED_DECAY = 0.98

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	MAX_LENGTH = Config._GetConfig("MAX_SNAPSHOT_COUNT")
end)

const function GetBufferIndex(head: number, relativeIndex: number): number
	return (head + relativeIndex - 2) % MAX_LENGTH + 1
end

const function BinarySearchInsertionPoint<Value, Velocity>(self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>, timeStamp: number): number
	const count = self.count
	if count == 0 then
		return 1
	end

	local left = 1
	local right = count
	const cache = self.cache
	const head = self.head

	while left <= right do
		const mid = (left + right) // 2
		const bufferIndex = GetBufferIndex(head, mid)
		const midTime = cache[bufferIndex].t

		if midTime < timeStamp then
			left = mid + 1
		else
			right = mid - 1
		end
	end

	return left
end

const function ShiftElementsRight<Value, Velocity>(self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>, startPos: number, endPos: number)
	const cache = self.cache
	const head = self.head

	for i = endPos, startPos, -1 do
		const fromIndex = GetBufferIndex(head, i)
		const toIndex = GetBufferIndex(head, i + 1)
		cache[toIndex] = cache[fromIndex]
	end
end

const function GetLatest<Value, Velocity>(self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>): SnapshotData<Value, Velocity>?
	if self.count == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	const lastIndex = GetBufferIndex(self.head, self.count)
	return self.cache[lastIndex]
end

const function Push<Value, Velocity>(self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>, timeStamp: number, value: Value, velocity: Velocity)
	const newData = { t = timeStamp, value = value, velocity = velocity }

	if self.count == 0 then
		self.cache[self.head] = newData
		self.count = 1
		return
	end

	const insertionPos = BinarySearchInsertionPoint(self, timeStamp)

	if insertionPos > self.count then
		if self.count < MAX_LENGTH then
			const newIndex = GetBufferIndex(self.head, self.count + 1)
			self.cache[newIndex] = newData
			self.count += 1
		else
			const newIndex = self.head
			self.cache[newIndex] = newData
			self.head = self.head % MAX_LENGTH + 1
		end
	else
		if self.count < MAX_LENGTH then
			ShiftElementsRight(self, insertionPos, self.count)
			const insertIndex = GetBufferIndex(self.head, insertionPos)
			self.cache[insertIndex] = newData
			self.count += 1
		else
			if insertionPos == 1 then
				return
			end
			for i = 1, insertionPos - 2 do
				const fromIndex = GetBufferIndex(self.head, i + 1)
				const toIndex = GetBufferIndex(self.head, i)
				self.cache[toIndex] = self.cache[fromIndex]
			end
			const insertIndex = GetBufferIndex(self.head, insertionPos - 1)
			self.cache[insertIndex] = newData
		end
	end
end

const function PushWithCheck<Value, Velocity>(
	self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>,
	timeStamp: number,
	value: Value,
	velocity: Velocity?,
	tickrate: number,
	stopped: boolean?
)
	const latestData = GetLatest(self)
	const isNewest = not latestData or timeStamp > latestData.t
	if stopped then
		Push(self, timeStamp, value, vector.zero :: any)
		if isNewest then
			self.stoppedAt = timeStamp
		end
		return
	end

	const position = (value :: any).Position
	local teleported = false
	if latestData and isNewest and latestData.t == self.stoppedAt then
		const moved = vector.magnitude(position - (latestData.value :: any).Position)
		const gap = timeStamp - latestData.t
		const travelTime = if self.peakSpeed > 1e-3 then moved / self.peakSpeed else 0

		teleported = travelTime > tickrate * 5
		const startAt = timeStamp - (if teleported then tickrate else math.max(tickrate, travelTime))
		if startAt > latestData.t and gap > tickrate * 1.5 then
			Push(self, startAt, latestData.value, vector.zero :: any)
		end
	elseif
		latestData and InterpolationMath.CheckIdle(latestData :: any, timeStamp, position, tickrate, self.peakSpeed)
	then
		latestData.velocity = vector.zero :: any
		Push(self, timeStamp - tickrate, latestData.value, vector.zero :: any)
	end
	if isNewest then
		self.stoppedAt = nil
	end

	const pushVelocity: Velocity = velocity
		or InterpolationMath.VelocityAt(GetLatest(self) :: any, timeStamp, value :: any, tickrate, self.peakSpeed) :: any

	Push(self, timeStamp, value, pushVelocity)
	if not teleported then
		self.peakSpeed = math.max(vector.magnitude(pushVelocity :: any), self.peakSpeed * PEAK_SPEED_DECAY)
	end
end

const function GetAt<Value, Velocity>(self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>, at: number, bypassLock: boolean?): Value?
	const count = self.count
	if count == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	if count == 1 then
		const index = GetBufferIndex(self.head, 1)
		return self.cache[index].value
	end

	if at < 0 then
		const latest = GetLatest(self)
		return latest and latest.value or nil
	end

	const cache = self.cache
	const head = self.head
	const lerpFunction = self.Lerp
	const lockedTime = self.lockedTime

	if at < lockedTime and not bypassLock then
		at = lockedTime
	end

	const insertionPos = BinarySearchInsertionPoint(self, at)

	const beforePos = insertionPos - 1
	const afterPos = insertionPos

	local beforeData: SnapshotData<Value, Velocity>?
	local afterData: SnapshotData<Value, Velocity>?

	if beforePos >= 1 and beforePos <= count then
		const beforeIndex = GetBufferIndex(head, beforePos)
		beforeData = cache[beforeIndex]
	end

	if afterPos >= 1 and afterPos <= count then
		const afterIndex = GetBufferIndex(head, afterPos)
		afterData = cache[afterIndex]
	end

	if beforeData and afterData then
		const dt = afterData.t - beforeData.t
		if dt == 0 then
			return beforeData.value
		end
		const alpha = (at - beforeData.t) / dt

		const p0, p1 = (beforeData.value :: any).Position, (afterData.value :: any).Position
		const v0, v1 = beforeData.velocity, afterData.velocity

		const position = lerpFunction(p0, p1, v0, v1, alpha, dt)
		const cf = (beforeData.value :: any):Lerp(afterData.value, alpha)

		return CFrame.new(position) * cf.Rotation
	elseif beforeData then
		Warn.low("Tried to fetch a time that was ahead of snapshot storage!")
		return beforeData.value
	elseif afterData then
		Warn.low("Tried to fetch a time that was behind snapshot storage!")
		return afterData.value
	end

	return nil
end

const function Clear<Value, Velocity>(self: Snapshot<Value, Velocity>)
	self.head = 1
	self.count = 0
	self.lockedTime = 0
	self.peakSpeed = 0
	self.stoppedAt = nil
end

const function New<Value, Velocity>(
	lerpFunction: (Vector3, Vector3, Velocity, Velocity, number, number) -> Vector3
): Snapshot<Value, Velocity>
	const cache: { SnapshotData<Value, Velocity> } = table.create(MAX_LENGTH) :: any
	for i = 1, MAX_LENGTH do
		cache[i] = { t = 0, value = (nil :: any) :: Value, velocity = (nil :: any) :: Velocity }
	end

	return {
		cache = cache,
		head = 1,
		count = 0,
		lockedTime = 0,
		peakSpeed = 0,
		Lerp = lerpFunction,

		Push = Push,
		PushWithCheck = PushWithCheck,
		GetLatest = GetLatest,
		GetAt = GetAt,
		Clear = Clear,
	}
end

return New

-- A sequence is comparable only inside one object lifetime and state revision.
local Sequence=require(script.Parent.Sequence)
local G={}
function G.Check(entity,row,owner)
	if not entity or entity.destroyed then return false,"missing_entity" end
	if owner~=nil and entity.networkOwner~=owner then return false,"wrong_owner" end
	if entity.generation~=row.generation then return false,"old_lifetime" end
	if (entity.ownershipRevision or 0)~=row.ownershipRevision then return false,"old_revision" end
	if not Sequence.Newer(row.sequence,entity._receivedSequence) then return false,"old_sequence" end
	return true
end
return table.freeze(G)

	return if typeof(user) == "Instance" then user.UserId else user
end

function Stats.HasPermissionToReplicate(user: number | Player)
	return script:GetAttribute(tostring(ToUserId(user))) == true
end

function Stats.ReplicateStatsForPlayer(user: number | Player)
	if RunService:IsClient() then
		warn("Stats.ReplicateStatsForPlayer should only be called on the server.")
		return
	end
	const userId = ToUserId(user)
	Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS[userId] = true
	processID(userId, true)
end

function Stats.StopReplicatingStatsForPlayer(user: number | Player)
	if RunService:IsClient() then
		warn("Stats.StopReplicatingStatsForPlayer should only be called on the server.")
		return
	end
	const userId = ToUserId(user)
	Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS[userId] = nil
	processID(userId, false)
end

for i, v in Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS do
	processID(i, v)
end

const function updateStat(type: string, name: string, value: any)
	if name == "WARNING_SEVERITY" then
		Config.SetWarningSeverity(value)
	end
	if type == "FFLAG" then
		(Config.FLAGS :: any)[name] = value
	end
end

const StatsRemoteHeaders = {
	REPLICATE_SERVER_STATS = "REPLICATE_SERVER_STATS",
	UPDATE_STAT = "UPDATE_STAT",
	DEBUGGER_OPENED = "DEBUGGER_OPENED",
	CLIENT_STATS_ACTION = "CLIENT_STATS_ACTION",
}

function Stats.SetForced(value: boolean)
	Stats.SERVER._FORCE = value
	Stats.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE = value
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	const statsRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent", script)
	statsRemote.Name = "Stats"
	local nextReport=0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if os.clock()<nextReport then return end nextReport=os.clock()+0.25
		local should = false
		if next(Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS) then
			for i, v in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS[v.UserId] and HasDebuggerOpened[v.UserId] then
					should = true
					statsRemote:FireClient(v, StatsRemoteHeaders.REPLICATE_SERVER_STATS, Stats.SERVER)
				end
			end
		end

		Stats.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE = Stats.SERVER._FORCE or should
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		HasDebuggerOpened[player.UserId] = nil
		debugBudgets[player]=nil
	end)

	statsRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr: Player, header: string, ...)
		if type(header)~="string" or not Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS[plr.UserId] then return end
		local budget=debugBudgets[plr] if not budget then budget=RateBudget.New(8,16,os.clock()) debugBudgets[plr]=budget end
		if not RateBudget.Allow(budget,1,os.clock()) then return end
		if header == StatsRemoteHeaders.DEBUGGER_OPENED then
			const opened = ...
			if type(opened)~="boolean" then return end
			HasDebuggerOpened[plr.UserId] = opened
			return
		end

		if Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS and not Stats.REPLICATE_PERMISSIONS[plr.UserId] then
			return
		end

		if header == StatsRemoteHeaders.UPDATE_STAT then
			const type, name, value = ...
			if typeof(name)~="string" then return end
			if type=="FFLAG" then
				if Config.FLAGS[name]==nil or typeof(value)~="boolean" then return end
			elseif name=="WARNING_SEVERITY" then
				if not table.find({"NONE","LOW","MEDIUM","HIGH"},value) then return end
			else return end
			updateStat(type, name, value)
			statsRemote:FireAllClients(StatsRemoteHeaders.UPDATE_STAT, type, name, value)
		elseif header == StatsRemoteHeaders.CLIENT_STATS_ACTION then
			const actionType, id = ...
			if type(id)~="number" or id%1~=0 or id<1 or id>65535 then return end
			const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
			if not entity then
				return
			end
			if actionType == "CHANGE_NATIVE" then
				const mode = Entity.GetModelReplicationType(entity)
				if mode == "NATIVE" then
					Entity.LockNativeServerCFrameReplication(entity)
				elseif mode == "NATIVE_WITH_LOCK" then
					Entity.UnlockNativeServerCFrameReplication(entity)
				end
			elseif actionType == "TOGGLE_PAUSE" then
				if entity.paused then
					Entity.ResumeReplication(entity)
				else
					Entity.PauseReplication(entity)
				end
			elseif actionType == "CHANGE_CONFIG" then
				const configName = select(3, ...)
				if type(configName)~="string" or not Config._EntityConfigs[configName] then return end
				Entity.SetConfig(entity, configName)
			elseif actionType == "SET_INTERPOLATION_MODE" then
				const mode = select(3, ...)
				if not table.find({"CFRAME","ALIGN","NONE"},mode) then return end
				Entity.SetInterpolationMode(entity, mode)
			end
		end
	end)
else
	const statsRemote = script:WaitForChild("Stats") :: RemoteEvent

	const function handleServerEvent(header: string, ...)
		if header == StatsRemoteHeaders.REPLICATE_SERVER_STATS then
			const serverStats = ...
			if Stats.CLIENT._PAUSE then
				return
			end
			for statName, value in serverStats do
				Stats.SERVER[statName] = value
			end
		elseif header == StatsRemoteHeaders.UPDATE_STAT then
			const type, name, value = ...
			updateStat(type, name, value)
		end
	end

	statsRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(handleServerEvent)

	Stats._openedDebugger = function()
		Stats.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE = true
		statsRemote:FireServer(StatsRemoteHeaders.DEBUGGER_OPENED, true)
	end
	Stats._closedDebugger = function()
		Stats.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE = false
		statsRemote:FireServer(StatsRemoteHeaders.DEBUGGER_OPENED, false)
	end

	Stats._updateStat = function(type: string, name: string, value: any)
		statsRemote:FireServer(StatsRemoteHeaders.UPDATE_STAT, type, name, value)
	end

	Stats._fireClientStatsEvent = function(...)
		statsRemote:FireServer(StatsRemoteHeaders.CLIENT_STATS_ACTION, ...)
	end
end

return Stats

const Ticker = {}

const function popSwap(t, item, index)
	const lastIndex = #t
	if index ~= lastIndex then
		const lastItem = t[lastIndex]
		t[index] = lastItem
		lastItem._tickerIndex = index
	end
	t[lastIndex] = nil
end

const Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Warn)
type Entity = Types.Entity
type Ticker = Types.Ticker

local GlobalTick = 0

function Ticker._IncrementGlobalTick()
	GlobalTick += 1
end

function Ticker.GetGlobalTick()
	return GlobalTick
end

function Ticker.new(config: Types.EntityConfig): Ticker
	-- Tickers holds full and half tick rate so entities don't constantly swap 
	const ticker = {
		tickedHalf = false,
		tickHalfRate = config.TICK_RATE * 2,
		tickRate = config.TICK_RATE,
		lastTicked = 0,
		tickedFrame = 0,
		objects = {},
		callbacks = {},
		config = config,
		dt = 0,
		halfdt = 0,
	}
	return ticker
end

function Ticker.AddCallback(ticker: Ticker, callback: (ticker: Ticker, dt: number) -> ())
	table.insert(ticker.callbacks, callback)
end

function Ticker.RemoveCallback(ticker: Ticker, callback: (ticker: Ticker, dt: number) -> ())
	const index = table.find(ticker.callbacks, callback)
	if index then
		table.remove(ticker.callbacks, index)
	end
end

function Ticker.Add(ticker: Ticker, object: Entity)
	table.insert(ticker.objects, object)
	object._ticker = ticker
	object._tickerIndex = #ticker.objects
end

function Ticker.Remove(ticker: Ticker, object: Entity)
	const index = object._tickerIndex
	if not index then
		Warn.low("Ticker.remove called on object not in ticker", object.id)
		return
	end

	popSwap(ticker.objects :: any, object, index)

	object._ticker = nil
	object._tickerIndex = nil
end

function Ticker.move(object: Entity, newTicker: Ticker)
	const oldTicker = object._ticker
	if oldTicker then
		Ticker.Remove(oldTicker, object)
	end
	Ticker.Add(newTicker, object)
end

function Ticker.CheckUpdate(ticker: Ticker, at: number?): boolean
	const now=at or os.clock()
	const difference = now - ticker.lastTicked
	if ticker._scheduleRate~=ticker.tickRate then ticker._nextDue=ticker.lastTicked+ticker.tickRate ticker._scheduleRate=ticker.tickRate end
	if now+1e-8 >= ticker._nextDue then
		const elapsed=math.max(1,math.floor((now-ticker._nextDue+1e-8)/ticker.tickRate)+1)
		ticker._nextDue+=elapsed*ticker.tickRate
		ticker.skippedDeadlines=(ticker.skippedDeadlines or 0)+elapsed-1
		-- Only ONE capture at the real time. Never invent catch-up world states.
		ticker.lastTicked = now
		ticker.tickedFrame = GlobalTick
		ticker.tickedHalf = not ticker.tickedHalf

		if ticker.tickedHalf then
			ticker.halfdt = difference + ticker.dt
		else
			ticker.halfdt = difference
		end

		ticker.dt = difference
		if #ticker.callbacks > 0 then
			for _, callback in ticker.callbacks do
				callback(ticker, difference)
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

return Ticker

-- Conservative X/Z buckets for finite-range custom/locked replication.
-- Native models and infinite ranges retain original all-viewer behavior.
local I={} I.__index=I
function I.new(cell) assert(type(cell)=="number" and cell>0 and cell<math.huge) return setmetatable({cell=cell,all={},buckets={}},I) end
local function key(x,z) return tostring(x)..":"..tostring(z) end
function I:Rebuild(positions)
	self.all=table.clone(positions) self.buckets={}
	for holder,p in self.all do
		local address=key(math.floor(p.x/self.cell),math.floor(p.z/self.cell))
		local bucket=self.buckets[address] if not bucket then bucket={} self.buckets[address]=bucket end bucket[holder]=p
	end
end
function I:Query(center,radius)
	if radius==math.huge then return table.clone(self.all) end
	local loX,hiX=math.floor((center.x-radius)/self.cell),math.floor((center.x+radius)/self.cell)
	local loZ,hiZ=math.floor((center.z-radius)/self.cell),math.floor((center.z+radius)/self.cell)
	if (hiX-loX+1)*(hiZ-loZ+1)>4096 then return table.clone(self.all) end
	local result={}
	for x=loX,hiX do for z=loZ,hiZ do
		for holder,p in self.buckets[key(x,z)] or {} do result[holder]=p end
	end end
	return result
end
return I

-- Display estimates only. Competitive evidence never calls this module.
local V = {}
function V.SegmentHermite(p0, p1, v0, v1, alpha, dt)
	local delta = p1 - p0
	local length = delta.Magnitude
	if length < 1e-8 then return p0 end
	local direction = delta / length
	local a = math.clamp((v0 or Vector3.zero):Dot(direction) * dt / length, 0, 3)
	local b = math.clamp((v1 or Vector3.zero):Dot(direction) * dt / length, 0, 3)
	-- Ordered Bezier control points give a sufficient monotonic segment constraint.
	if a + b > 3 then local scale = 3 / (a + b) a *= scale b *= scale end
	local t2, t3 = alpha * alpha, alpha * alpha * alpha
	local u = (t3 - 2*t2 + alpha)*a + (-2*t3 + 3*t2) + (t3-t2)*b
	return p0 + delta * math.clamp(u, 0, 1)
end
function V.Sample(snapshot, time, mode, predictionSeconds, predictionDistance, predictionSpeed)
	local requestedTime=time
	-- Respect explicit teleports for EVERY display curve, including linear sampling.
	if snapshot.lockedTime and time<snapshot.lockedTime then time=snapshot.lockedTime end
	local latest = snapshot:GetLatest()
	if not latest then return nil, {status="empty", requestedTime=time} end
	local first = snapshot.cache[snapshot.head]
	if time > latest.t then
		local age = time - latest.t
		local velocity = latest.velocity or Vector3.zero
		if predictionSeconds > 0 and age <= predictionSeconds and velocity.Magnitude <= predictionSpeed then
			local travel = velocity * age
			if travel.Magnitude <= predictionDistance then
				return latest.value + travel, {status="predicted",requestedTime=time,sourceTime=latest.t,age=age}
			end
		end
		return latest.value, {status="held",requestedTime=time,sourceTime=latest.t,age=age}
	end
	if requestedTime<time then
		local frame=V.Sample(snapshot,time,mode,predictionSeconds,predictionDistance,predictionSpeed)
		return frame,{status="discontinuity",requestedTime=requestedTime,sourceTime=time}
	end
	if time < first.t then return first.value, {status="before_coverage",requestedTime=time,sourceTime=first.t} end
	if mode == "HERMITE" then return snapshot:GetAt(time), {status="interpolated",requestedTime=time} end
	local previous = first
	for index=2,snapshot.count do
		local after = snapshot.cache[(snapshot.head+index-2)%#snapshot.cache+1]
		if after.t >= time then
			local span = after.t - previous.t
			if span <= 0 then return after.value, {status="recorded",requestedTime=time,sourceTime=after.t} end
			local alpha = math.clamp((time-previous.t)/span,0,1)
			local rotation = previous.value:Lerp(after.value,alpha).Rotation
			local position = if mode=="LINEAR" then previous.value.Position:Lerp(after.value.Position,alpha)
				else V.SegmentHermite(previous.value.Position,after.value.Position,previous.velocity,after.velocity,alpha,span)
			return CFrame.new(position)*rotation,{status="interpolated",requestedTime=time,before=previous.t,after=after.t}
		end
		previous=after
	end
	return latest.value,{status="recorded",requestedTime=time,sourceTime=latest.t}
end
return table.freeze(V)

-- Exact for linear translating spheres. Other shapes use explicit bounded refinement.
local C={}
local function finite(v) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end
local function vec(v) return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z) and v.Magnitude<=2e7 end
function C.Spheres(a0,a1,ra,b0,b1,rb)
	assert(vec(a0) and vec(a1) and vec(b0) and vec(b1) and finite(ra) and finite(rb) and ra>=0 and rb>=0 and ra+rb<=1024,"Invalid sphere path")
	-- Vector3 arithmetic and :Dot round to float32. Subtracting two large
	-- quadratic terms there can move a grazing contact by several millistuds.
	-- Read components once and solve in Luau doubles, using closest approach.
	local rx,ry,rz=a0.X-b0.X,a0.Y-b0.Y,a0.Z-b0.Z
	local dx,dy,dz=(a1.X-a0.X)-(b1.X-b0.X),(a1.Y-a0.Y)-(b1.Y-b0.Y),(a1.Z-a0.Z)-(b1.Z-b0.Z)
	local radius=ra+rb
	local cc=rx*rx+ry*ry+rz*rz-radius*radius
	if cc<=0 then return 0 end
	local aa=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz if aa<1e-20 then return nil end
	local closest=-(rx*dx+ry*dy+rz*dz)/aa
	local x,y,z=rx+dx*closest,ry+dy*closest,rz+dz*closest
	local squared=(radius*radius-(x*x+y*y+z*z))/aa
	if squared<0 then return nil end
	local first=closest-math.sqrt(squared)
	return if first>=0 and first<=1 then first else nil

	for _,v in {speed,timeUncertainty,acceleration,sampleGap,codecError,radius,angleError} do assert(type(v)=="number" and v==v and v>=0 and v<math.huge) end
	return speed*timeUncertainty+acceleration*sampleGap*sampleGap/8+codecError+2*radius*math.sin(math.min(angleError,math.pi)/2)
end

	assert(finite(linearDistance) and linearDistance>=0 and finite(angularDistance) and angularDistance>=0 and finite(radius) and radius>=0
		and finite(tolerance) and tolerance>0 and finite(maximum) and maximum>=1 and maximum<=4096 and maximum%1==0)
	local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil((linearDistance+angularDistance*radius)/tolerance))
	if steps>maximum then return nil,"refinement_budget" end
	return steps

-- Read-only historical contact evidence with separate source and target times.

local function call(self,callback,...)

function W.new(options)

end
function W:Track(id,binding)
	assert(not self.inCallback,"Return from the game callback before changing tracked objects")
	assert(name(id) and not self.actors[id] and type(binding)=="table" and name(binding.kind))
	assert(binding.grade=="observed" or binding.grade=="serverValidated" or binding.grade=="serverSimulated")
	local count=0 for _ in self.actors do count+=1 end assert(count<256,"EvidenceWorld actor capacity")
	self.serial+=1
	self.actors[id]={id=id,kind=binding.kind,grade=binding.grade,lifetime=self.serial,
		history=History.new({seconds=self.seconds,maxGap=self.maxGap,capacity=binding.capacity or 128,maxSpeed=binding.maxSpeed or 4096,maxRadius=binding.maxRadius or 512})}

function W:Untrack(id) assert(not self.inCallback,"Return from the game callback before untracking") self.actors[id]=nil end
function W:Discontinuity(id,time,reason)

end
function W:Record(id,row)
	assert(not self.inCallback,"Return from the game callback before recording")
	local actor=assert(self.actors[id],"Unknown actor")

	local copy=table.clone(row) copy.grade=actor.grade

end
function W:Query(request)
	if self.inCallback then return failure("reentrant_query") end
	if type(request)~="table" or not name(request.source) then return failure("invalid_request") end
	local source=self.actors[request.source] if not source then return failure("source_missing") end
	local ok,now=call(self,self.clock) if not ok or not Guard.Number(now) then return failure("clock_fault") end
	local sourceTime,targetTime=request.sourceTime,request.targetTime
	for _,time in {sourceTime,targetTime} do
		if not Guard.Number(time) or time>now+1e-6 or now-time>self.maxRewind then return failure("time_out_of_policy") end
	end
	-- nil fields do not appear in an array constructor's iteration.
	if not Guard.Number(sourceTime) or not Guard.Number(targetTime) then return failure("invalid_time") end
	local pose,why=source.history:Sample(sourceTime,now)
	if not pose then return failure("source_"..why,source.id) end
	local shape=Shapes.Copy(request.shape)
	if not shape then return failure("invalid_shape") end
	local reach=request.maxReach or 32
	if not Guard.Number(reach) or reach<0 or reach>4096 or Shapes.Reach(shape)>reach then return failure("reach_limit") end
	local transformed,worldShape=Contract.Call(Shapes.At,shape,pose.root)
	if not transformed then return failure("invalid_shape") end
	local kinds={} local n=0
	if type(request.targets)~="table" then return failure("target_kinds_required") end
	for _,kind in request.targets do if not name(kind) then return failure("invalid_target_kind") end kinds[kind]=true n+=1 end
	if n<1 or n>32 then return failure("invalid_target_kind") end
	local limit=request.maxTargets or 1
	if not Guard.Integer(limit,1,256) then return failure("invalid_target_limit") end
	if request.rule~=nil and type(request.rule)~="function" then return failure("invalid_rule") end
	local contacts={} local blocker=1 local blocked=false
	if request.world then
		if worldShape.kind~="sweep" or type(request.world)~="function" then return failure("world_provider_or_shape") end
		local called,cover=call(self,request.world,targetTime,now,worldShape)
		if not called or type(cover)~="table" or cover.covered~=true or type(cover.blocked)~="boolean"
			or not Guard.Number(cover.fraction) or cover.fraction<0 or cover.fraction>1 then return failure("world_unknown") end
		blocked=cover.blocked blocker=if blocked then cover.fraction else 1
	end
	for id,actor in self.actors do
		if id==request.source or not kinds[actor.kind] then continue end
		local target,reason=actor.history:Sample(targetTime,now)
		if not target then return failure("target_"..reason,id) end
		if request.rule then
			local called,allowed=call(self,request.rule,pose.state,target.state,id,actor.kind)
			if not called or type(allowed)~="boolean" then return failure("rules_fault",id) end
			if not allowed then continue end
		end
		local fraction,zone
		for key,volume in target.zones do
			local hit=Shapes.Intersect(worldShape,volume)
			if hit and (hit<blocker or (not blocked and hit<=blocker)) and (fraction==nil or hit<fraction or (hit==fraction and key<zone)) then fraction,zone=hit,key end
		end
		if fraction then table.insert(contacts,table.freeze({id=id,kind=actor.kind,zone=zone,fraction=fraction,root=target.root,
			state=target.state,lifetime=actor.lifetime,generation=target.generation,time=targetTime,uncertainty=target.uncertainty})) end
	end
	table.sort(contacts,function(a,b) return if a.fraction==b.fraction then a.id<b.id else a.fraction<b.fraction end)
	while #contacts>limit do table.remove(contacts) end
	return table.freeze({ok=true,reason="covered",source=pose,sourceTime=sourceTime,targetTime=targetTime,shape=worldShape,contacts=table.freeze(contacts)})
end
return W

-- Immutable evidence; no synthetic stop samples and no endpoint fallback.

local Guard=require(Core.Guard)

local Contract=require(Core.Contract)
local H={} H.__index=H
local grades={observed=true,serverValidated=true,serverSimulated=true}
function H.new(options)
	local o=options or {}
	local seconds,capacity,gap=o.seconds or 0.6,o.capacity or 128,o.maxGap or 0.075
	assert(Guard.Number(seconds) and seconds>0 and seconds<=10 and Guard.Integer(capacity,2,4096) and Guard.Number(gap) and gap>0 and gap<=1)
	assert(Guard.Number(o.maxSpeed or 4096) and (o.maxSpeed or 4096)>=0 and (o.maxSpeed or 4096)<=4096)
	assert(Guard.Number(o.maxRadius or 512) and (o.maxRadius or 512)>0 and (o.maxRadius or 512)<=512)
	return setmetatable({rows={},head=1,count=0,capacity=capacity,seconds=seconds,maxGap=gap,generation=1,
		maxSpeed=o.maxSpeed or 4096,maxRadius=o.maxRadius or 512,boundary=-math.huge},H)
end
function H:At(index) return self.rows[(self.head+index-2)%self.capacity+1] end
function H:Latest() return if self.count>0 then self:At(self.count) else nil end
function H:Break(time,reason)
	assert(Guard.Number(time))

end
function H:Push(row)
	if type(row)~="table" or not Guard.Number(row.time) or not Guard.Number(row.receivedAt) or row.receivedAt<row.time
		or not Guard.Frame(row.root) or not grades[row.grade] then return false,"invalid_record" end
	if row.sourceId~=nil and not ((type(row.sourceId)=="string" and #row.sourceId<=128) or Guard.Number(row.sourceId)) then return false,"invalid_source_id" end
	local last=self:Latest()
	if row.time<self.boundary or (last and row.time<=last.time) then return false,"non_monotonic" end
	if last and last.generation==self.generation and (row.root.Position-last.root.Position).Magnitude>self.maxSpeed*(row.time-last.time)+1e-4 then return false,"speed_bound" end
	local state=Contract.State(row.state or {}) if not state then return false,"invalid_state" end
	if type(row.zones)~="table" then return false,"invalid_zones" end
	local zones={} local count=0
	for key,zone in row.zones or {} do
		count+=1 local copy=Shapes.Copy(zone,true)
		if type(key)~="string" or #key>64 or count>32 or not copy then return false,"invalid_zone" end
		if (copy.frame.Position-row.root.Position).Magnitude+Shapes.Radius(copy)>self.maxRadius+1e-5 then return false,"zone_out_of_bounds" end
		zones[key]=copy
	end
	if count==0 then return false,"empty_zones" end
	local uncertainty=row.uncertainty or 0
	if not Guard.Number(uncertainty) or uncertainty<0 or uncertainty>1 then return false,"invalid_uncertainty" end
	local copy=table.freeze({time=row.time,receivedAt=row.receivedAt,root=row.root,zones=table.freeze(zones),state=state,
		grade=row.grade,generation=self.generation,sourceId=row.sourceId,uncertainty=uncertainty})
	if self.count<self.capacity then self.count+=1 self.rows[(self.head+self.count-2)%self.capacity+1]=copy
	else self.rows[self.head]=copy self.head=self.head%self.capacity+1 end

function H:Sample(time,now,allowObserved)
	if not Guard.Number(time) or not Guard.Number(now) then return nil,"invalid_time" end
	if time>now+1e-6 then return nil,"future" end
	if now-time>self.seconds then return nil,"expired" end
	if self.count==0 then return nil,"empty" end
	if time<self:At(1).time then return nil,"too_old" end
	if time>self:Latest().time then return nil,"not_recorded" end
	local lo,hi=1,self.count
	while lo<=hi do local mid=(lo+hi)//2 if self:At(mid).time<time then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid-1 end end
	local after=self:At(lo)
	if after.generation~=self.generation then return nil,"generation_changed" end
	if not allowObserved and after.grade=="observed" then return nil,"unverified_source" end
	if after.time==time then return after end
	local before=self:At(lo-1)
	if before.generation~=after.generation then return nil,"discontinuity" end
	if before.grade~=after.grade or (not allowObserved and before.grade=="observed") then return nil,"trust_boundary" end
	if after.time-before.time>self.maxGap then return nil,"sample_gap" end
	if not Contract.SameState(before.state,after.state) then return nil,"state_boundary" end
	local alpha=(time-before.time)/(after.time-before.time) local zones={}
	for name,zone in before.zones do
		local nextZone=after.zones[name]
		if not nextZone or not Shapes.SameDimensions(zone,nextZone) then return nil,"geometry_boundary" end
		zones[name]=Shapes.Lerp(zone,nextZone,alpha)
	end
	for name in after.zones do if not before.zones[name] then return nil,"geometry_boundary" end end
	return table.freeze({time=time,receivedAt=math.max(before.receivedAt,after.receivedAt),root=before.root:Lerp(after.root,alpha),
		zones=table.freeze(zones),state=before.state,grade=before.grade,generation=before.generation,
		uncertainty=math.max(before.uncertainty,after.uncertainty),before=before.sourceId,after=after.sourceId})
end
return H

-- Continuous checks for the declared endpoint interpolation, not arbitrary paths.
-- Unresolved intervals return UNKNOWN, never an invented clear or damage result.
local Shapes=require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Shapes)
local Guard=require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Guard)
local Continuous=require(script.Parent.Continuous)
local M={}
local function axes(shape)
	if shape.kind=="box" then return {shape.frame.RightVector,shape.frame.UpVector,shape.frame.ZVector} end
	if shape.kind=="capsule" then return {shape.frame.UpVector} end return {}
end
local function extent(shape,axis)
	if shape.kind=="box" then local h=shape.size/2 return math.abs(axis:Dot(shape.frame.RightVector))*h.X+math.abs(axis:Dot(shape.frame.UpVector))*h.Y+math.abs(axis:Dot(shape.frame.ZVector))*h.Z end
	if shape.kind=="capsule" then return shape.radius+(shape.height/2-shape.radius)*math.abs(axis:Dot(shape.frame.UpVector)) end
	return shape.radius
end
local function separation(a,b)
	local delta=b.frame.Position-a.frame.Position local aa,bb=axes(a),axes(b) local candidates={delta}
	for _,axis in aa do table.insert(candidates,axis) end for _,axis in bb do table.insert(candidates,axis) end
	for _,u in aa do for _,v in bb do table.insert(candidates,u:Cross(v)) end end
	-- Include sphere-to-closest-box direction, often much tighter than face axes.
	for _,pair in {{a,b},{b,a}} do
		local box,other=pair[1],pair[2]
		if box.kind=="box" then
			local p=box.frame:PointToObjectSpace(other.frame.Position) local half=box.size/2
			local closest=Vector3.new(math.clamp(p.X,-half.X,half.X),math.clamp(p.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),math.clamp(p.Z,-half.Z,half.Z))
			table.insert(candidates,other.frame.Position-box.frame:PointToWorldSpace(closest))
		end
	end
	local lower=0
	for _,axis in candidates do if axis.Magnitude>1e-7 then axis=axis.Unit lower=math.max(lower,math.abs(delta:Dot(axis))-extent(a,axis)-extent(b,axis)) end end
	return lower
end
local function rotation(a,b) local _,angle=(a.frame.Rotation:Inverse()*b.frame.Rotation):ToAxisAngle() return math.abs(angle) end
function M.Between(a0,a1,b0,b1,options)
	local o=options or {}
	a0,a1,b0,b1=Shapes.Copy(a0,true),Shapes.Copy(a1,true),Shapes.Copy(b0,true),Shapes.Copy(b1,true)
	if not a0 or not a1 or not b0 or not b1 or not Shapes.SameDimensions(a0,a1) or not Shapes.SameDimensions(b0,b1) then return table.freeze({status="unknown",reason="geometry_boundary"}) end
	local budget,tolerance,fractionTolerance=o.budget or 256,o.tolerance or 0.005,o.fractionTolerance or 0.001
	assert(Guard.Integer(budget,1,4096) and Guard.Number(tolerance) and tolerance>0 and tolerance<=1 and Guard.Number(fractionTolerance) and fractionTolerance>0 and fractionTolerance<=1)
	if a0.kind=="sphere" and b0.kind=="sphere" then
		local fraction=Continuous.Spheres(a0.frame.Position,a1.frame.Position,a0.radius,b0.frame.Position,b1.frame.Position,b0.radius)
		return table.freeze({status=if fraction then "hit" else "clear",fraction=fraction,lower=fraction,upper=fraction,exact=true,evaluations=1})
	end
	local linearA=(a1.frame.Position-a0.frame.Position).Magnitude local linearB=(b1.frame.Position-b0.frame.Position).Magnitude
	local angleA,angleB=rotation(a0,a1),rotation(b0,b1) local radiusA,radiusB=Shapes.Radius(a0),Shapes.Radius(b0)
	local scale=math.max(a0.frame.Position.Magnitude,a1.frame.Position.Magnitude,b0.frame.Position.Magnitude,b1.frame.Position.Magnitude,1)
	local numericMargin=math.max(1e-5,scale*1e-6)
	if Shapes.Intersect(a0,b0) then return table.freeze({status="hit",fraction=0,lower=0,upper=0,exact=true,evaluations=1}) end
	local stack={{0,1}} local evaluations=0
	while #stack>0 do
		if evaluations>=budget then return table.freeze({status="unknown",reason="refinement_budget",evaluations=evaluations}) end
		local interval=table.remove(stack) local lo,hi=interval[1],interval[2] local mid=(lo+hi)/2 local span=hi-lo
		local a,b=Shapes.Lerp(a0,a1,mid),Shapes.Lerp(b0,b1,mid) evaluations+=1
		-- Every point can move this far from its midpoint pose over the interval.
		local travel=(linearA+linearB)*span/2+2*radiusA*math.sin(math.min(math.pi,angleA*span)/4)+2*radiusB*math.sin(math.min(math.pi,angleB*span)/4)
