		if span<=fractionTolerance or travel<=tolerance then
			for _,fraction in {lo,mid,hi} do
				if Shapes.Intersect(Shapes.Lerp(a0,a1,fraction),Shapes.Lerp(b0,b1,fraction)) then
					return table.freeze({status="hit",fraction=fraction,lower=lo,upper=hi,exact=false,evaluations=evaluations})
				end
			end
			return table.freeze({status="unknown",reason="interval_unresolved",lower=lo,upper=hi,evaluations=evaluations})
		end
		-- Left interval is visited first so any returned contact includes a bound
		-- on earliest contact. A preceding unknown interval prevents a later hit.
		table.insert(stack,{mid,hi}) table.insert(stack,{lo,mid})
	end
	return table.freeze({status="clear",exact=false,evaluations=evaluations})
end
return table.freeze(M)

-- An exception is ambiguous: never retry a possibly partially applied outcome automatically.

	assert(type(key)=="string" and #key>0 and #key<=256 and type(callback)=="function")
	assert(type(now)=="number" and now==now and type(expires)=="number" and expires>now and expires-now<=30)
	assert(math.abs(now)<math.huge and math.abs(expires)<math.huge)
	for id,row in self.rows do if now>=row.expires then self.rows[id]=nil self.count-=1 end end
	local previous=self.rows[key]
	if previous then return false,if previous.status=="applied" then "already_applied" else "outcome_ambiguous" end
	if self.count>=self.capacity then return false,"outcome_capacity" end
	local record={status="pending",expires=expires} self.rows[key]=record self.count+=1
	local thread=coroutine.create(callback) local ok,value=coroutine.resume(thread,key)
	if not ok or coroutine.status(thread)~="dead" then
		if coroutine.status(thread)~="dead" then coroutine.close(thread) end
		record.status="ambiguous" return false,"outcome_ambiguous"

		assert(type(key.zones)=="table","Pose key needs named zones")

	local grade=o.grade or "observed"
	assert(type(o.capture)=="function","Supply a capture hook for this game's positions, zones and state")
	local frequency=o.frequency or 60
	assert(Guard.Number(frequency) and frequency>=1 and frequency<=120)
	world:Track(id,{kind=o.kind or "actor",grade=grade,maxSpeed=o.maxSpeed or 4096,maxRadius=o.maxRadius or 16})
	local alive=true local revision=entity.ownershipRevision or 0
	local lastCapture=-math.huge local clock=o.clock or function() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
	local handle={id=id,lastReason="waiting",accepted=0,rejected=0}
	local connection,destroyed
	local function record()
		if not alive then return false,"closed" end
		local called,now=Contract.Call(clock)
		if not called or not Guard.Number(now) then handle.lastReason="clock_fault" return false,handle.lastReason end
		if now<lastCapture then handle.lastReason="clock_reversed" handle.rejected+=1 return false,handle.lastReason end
		if now-lastCapture<1/frequency-1e-6 then return false,"not_due" end
		lastCapture=now
		if (entity.ownershipRevision or 0)~=revision then
			revision=entity.ownershipRevision or 0 world:Discontinuity(id,now,"stream_changed")
		end
		if grade=="serverSimulated" and o.independent~=true then
			local part=chrono.Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
			if entity.networkOwner or (part and not part.Anchored and part:GetNetworkOwner()~=nil) then
				handle.lastReason="source_became_client_owned" handle.rejected+=1 return false,handle.lastReason
			end
		end
		local ok,snapshot=Contract.Call(o.capture,entity,now)
		if not ok or type(snapshot)~="table" then
			handle.lastReason="capture_fault" handle.rejected+=1 return false,handle.lastReason
		end
		local copy=table.clone(snapshot) copy.time=now copy.receivedAt=now copy.sourceId=revision
		local accepted,reason=world:Record(id,copy)
		handle.lastReason=reason or "recorded"
		if accepted then handle.accepted+=1 else handle.rejected+=1 end
		return accepted,reason
	end
	local function close()
		if not alive then return end
		alive=false if connection then connection:Disconnect() end if destroyed then destroyed:Disconnect() end
		world:Untrack(id)
	end
	handle.Capture=record handle.Disconnect=close
	destroyed=chrono.Entity.GetEvent(entity,"Destroying"):Connect(close)
	if o.manual~=true then connection=game:GetService("RunService").PostSimulation:Connect(record) end
	record()
	return handle
end
return table.freeze(S)

-- Server-owned conflict tokens for possession, rounds and move state.
-- Reserve the next revision BEFORE callbacks; a partial failure stays reserved.
local V={} V.__index=V
function V.new(initial)
	initial=initial or 0 assert(type(initial)=="number" and initial%1==0 and initial>=0 and initial<9007199254740991)
	return setmetatable({revision=initial,busy=false,ambiguous=false},V)
end
function V:Get() return self.revision end
function V:Apply(expected,callback)
	if self.busy or self.ambiguous then return false,"state_ambiguous" end
	if expected~=self.revision then return false,"state_changed" end
	assert(type(callback)=="function" and self.revision<9007199254740991)
	self.revision+=1 self.busy=true
	local thread=coroutine.create(callback) local ok,confirmed=coroutine.resume(thread,self.revision)
	local finished=coroutine.status(thread)=="dead"
	if not finished then coroutine.close(thread) end self.busy=false
	if not ok or not finished or confirmed~=true then self.ambiguous=true return false,"state_ambiguous" end
	return true,self.revision
end
-- Recovery is an explicit server reconciliation, never a client request/retry.
function V:Reconcile() assert(not self.busy and self.revision<9007199254740991) self.ambiguous=false self.revision+=1 return self.revision end
return V

-- Historical obstacle provider compatible with Core's world(time,now,shape) hook.
-- Object existence is time bounded; missing geometry is never reported clear.
local History=require(script.Parent.History)
local Guard=require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Guard)
local Shapes=require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Shapes)
local W={} W.__index=W
function W.new(options)
	local o=options or {} local seconds=o.seconds or 0.6
	assert(Guard.Number(seconds) and seconds>=0.05 and seconds<=10)
	return setmetatable({rows={},seconds=seconds,maxGap=o.maxGap or 0.075,serial=0,lastTime=-math.huge},W)
end
function W:Track(id,time,options)
	assert(type(id)=="string" and #id>0 and #id<=64 and Guard.Number(time) and not self.rows[id])
	local count=0 for _ in self.rows do count+=1 end assert(count<256,"Obstacle history capacity")
	local o=options or {} assert(o.grade=="serverSimulated" or o.grade=="serverValidated","Obstacle position needs an explicit checked server source")
	self.serial+=1 self.rows[id]={born=time,lifetime=self.serial,grade=o.grade,history=History.new({seconds=self.seconds,maxGap=self.maxGap,capacity=o.capacity or 128,maxSpeed=o.maxSpeed or 4096,maxRadius=o.maxRadius or 512})}
end
function W:Record(id,row)
	local object=assert(self.rows[id],"Unknown obstacle")
	if object.removed or type(row)~="table" or not Guard.Number(row.time) or row.time<object.born then return false,"obstacle_not_active" end
	local copy=table.clone(row) copy.grade=object.grade return object.history:Push(copy)
end
function W:Remove(id,time)
	local object=assert(self.rows[id],"Unknown obstacle") local latest=object.history:Latest()
	assert(not object.removed and Guard.Number(time) and time>=object.born and (not latest or time>=latest.time)) object.removed=time
end
function W:Discontinuity(id,time,reason) assert(self.rows[id],"Unknown obstacle").history:Break(time,reason) end
function W:Prune(now)
	assert(Guard.Number(now) and now>=self.lastTime) self.lastTime=now
	for id,object in self.rows do if object.removed and now-object.removed>self.seconds then self.rows[id]=nil end end
end
function W:Query(at,now,shape)
	if not Guard.Number(at) or not Guard.Number(now) or now<self.lastTime or at>now or now-at>self.seconds or type(shape)~="table" or shape.kind~="sweep" then return {covered=false,reason="world_time_or_shape"} end
	local copy=Shapes.Copy(shape) if not copy then return {covered=false,reason="world_shape"} end
	local fraction,id,zone=1,nil,nil
	for name,object in self.rows do
		if at<object.born or (object.removed and at>=object.removed) then continue end
		local pose,reason=object.history:Sample(at,now)
		if not pose then return table.freeze({covered=false,reason=reason,id=name}) end
		for key,volume in pose.zones do
			local hit=Shapes.Intersect(copy,volume)
			if hit and (not id or hit<fraction or (hit==fraction and name<id) or (hit==fraction and name==id and key<zone)) then fraction,id,zone=hit,name,key end
		end
	end
	return table.freeze({covered=true,blocked=id~=nil,fraction=fraction,id=id,zone=zone})
end
function W:Provider() return function(at,now,shape)return self:Query(at,now,shape)end end
return W

	local F=require(root) local settings=require(root.Settings)

	active[root]=state

		local hook=require(root.Hooks)

		table.insert(handles,binding)
	else
		local config=F.Config
		for name in config.FLAGS do if settings[name]~=nil then config.FLAGS[name]=settings[name] end end
		local values={PLAYER_REPLICATION=if settings.players then "AUTOMATIC" else "CUSTOM",
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION=settings.experimentalPrediction,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DRAW=settings.experimentalDraw,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_SECONDS=settings.experimentalSeconds,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DISTANCE=settings.experimentalDistance,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_SPEED=settings.experimentalSpeed,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_ACCELERATION=settings.experimentalAcceleration,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_TURN=settings.experimentalTurn,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_ANGULAR=settings.experimentalAngular,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_GAP=settings.experimentalGap,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_TELEPORT=settings.experimentalTeleport,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_LEARNING=settings.experimentalLearning,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_DELAY=settings.experimentalDelay,
			EXPERIMENTAL_PREDICTION_LEAD=settings.experimentalLead,
			DEFAULT_MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE=settings.modelMode,DEFAULT_INTERPOLATION_MODE=settings.interpolation,
			VISUAL_CURVE=settings.curve,MIN_BUFFER=settings.minBuffer,MAX_BUFFER=settings.maxBuffer,
			VISUAL_PREDICTION_SECONDS=settings.predictionSeconds,VISUAL_PREDICTION_DISTANCE=settings.predictionDistance,VISUAL_PREDICTION_SPEED=settings.predictionSpeed,
			MAX_SNAPSHOT_COUNT=settings.snapshots,DEFAULT_NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE=settings.normalDistance,DEFAULT_HALF_TICK_DISTANCE=settings.halfDistance,
			GRID_UPDATE_INTERVAL=settings.gridInterval,GRID_MAX_UPDATE_TIME=settings.gridBudget/1000,
			MAX_TOTAL_BYTES_PER_FRAME_PER_PLAYER=settings.byteRate,WARNING_SEVERITY=settings.warning,
			REPLICATE_DEATHS=settings.deaths,REPLICATE_CFRAME_SETTERS=settings.setters}
		for key,value in values do config.SetConfig(key,value) end
		config.RegisterEntityType("PLAYER",{TICK_RATE=1/settings.sendHz,BUFFER=0,HALF_TICK_DISTANCE=math.huge,
			MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE=settings.modelMode,FULL_ROTATION=settings.fullRotation,ASSEMBLY_ROOT_PART_CHECK=true})
		config.RegisterEntityType("EXTRA",{TICK_RATE=1/settings.sendHz,BUFFER=0,FULL_ROTATION=settings.fullRotation,
			MODEL_REPLICATION_MODE=settings.modelMode,STORE_SNAPSHOTS=true})
		local hooks=require(root.Hooks)
		if hooks.Configure then hooks.Configure(F,settings) end
		F.Start()
		if run:IsServer() then
			local function add(object)
				if stopped or entities[object] or not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not (object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
				if F.Holder.GetEntityFromModel(object) then return end
				if object:IsA("Model") and not object.PrimaryPart then warn("ChronoFork: set PrimaryPart for "..object:GetFullName()) return end
				if object:IsA("BasePart") and object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") then
					local model=object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
					if model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then warn("ChronoFork: tag/select the whole character model, not a limb") return end
				end
				origins[object]=object.Parent
				local e=F.Entity.new("EXTRA",object,settings.modelMode) entities[object]=e
				if hooks.Connected then hooks.Connected(F,e,object) end
			end
			local function remove(object)
				local e=entities[object] if not e then return end entities[object]=nil
				-- Leave game-created models intact when the tag/link is removed.
				if hooks.Disconnected then hooks.Disconnected(F,e,object) end
				F.Entity.Destroy(e,true)
				local previous=origins[object] origins[object]=nil
				if settings.modelMode=="CUSTOM" and object.Parent and previous and previous:IsDescendantOf(game) then object.Parent=previous end
			end
			if settings.extraSource=="Tag" then
				local tags=game:GetService("CollectionService")
				connect(tags:GetInstanceAddedSignal(settings.tag),add) connect(tags:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(settings.tag),remove)
				for _,o in tags:GetTagged(settings.tag) do add(o) end
			elseif settings.extraSource=="Selection" then
				for _,ref in root.References:GetChildren() do if ref:IsA("ObjectValue") and ref.Value then add(ref.Value) end end
			end
			if settings.debugger then
				local allowed={} for id in settings.adminIds:gmatch("[^,%s]+") do allowed[tonumber(id)]=true end
				local function grant(player) if run:IsStudio() or allowed[player.UserId] then F.Stats.ReplicateStatsForPlayer(player) end end
				connect(game.Players.PlayerAdded,grant) for _,p in game.Players:GetPlayers() do grant(p) end
			end
		elseif settings.debugger then
			table.insert(handles,require(root.DebugUI).Mount(F,root))
		end
	end
	function state.Disconnect()
		if stopped then return end stopped=true
		for _,c in handles do c:Disconnect() end
		-- The original replication loop is started once for this Play session.
		-- Full uninstall/configuration changes require Stop, then Edit-time Undo.
		active[root]=nil
	end
	root:SetAttribute(if run:IsServer() then "ChronoForkServerStarted" else "ChronoForkClientStarted",true)
	return state
end
return B

-- A replicated parent can arrive before its descendants. Wait for explicit paths,
-- not a descendant count that unrelated dynamically created objects could satisfy.
local A={}
function A.Ready(root,timeout)
	local deadline=os.clock()+(timeout or 30)
	local descriptor=root:WaitForChild("ReadyPaths",timeout or 30)
	assert(descriptor and descriptor:IsA("StringValue"),"ChronoFork package is incomplete: ReadyPaths is missing")
	while #descriptor.Value==0 do assert(os.clock()<deadline,"ChronoFork path list did not arrive") task.wait() end
	local paths=game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(descriptor.Value)
	assert(type(paths)=="table" and #paths>0 and #paths<=4096,"Invalid ChronoFork package path list")
	for _,path in paths do
		assert(type(path)=="string" and #path<=512,"Invalid package path")
		local object=root
		for segment in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
			local child=object:FindFirstChild(segment)
			while not child do
				assert(os.clock()<deadline,"ChronoFork package is incomplete: "..path)
				task.wait() child=object:FindFirstChild(segment)
			end
			object=child
		end
	end
	return true
end
return table.freeze(A)

-- Seeded synthetic source-time replay, not a claim about native multiplayer fairness.
local Suite={}
function Suite.Run(Motion,seed)
	local report={seed=seed or 20261028,assertions=0,profiles=0,samples=0,failures={},byMotion={},byDelay={},profilesDetail={}}
	local function check(v,why) report.assertions+=1 assert(v,why or "prediction check failed") end
	local function case(name,fn) local ok,why=pcall(fn) if not ok then table.insert(report.failures,{name=name,error=tostring(why)}) end end
	case("straight and rotation",function()
		local m=Motion.New()
		for i=0,10 do check(m:Observe(i/30,CFrame.new(i*16/30,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,i/30,0),Vector3.new(16,0,0))) end
		local f,info=m:Predict(10/30+0.2)
		check((f.Position-Vector3.new((10/30+0.2)*16,0,0)).Magnitude<1e-4,"straight exact")
		check(info.trust=="estimate")
		local _,angle=(f.Rotation:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.Angles(0,10/30+0.2,0))):ToAxisAngle()
		check(math.abs(angle)<1e-4,"angular extrapolation")
	end)
	case("invalid, reorder, cap, teleport and idle",function()
		local m=Motion.New() check(not m:Observe(0/0,CFrame.identity))
		check(m:Observe(1,CFrame.identity,Vector3.zero)) check(not m:Observe(1,CFrame.identity,Vector3.zero))
		check(not m:Observe(2,CFrame.identity,Vector3.new(math.huge,0,0)))
		check(m:Observe(1.1,CFrame.new(100,0,0),Vector3.zero))
		local f,info=m:Predict(2) check(f.Position.X==100 and info.status=="capped" and info.epoch>0)
		check(m:Predict(1)==nil) check(m:Predict(0/0)==nil)
		check(m:Observe(2.1,CFrame.new(200,0,0)))
		local reset=m:Predict(2.2) check(reset.Position.X==200,"teleport without velocity must reset")
		local epoch=m.epoch check(not m:Observe(9,CFrame.identity,Vector3.new(math.huge,0,0))) check(m.epoch==epoch,"invalid sample must not mutate")
		m:Reset() check(m:Predict(2)==nil)
	end)
	case("bounded forecasts",function()
		local r=Random.new(1234)
		for i=1,1000 do
			local m=Motion.New() local v=Vector3.new(r:NextNumber(-90,90),0,r:NextNumber(-50,50))
			m:Observe(0,CFrame.identity,v) m:Observe(0.03,CFrame.new(v*0.03),v)
			local f,info=m:Predict(r:NextNumber(0.03,2))
			check((f.Position-v*0.03).Magnitude<=8.0001,"distance cap") check(info.horizon<=0.25)
		end
	end)
	local function p(x,y,z,vx,vy,vz) return Vector3.new(x,y,z),Vector3.new(vx,vy,vz) end
	local motions={
		idle=function(t) return p(0,0,0,0,0,0) end,
		walk=function(t) return p(16*t,0,0,16,0,0) end,
		sprint=function(t) return p(80*t,0,0,80,0,0) end,
		acceleration=function(t) if t<3 then return p(2*t*t,0,0,4*t,0,0) else return p(18+12*(t-3),0,0,12,0,0) end end,
		brake=function(t) if t<2 then return p(16*t,0,0,16,0,0) elseif t<4 then local u=t-2 return p(32+16*u-4*u*u,0,0,16-8*u,0,0) else return p(48,0,0,0,0,0) end end,
		circle=function(t) return p(8*math.sin(2*t),0,8*(1-math.cos(2*t)),16*math.cos(2*t),0,16*math.sin(2*t)) end,
		stopgo=function(t) local n=math.floor(t/0.6) local u=t-n*0.6 local moving=n%2==0 return p(math.ceil(n/2)*9.6+(if moving then u*16 else 0),0,0,if moving then 16 else 0,0,0) end,
		reversal=function(t) local n=math.floor(t/0.8) local u=t-n*0.8 local s=if n%2==0 then 1 else -1 return p((if s==1 then 0 else 12.8)+s*16*u,0,0,s*16,0,0) end,
		zigzag=function(t) local n=math.floor(t/0.7) local u=t-n*0.7 local s=if n%2==0 then 1 else -1 return p(12*t,0,(if s==1 then 0 else 8.4)+s*12*u,12,0,s*12) end,
		jump=function(t) local u=t%1 return p(16*t,12*u*(1-u),0,16,12*(1-2*u),0) end,
		wall=function(t) return p(math.min(24,16*t),0,0,if t<1.5 then 16 else 0,0,0) end,
		dash=function(t) local n=math.floor(t) local u=t-n return p(n*24.8+(if u<0.2 then 60*u else 12+16*(u-0.2)),0,0,if u<0.2 then 60 else 16,0,0) end,
		teleport=function(t) return p(16*t+(if t>=3 then 60 else 0),0,0,16,0,0) end,
		microjitter=function(t) return p(16*t+0.05*math.sin(40*t),0,0,16+2*math.cos(40*t),0,0) end,
		platform=function(t) return p(6*math.sin(2*t),2*math.sin(t),8*t,12*math.cos(2*t),2*math.cos(t),8) end,
	}
	local names={} for name in motions do table.insert(names,name) end table.sort(names)
	-- Irregular, seed-dependent player decisions. These are NOT forecast inputs;
	-- predictors receive only packets that have arrived at the evaluation time.
	local random=Random.new(report.seed)
	for _,kind in {"randomCuts","randomSpeeds","randomCurves"} do
		local trace={} local position=Vector3.zero local velocity=Vector3.new(16,0,0)
		local change,heading,speed=0,0,16
		for step=0,1441 do
			local t=step/240
			if t>=change then
				change=t+random:NextNumber(0.18,0.9) heading=random:NextNumber(-math.pi,math.pi)
				speed=if kind=="randomSpeeds" then random:NextNumber(0,65) else 16
			end
			local target=Vector3.new(math.cos(heading)*speed,0,math.sin(heading)*speed)
			velocity=if kind=="randomCurves" then velocity:Lerp(target,1-math.exp(-1/240/0.15)) else target
			table.insert(trace,{position=position,velocity=velocity}) position+=velocity/240
		end
		motions[kind]=function(t)
			local i=math.min(#trace-1,math.floor(t*240)+1) local alpha=t*240-(i-1)
			return trace[i].position:Lerp(trace[i+1].position,alpha),trace[i].velocity
		end
		table.insert(names,kind)
	end
	local keys={"nativeHold","old100ms","straight250ms","adaptive"}
	local all={} for _,key in keys do all[key]={sum=0,square=0,max=0,errors={}} end
	local function aggregate(container,key,errors)
		local row=container[key] or {count=0,sums={}} container[key]=row
		row.count+=1 for k,e in errors do row.sums[k]=(row.sums[k] or 0)+e end
	end
	for _,name in names do for _,delay in {0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.35} do for _,jitter in {0,0.05} do for _,loss in {0,0.1,0.3} do for _,hz in {15,30} do
		report.profiles+=1
		local r=Random.new(report.seed+report.profiles*997)
		local model=Motion.New() local packets={} local source=motions[name]
		for i=0,6*hz do
			local t=i/hz local position,velocity=source(t)
			if r:NextNumber()>=loss and not (loss==0.3 and t>2 and t<2.2) then
				table.insert(packets,{t=t,arrival=t+math.max(0,delay+r:NextNumber(-jitter,jitter)),frame=CFrame.new(position),velocity=velocity})
			end
		end
		table.sort(packets,function(a,b) return a.arrival<b.arrival end)
		local cursor,last=1,nil local totals={} for _,k in keys do totals[k]=0 end local count=0
		for step=0,360 do
			local t=step/60
			while cursor<=#packets and packets[cursor].arrival<=t do
				local s=packets[cursor]
				local ok=model:Observe(s.t,s.frame,s.velocity)
				if ok then last=s end cursor+=1
			end
			if last and t>=0.75 then
				local truth=source(t) local age=t-last.t
				local old=last.velocity*math.min(0.1,age) if old.Magnitude>3 then old=Vector3.zero end
				local straight=last.velocity*math.min(0.25,age) if straight.Magnitude>8 then straight=straight.Unit*8 end
				local prediction,info=model:Predict(t)
				local positions={nativeHold=last.frame.Position,old100ms=last.frame.Position+old,straight250ms=last.frame.Position+straight,adaptive=prediction.Position}
				local errors={}
				for _,key in keys do
					local e=(positions[key]-truth).Magnitude local a=all[key]
					a.sum+=e a.square+=e*e a.max=math.max(a.max,e) table.insert(a.errors,e)
					errors[key]=e totals[key]+=e
				end
				aggregate(report.byMotion,name,errors) aggregate(report.byDelay,tostring(delay),errors)
				report.samples+=1 count+=1
				check(info.trust=="estimate" and info.horizon<=0.25,"bounded trust")
			end
		end
		for k,v in totals do totals[k]=v/math.max(1,count) end
		table.insert(report.profilesDetail,{motion=name,delay=delay,jitter=jitter,loss=loss,hz=hz,mean=totals,count=count})
		if report.profiles%3==0 then task.wait() end
	end end end end end
	local function finish(groups)
		for _,row in groups do row.mean={} for k,v in row.sums do row.mean[k]=v/row.count end row.sums=nil end
	end
	finish(report.byMotion) finish(report.byDelay)
	report.summary={}
	for key,a in all do
		table.sort(a.errors)
		report.summary[key]={mean=a.sum/report.samples,rmse=math.sqrt(a.square/report.samples),p95=a.errors[math.ceil(#a.errors*0.95)],max=a.max}
	end
	report.ok=#report.failures==0
	return report
end
return Suite

local root=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ChronoForkSmoke")
local F=require(root) F.Start(root:WaitForChild("Settings",30))
if F.Experimental then require(root.DebugUI).Mount(F,root) end
local reports={}
local shared=if root:FindFirstChild("Replication") then root.Replication.Shared else root.Shared
local payloadBytes,packetCount,startedAt=0,0,os.clock()
local function count(_,data) if typeof(data)=="buffer" then payloadBytes+=buffer.len(data) packetCount+=1 end end
shared.Remotes.Replicate.OnClientEvent:Connect(count) shared.Remotes.SafeReplicate.OnClientEvent:Connect(count)
local function fail(message) script:SetAttribute("Error",message) end
local function inspect()
	for _,name in {"Native","Locked","Custom","Data","Mounted","Owned"} do
		local id=root:GetAttribute(name.."Id")
		local e=id and F.Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
		if e then
			local r=reports[name] or {samples=0,modes={}}
			r.samples+=1 r.generation=e.generation r.revision=e.ownershipRevision r.owner=if e.networkOwner then e.networkOwner.UserId else 0
			r.modes[F.Entity.GetModelReplicationType(e)]=true
			r.position=if e.latestCFrame then {e.latestCFrame.X,e.latestCFrame.Y,e.latestCFrame.Z} else nil
			r.render=if e.renderInfo then e.renderInfo.status else "local"
			if e.renderInfo and e.renderInfo.experimental then
				r.experimentalSamples=(r.experimentalSamples or 0)+1
				if e.renderInfo.trust=="estimate" then r.predictedSamples=(r.predictedSamples or 0)+1 end
			end
			r.model=e.model~=nil r.data=e._data r.mounted=e.mountParentId~=nil
			reports[name]=r
			if name=="Owned" and e.isContextOwner and e.model then
				local part=F.Entity.GetPrimaryPart(e) if part then part.CFrame=CFrame.new(12+math.sin(os.clock()*3)*3,18,0) end
			end
		end
	end
	script:SetAttribute("Reports",game.HttpService:JSONEncode(reports))
	script:SetAttribute("Started",if F.IsStarted then F.IsStarted() else true)
end
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if script:GetAttribute("Complete") then return end
	local ok,why=pcall(inspect) if not ok then fail(tostring(why)) end
	if root:GetAttribute("Complete") then script:SetAttribute("Complete",true) script:SetAttribute("Metrics",game.HttpService:JSONEncode({seconds=os.clock()-startedAt,statePayloadBytes=payloadBytes,statePackets=packetCount,scope="received state buffers; excludes reliable lifecycle, Roblox physics and headers"})) end
end)
script:SetAttribute("Ready",true)

-- Synthetic delivery schedules. This is NOT a Roblox network simulator result.
local T={}
function T.Run(fixture)
	local shared=fixture.ChronoFork.Replication.Shared local P=require(shared.Protocol) local Gate=require(shared.StateGate)
	local random=Random.new(2026102702) local packets={}
	for i=1,100 do
		local generation=if i>=70 then 2 else 1 local revision=if i>=40 and i<70 then 1 else 0
		local sequence=if i>=70 then i-69 elseif i>=40 then i-39 else i
		local e={id=1,generation=generation,ownershipRevision=revision,_sendSequence=sequence}
		packets[i]=P.Pack({P.Record(e,i/20,CFrame.new(i,0,0),true)})[1]
	end
	local report={scope="synthetic packet delivery and lifecycle replay; not live latency or hit fairness",seed=2026102702,scenarios=0,assertions=0,accepted=0,refused=0,failures={},profiles={}}
	for _,rtt in {0,0.02,0.05,0.1,0.16,0.25,0.4,0.8,1.6} do
	for _,asymmetry in {0.1,0.5,0.9} do
	for _,jitter in {0,0.01,0.04,0.1} do
	for _,loss in {0,0.01,0.05,0.2} do
	for _,burst in {0,0.3} do
		local delay=rtt*asymmetry local delivery={}
		for i,b in packets do if random:NextNumber()>=loss then
			local at=i/20+math.max(0,delay+random:NextNumber(-jitter,jitter))
			if burst>0 and i>=45 and i<=50 then at+=burst end
			table.insert(delivery,{at=at,index=i,packet=b})
		end end
		table.sort(delivery,function(a,b)return if a.at==b.at then a.index<b.index else a.at<b.at end)
		local e={generation=1,ownershipRevision=0} local control=0 local accepted,refused=0,0
		for _,event in delivery do
			-- Reliable ownership/lifetime notification can arrive AFTER new state.
			if event.at>=2+delay+0.08 and control==0 then e.ownershipRevision=1 e._receivedSequence=nil control=1 end
			if event.at>=3.5+delay+0.08 and control<2 then e.generation=2 e.ownershipRevision=0 e._receivedSequence=nil control=2 end
			local row=assert(P.Decode(event.packet))[1]
			local ok=Gate.Check(e,row)
			if ok then
				local previous=e._receivedSequence
				assert(row.generation==e.generation and row.ownershipRevision==e.ownershipRevision,"crossed lifecycle boundary")
				assert(previous==nil or row.sequence>previous,"accepted stale sequence")
				e._receivedSequence=row.sequence accepted+=1 report.assertions+=2
			else refused+=1 end
		end
		report.scenarios+=1 report.accepted+=accepted report.refused+=refused
		table.insert(report.profiles,{rtt=rtt,asymmetry=asymmetry,jitter=jitter,loss=loss,burst=burst,accepted=accepted,refused=refused})
		if report.scenarios%40==0 then task.wait() end
	end end end end end
	report.ok=true return report
end

		local paths={} for _,o in package:GetDescendants() do

function I.PreviewRemove(package)
	if not package or package:GetAttribute("ChronoForkOwner")~=owner then return nil,"Select an installed full-runtime package in ReplicatedStorage." end
	local manifest=package:FindFirstChild("InstallManifest") if manifest and manifest:IsA("ObjectValue") then manifest=manifest.Value end
	if not manifest then return nil,"The install record is missing. Use Studio Undo or review the package manually." end
	local owned={} local token=package:GetAttribute("ChronoForkInstallId")
	local remembered={}
	if manifest.Parent==game:GetService("ServerStorage") and (manifest:GetAttribute("ChronoForkInstallId")~=token or manifest:GetAttribute("ChronoForkOwner")~=owner) then return nil,"The private install record does not match this package." end
	for _,ref in manifest:GetChildren() do
		local o=ref.Value if not o then return nil,"An installed object was moved or removed. Review it manually to preserve your work." end
		remembered[o]=true
		local previousParent=ref:FindFirstChild("InstalledParent")
		if previousParent and (previousParent.Value~=o.Parent or ref:GetAttribute("InstalledName")~=o.Name) then return nil,"An installed object was moved or renamed. Review it manually to preserve your work." end
		local exact=ref:FindFirstChild("InstalledSource")
		if exact and (not o:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or o.Source~=exact.Value) then return nil,o.Name.." was edited after installation. Removal is blocked to preserve those edits; use Undo or back up and review manually." end
		if o==package or o:IsDescendantOf(package) then continue end
		if o:GetAttribute("ChronoForkInstallId")~=token then return nil,"An install link points outside this package. Review it manually." end
		table.insert(owned,o)
	end
	if manifest.Parent==game:GetService("ServerStorage") then
		for _,o in package:GetDescendants() do if not remembered[o] then return nil,"Objects were added after installation. Removal is blocked to preserve those additions." end end
		table.insert(owned,manifest)
	end
	table.insert(owned,package) return owned
end
function I.Remove(package,dependencies)
	assert(not game:GetService("RunService"):IsRunning(),"Stop Play before removal")
	local owned,why=I.PreviewRemove(package) if not owned then return nil,why end
	local history=if dependencies then dependencies.history else game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
	local rec=history:TryBeginRecording("ChronoForkFullRemove","Remove unchanged ChronoFork installation") if not rec then return nil,"Studio could not start Undo." end
	for _,o in owned do o:Destroy() end history:FinishRecording(rec,Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) return true
end
return I

			if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value<f.min or value>f.max or (f.integer and value%1~=0) then return false,f.label..": use "..f.min.." to "..f.max..(if f.integer then " (whole numbers)." else ".") end

export type AlignDriver = {
	part: BasePart,
	container: Camera,
	driverPart: BasePart,
	alignPosition: AlignPosition,
	alignOrientation: AlignOrientation,
	velocity: Vector3?,
	lastPosition: Vector3?,
	lastTime: number?,
}

const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)

const CONTAINER_NAME = "__CHRONO_ALIGN"
const DRIVER_PART_NAME = "__CHRONO_ALIGN_PART"

const ROOT_PRIORITY = 127

const MAX_RESPONSIVENESS = 200

const MAX_SPEED = 1000

local velocityUpdates: { AlignDriver } = {}
const AlignDriver = {}

const function Create(part: BasePart): AlignDriver
	const previous = part:FindFirstChild(CONTAINER_NAME)
	if previous then
		previous:Destroy()
	end

	const initCF = part.CFrame

	const container = Instance.new("Camera")
	container.Archivable = false
	container.Name = CONTAINER_NAME
	container.Parent = part

	const driverPart = Instance.new("Part")
	driverPart.Name = DRIVER_PART_NAME

	driverPart.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.0001, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	driverPart.Massless = false
	driverPart.RootPriority = ROOT_PRIORITY
	driverPart.Size = Vector3.zero
	driverPart.CanCollide = false
	driverPart.CanQuery = false
	driverPart.CanTouch = false
	driverPart.Transparency = 1
	driverPart.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

	driverPart.CFrame = initCF
	driverPart.Parent = container

	const weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "__CHRONO_ALIGN_WELD"
	weld.Part0 = driverPart
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.Parent = container

	const attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "__CHRONO_ALIGN_ATTACHMENT"
	attachment.Parent = driverPart

	const alignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
	alignPosition.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	alignPosition.Attachment0 = attachment

	alignPosition.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = false
	alignPosition.ReactionForceEnabled = false

	alignPosition.ForceRelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	alignPosition.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.Magnitude

	alignPosition.MaxForce = math.huge
	alignPosition.MaxVelocity = math.huge
	alignPosition.Responsiveness = MAX_RESPONSIVENESS

	alignPosition.RigidityEnabled = true
	alignPosition.Position = initCF.Position
	alignPosition.Parent = driverPart

	const alignOrientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	alignOrientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	alignOrientation.Attachment0 = attachment

	alignOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
	alignOrientation.PrimaryAxisOnly = false
	alignOrientation.ReactionTorqueEnabled = false
	alignOrientation.MaxTorque = math.huge
	alignOrientation.MaxAngularVelocity = math.huge
	alignOrientation.Responsiveness = MAX_RESPONSIVENESS
	alignOrientation.RigidityEnabled = true
	alignOrientation.CFrame = initCF.Rotation
	alignOrientation.Parent = driverPart

	part.CFrame = initCF

	return {
		part = part,
		container = container,
		driverPart = driverPart,
		alignPosition = alignPosition,
		alignOrientation = alignOrientation,
	}
end

const function Update(driver: AlignDriver, cframe: CFrame)
	driver.alignPosition.Position = cframe.Position
	driver.alignOrientation.CFrame = cframe.Rotation
end

const function Destroy(driver: AlignDriver)
	if driver.container then
		driver.container:Destroy()
	end

	driver.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Mimics roblox's replication for velocity
const function UpdateVelocity(driver: AlignDriver, position: Vector3, renderTime: number)
	const lastTime = driver.lastTime
	const lastPosition = driver.lastPosition
	if lastTime and lastPosition and renderTime > lastTime and renderTime - lastTime < 0.5 then
		const velocity = (position - lastPosition) / (renderTime - lastTime)
		if vector.magnitude(velocity :: any) < MAX_SPEED then
			driver.velocity = velocity
			table.insert(velocityUpdates, driver)
		end
	end
	driver.lastPosition = position
	driver.lastTime = renderTime
end

const function Step(entity: Types.Entity, part: BasePart, cframe: CFrame, renderTime: number)
	local existing = entity._alignDriver
	if existing and existing.part ~= part then
		Destroy(existing)
		existing = nil
	end
	if not existing then
		part.CFrame = cframe
	end
	const driver = existing or Create(part)
	entity._alignDriver = driver
	Update(driver, cframe)
	UpdateVelocity(driver, cframe.Position, renderTime)
end

const function Clear(entity: Types.Entity)
	const driver = entity._alignDriver
	if driver then
		Destroy(driver)
		entity._alignDriver = nil
	end
end

const function ApplyVelocities()
	for _, driver in velocityUpdates do
		if driver.velocity and driver.container.Parent then
			driver.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = driver.velocity
		end
	end
	velocityUpdates = {}
end

AlignDriver.Create = Create
AlignDriver.Update = Update
AlignDriver.Destroy = Destroy
AlignDriver.Step = Step
AlignDriver.Clear = Clear
AlignDriver.ApplyVelocities = ApplyVelocities

return AlignDriver

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Warn = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Warn)
const Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Config)
const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)
const BufferTracker = require(script.Parent.InterpolationBuffer)

const ClientClocks: { [Types.ClientClock]: boolean } = {}
const _ServerOwnedClocks: { [Types.ClientClock]: boolean } = {}

const function GetBuffer(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): number
	if clientClock.buffer then
		return BufferTracker.GetBuffer(clientClock.buffer, clientClock.tickRate)
	else
		return clientClock.bufferConst or 0
	end
end

const function Clear(clientClock: Types.ClientClock)
	clientClock.lastClockAt = nil
	clientClock.lastClockDuration = 0
	clientClock.renderAt = nil

	if clientClock.buffer then
		clientClock.buffer.init = false
	end
end

const function GetEstimatedServerTime(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): number
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		Warn.low("ClientClock: Estimated server time not yet established for", clientClock.name)
		return 0
	end

	return clientClock.lastClockAt + (os.clock() - clientClock.lastClockDuration)
end

const function GetTargetRenderTime(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): number
	if not clientClock.renderAt then
		if clientClock.lastClockAt then
			return GetEstimatedServerTime(clientClock) - GetBuffer(clientClock)
		end
		Warn.low("ClientClock: Render time not yet established for", clientClock.name)
		return 0
	end

	return clientClock.renderAt
end

const function CheckHasLastClockAt(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, sendTime: number)
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		clientClock.lastClockAt = sendTime
		clientClock.lastClockDuration = os.clock()
		clientClock.renderAt = nil
	end
end

const function Refresh(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, currentSendTime: number): boolean
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		CheckHasLastClockAt(clientClock, currentSendTime)
		return false
	end

	if currentSendTime > clientClock.lastClockAt then
		clientClock.lastClockAt = currentSendTime
		clientClock.lastClockDuration = os.clock()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

const function OnSnapShot(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, currentSendTime: number)
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		CheckHasLastClockAt(clientClock, currentSendTime)
		return
	end

	if clientClock.buffer then
		BufferTracker.Register(clientClock.buffer, currentSendTime)
	end

	if Refresh(clientClock, currentSendTime) and not clientClock.renderAt then
		clientClock.renderAt = currentSendTime - GetBuffer(clientClock)
	end
end

const function OnStop(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, stopTime: number)
	if clientClock.buffer then
		BufferTracker.MarkIdle(clientClock.buffer, stopTime)
	end
end

const function SetTickRate(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, tickRate: number)
	if clientClock.tickRate == tickRate then
		return
	end
	clientClock.tickRate = tickRate
end

const function Destroy(clientClock: Types.ClientClock)
	ClientClocks[clientClock] = nil
	if _ServerOwnedClocks[clientClock] then
		_ServerOwnedClocks[clientClock] = nil
	end
end

const function Update(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, dt: number)
	const now = os.clock()
	const delay = GetBuffer(clientClock)
	if not clientClock.lastClockAt then
		return
	end
	const estimatedServerTime = clientClock.lastClockAt + (now - clientClock.lastClockDuration)
	local renderAt = (clientClock.renderAt or (estimatedServerTime - delay)) + dt

	const renderTimeError = delay - (estimatedServerTime - renderAt)

	if math.abs(renderTimeError) > 0.1 then
		renderAt = estimatedServerTime - delay
	elseif renderTimeError > 0.01 then
		renderAt = math.max(estimatedServerTime - delay, renderAt - 0.1 * dt)
	elseif renderTimeError < -0.01 then
		renderAt = math.min(estimatedServerTime - delay, renderAt + 0.1 * dt)
	end

	clientClock.renderAt = renderAt
end

const function UpdateBuffer(clientClock: Types.ClientClock, buffer: number?)
	buffer = if buffer and buffer <= 0 then nil else buffer
	const currentBuffer = clientClock.bufferConst
	if currentBuffer == buffer then
		return
	end
	if not buffer then
		if not clientClock.buffer then
			clientClock.buffer = BufferTracker.new(clientClock)
		end
	else
		clientClock.buffer = nil
	end
	clientClock.bufferConst = buffer
	clientClock.renderAt = nil
end

const function new(tickRate: number, name: string, bufferNumber: number?, networkOwner: Player?): Types.ClientClock
	bufferNumber = if bufferNumber and bufferNumber <= 0 then nil else bufferNumber
	const self: Types.ClientClock = {
		name = name,
		lastClockAt = nil,
		lastClockDuration = 0,
		renderAt = nil,
		tickRate = tickRate,
		_baseTickRate = tickRate,
		_owner = networkOwner,
		buffer = nil,
		bufferConst = bufferNumber,

		OnSnapShot = OnSnapShot,
		OnStop = OnStop,
		Refresh = Refresh,
		GetEstimatedServerTime = GetEstimatedServerTime,
		GetTargetRenderTime = GetTargetRenderTime,
		Clear = Clear,
		SetTickRate = SetTickRate,
		UpdateBuffer = UpdateBuffer,
		Destroy = Destroy,
	}
	if not bufferNumber then
		self.buffer = BufferTracker.new(self)
	end

	if not networkOwner then
		_ServerOwnedClocks[self] = true
	end

	ClientClocks[self] = true
	return self
end

const function UpdateAll(dt: number)
	for clientClock, _ in ClientClocks do
		Update(clientClock, dt)
	end
end

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	for name, config in Config._EntityConfigs do
		const clientClocks = config.CLIENT_CLOCK
		if not clientClocks then
			Warn.high("Entity Config", name, "is missing client clocks")
			return
		end
		clientClocks.NORMAL = new(config.TICK_RATE, name .. "_NORMAL", config.BUFFER)
		if (config.HALF_TICK_DISTANCE or math.huge) < math.huge then
			clientClocks.HALF = new(config.TICK_RATE * 2, name .. "_HALF", config.BUFFER)
		end
	end
end)

return {
	_getBuffer = GetBuffer,
	new = new,
	clientClocks = ClientClocks,
	serverOwnedClocks = _ServerOwnedClocks,
	UpdateAll = UpdateAll,
}

const ClientClock = require(script.Parent.ClientClock)
const StatsALL = require(Shared.Stats)
const Entity = require(Shared.Entity)
const Holder = require(Shared.Holder)
const Types = require(Shared.Types)
const Stats = StatsALL.CLIENT

type SnapshotData = Types.SnapshotData<CFrame, Vector3>

const idMap = Holder.idMap

const function UpdateEntityStats()
	if not StatsALL.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE or Stats._PAUSE then
		return
	end
	const entities = {}
	for _, entity in idMap do
		const id = entity.id
		const config = entity.entityConfig
		const configName = config and config.NAME or "DEFAULT"
		const networkOwner = entity.networkOwner
		const isCharacter = entity._player ~= nil

		const lastRecvTime = entity.latestTime or 0
		const lastReplicatedTime = entity.lastReplicatedTime or 0

		local renderCache = entity._clientClock

		if not renderCache then
			const RenderCaches = entity.entityConfig.CLIENT_CLOCK
			if RenderCaches then
				renderCache = entity.isHalfTicked and RenderCaches.HALF or RenderCaches.NORMAL
			end
		end

		local targetRender = 0
		local averageLatency = 0
		local deviation = 0
		local bufferedTime = 0

		if renderCache then
			targetRender = renderCache:GetTargetRenderTime()
			const interpolationBuff = renderCache.buffer
			if interpolationBuff then
				averageLatency = interpolationBuff.averageLatency
				deviation = interpolationBuff.deviation
			end
			bufferedTime = ClientClock._getBuffer(renderCache)
		end
		const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
		const snapshot = entity.snapshot
		const currentPosition = primaryPart and primaryPart.Position
		const snapshots: { SnapshotData } = {}
		if snapshot then
			for _, snap in snapshot.cache do
				table.insert(snapshots, { t = snap.t, value = snap.value, velocity = snap.velocity })
			end
			table.sort(snapshots, function(a: SnapshotData, b: SnapshotData)
				return a.t > b.t
			end)
		end
		const data = {
			id = id,
			entity = entity,
			networkOwner = networkOwner,
			isCharacter = isCharacter,
			config = configName,
			lastReceivedTime = lastRecvTime,
			lastReplicatedTime = lastReplicatedTime,
			targetTime = targetRender,
			averageLatency = averageLatency,
			deviation = deviation,
			bufferedTime = bufferedTime,
			currentPosition = currentPosition,
			snapshots = snapshots,
		}
		table.insert(entities, data)
	end
	Stats.CLIENT_ENTITIES = entities :: any
end

return UpdateEntityStats

const Shared = script.Parent.Parent.Shared

const Types = require(Shared.Types)
const Stats = require(Shared.Stats).CLIENT

const TICKS = 4

local FrustumLookVector = vector.create(0, 0, -1)
local FrustumRightVector = vector.create(1, 0, 0)
local FrustumUpVector = vector.create(0, 1, 0)
local FrustumPosition = vector.create(0, 0, 0)
local TanHorizontal = 0
local TanVertical = 0

local CurrentTick = 0
local OutOfBroadPhaseTick = 0
local TotalCulled = 0

const Frustum = {}

const function Prepare()
	const cframe: CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	FrustumLookVector = cframe.LookVector :: any
	FrustumRightVector = cframe.RightVector :: any
	FrustumUpVector = cframe.UpVector :: any

	FrustumPosition = cframe.Position :: any

	const cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	const halfFov = math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2)
	const aspectRatio = cam.ViewportSize.X / cam.ViewportSize.Y
	TanHorizontal = math.tan(halfFov) * aspectRatio
	TanVertical = math.tan(halfFov)
end

const function CheckPoint(pos: vector)
	const diff = pos - FrustumPosition

	const magnitude = vector.magnitude(diff)

	if magnitude == 0 then
		return true
	end

	const forwardDis = vector.dot(diff, FrustumLookVector)

	const forwardDot = forwardDis / magnitude
	if forwardDot < 0 then
		return false
	end
	if forwardDis < 1 then
		return true
	end
	const unit = diff / magnitude
	const rightDot = vector.dot(unit, FrustumRightVector)

	if math.abs(rightDot) > forwardDot * TanHorizontal then
		return false
	end

	const upDot = vector.dot(unit, FrustumUpVector)
	if math.abs(upDot) > forwardDot * TanVertical then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

const function CheckBroadPhase(center: vector, size: vector)
	if size == vector.zero then
		return CheckPoint(center)
	end
	const halfSize = size * 0.5
	const halfX = halfSize.x
	const halfY = halfSize.y
	const halfZ = halfSize.z
	const negX = -halfX
	const negY = -halfY
	const negZ = -halfZ

	return CheckPoint(center + vector.create(halfX, halfY, halfZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(negX, halfY, halfZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(halfX, negY, halfZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(negX, negY, halfZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(halfX, halfY, negZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(negX, halfY, negZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(halfX, negY, negZ))
		or CheckPoint(center + vector.create(negX, negY, negZ))
end

-- Runs every 4 frames at 60hz so this runs at ~15hz
const function Update()
	CurrentTick += 1
	if CurrentTick % TICKS == 0 then
		Stats.TOTAL_ENTITIES_CULLED = TotalCulled
		TotalCulled = 0
		CurrentTick = 0
	end
end

const function IsThrottled(entity: Types.Entity): boolean
	const slot = entity._outofBroadPhaseTick
	return slot ~= nil and slot ~= CurrentTick
end

const function IsCulled(entity: Types.Entity, targetCFrame: CFrame): boolean
	const broadPhase = entity.broadPhase :: vector
	const toCheck = targetCFrame :: any
	const lastCheckedCFrame = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
	debug.profilebegin("Prepare Frustum")
	const passed = CheckBroadPhase(toCheck.Position, broadPhase)
	debug.profileend()
	if not passed then
		if lastCheckedCFrame and lastCheckedCFrame.Position ~= toCheck.Position then
			debug.profilebegin("Check Last CFrame")
			const passLast = CheckBroadPhase(lastCheckedCFrame.Position :: any, broadPhase)
			debug.profileend()
			if not passLast then
				TotalCulled += 1
				return true
			end
		else
			if not lastCheckedCFrame then
				entity.lastCheckedCFrame = toCheck
			end
			if not entity._outofBroadPhaseTick then
				entity._outofBroadPhaseTick = OutOfBroadPhaseTick
				OutOfBroadPhaseTick += 1
				if OutOfBroadPhaseTick % TICKS == 0 then
					OutOfBroadPhaseTick = 0
				end
			end
			TotalCulled += 1
			return true
		end
	end
	entity.lastCheckedCFrame = nil
	entity._outofBroadPhaseTick = nil
	return false
end

Frustum.Prepare = Prepare
Frustum.CheckPoint = CheckPoint
Frustum.CheckBroadPhase = CheckBroadPhase
Frustum.Update = Update
Frustum.IsThrottled = IsThrottled
Frustum.IsCulled = IsCulled

return Frustum

const Warn = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Warn)
const Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Config)
const Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Types)

local MIN_BUFFER: number
local MAX_BUFFER: number
const ALPHA = 0.1
const GAP_DECAY = 0.005

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	MIN_BUFFER = Config._GetConfig("MIN_BUFFER")
	MAX_BUFFER = Config._GetConfig("MAX_BUFFER")
end)
const Buffer = {}

function Buffer.new(clientClock: Types.ClientClock): Types.InterpolationBuffer
	return {
		init = false,
		averageLatency = 0,
		deviation = 0,
		lastLatency = 0,
		lastSendTime = nil,
		maxSendGap = 0,
		idle = false,

		clientClock = clientClock,
	}
end

function Buffer.Register(data: Types.InterpolationBuffer, time: number)
	const clientClock = data.clientClock
	const clientNow = clientClock:GetEstimatedServerTime()
	const latency = clientNow - time

	if math.abs(latency) > 1 then
		clientClock:Clear()
		Warn.low(data.clientClock.name, ` latency too high, cleared cache to repredict in case of error:! {latency}`)
	end

	const lastSendTime = data.lastSendTime
	if lastSendTime and time > lastSendTime and not data.idle then
		const gap = time - lastSendTime
		if gap <= clientClock.tickRate * 3 then
			data.maxSendGap = if gap > data.maxSendGap
				then gap
				else data.maxSendGap + (gap - data.maxSendGap) * GAP_DECAY
		end
	end
	if not lastSendTime or time > lastSendTime then
		data.lastSendTime = time
		data.idle = false
	end

	if not data.init then
		--using the difference between current and last latency, i could smooth out the deviation (the variation in latency, which correlates to packet loss)
		--this is using statistics https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moving_average
		data.averageLatency = latency
		data.deviation = 0
		data.lastLatency = latency
		data.init = true
		return
	end

	if data.lastLatency then
		const delta = math.abs(latency - data.lastLatency)
		--deviation is essentially jitter, and we calculate that using RFC 3550 jitter estimation
		--see: https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/tech/tech3337.pdf
		data.deviation = data.deviation + (delta - data.deviation) * ALPHA
	end

	data.averageLatency = data.averageLatency + (latency - data.averageLatency) * ALPHA
	data.lastLatency = latency
end

function Buffer.MarkIdle(data: Types.InterpolationBuffer, time: number)
	const lastSendTime = data.lastSendTime
	if lastSendTime and time < lastSendTime then
		return
	end
	data.lastSendTime = time
	data.idle = true
end

function Buffer.GetBuffer(data: Types.InterpolationBuffer, tickRate: number)
	if not data then
		return MIN_BUFFER
	end

	const deviationMargin = data.deviation * 2
	const rawBuffer = math.max(tickRate, data.maxSendGap) + deviationMargin

	local buffer = if rawBuffer < MIN_BUFFER then MIN_BUFFER + (MIN_BUFFER - rawBuffer) * 0.2 else rawBuffer
	if buffer > MAX_BUFFER then
		Warn.low(`Interpolation buffer exceeded max! Was {buffer}, clamped to {MAX_BUFFER} for`, data.clientClock.name)
		buffer = MAX_BUFFER
	end

	return buffer
end

return Buffer

	if not model then
		return
	end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		Warn.high(`Model for {LocalPlayer} is not a Model instance.`)
		return
	end
	LocalPlayer.Character = model
	const cf = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or model.PrimaryPart
	workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = cf
	-- This was to a fix to resolve custom mode

		end
	end

const function OnCharacterRegistered(player: Player, entity: Types.Entity)
	if not IsAutomatic() or Entity.GetModelReplicationType(entity) ~= "CUSTOM" then
		return
	end
	const model = entity.model
	if not model then
		return Warn.high(`No model found for {player}`)
	end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		return Warn.high(`Model for {player} is not a Model instance.`)
	end
	player.Character = model

	if player == LocalPlayer then
		Entity.GetEvent(entity, "ModelChanged"):Connect(function(_, newModel)
			SetLocalCharacter(newModel)
		end)
		SetLocalCharacter(model)
	end
end

const function StopWatch(entity: Types.Entity)
	const clear = binClears[entity]
	if clear then
		binClears[entity] = nil
		clear()
	end
end

const function WatchDeath(player: Player, entity: Types.Entity)
	if player ~= LocalPlayer or binClears[entity] then
		return
	end
	const add, clear = Bin()
	const addDied, clearDied = Bin()

	const function CheckHumanoid(_, model: Model | BasePart?)
		clearDied()
		if not model or not entity.isContextOwner or not model:IsA("Model") then
			return
		end
		const humanoid = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			addDied(humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				if entity.isContextOwner then
					DeathRemote:FireServer(entity.id)
				end
			end))
		end
	end

	add(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "ModelChanged"):Connect(CheckHumanoid))
	add(Entity.GetEvent(entity, "Destroying"):Connect(function()
		StopWatch(entity)
	end))
	add(clearDied)
	binClears[entity] = clear
	CheckHumanoid(entity, entity.model)
end

const function Die(id: number)
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
	if not entity or entity.isContextOwner then
		return
	end
	const model = entity.model
	if not model then
		return
	end
	task.wait()
	const humanoid = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
		humanoid.Health = 0
		humanoid.Health = 10
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end

return nil

const ServerWrap = ClockUnwrap.new()
const ClientOwnedWrap: ClockUnwrap.Store = {}

const TickerHeaderBytes = 4 + 1
const FULL_BYTES = 4 * 3 + 2 * 3
const YAW_BYTES = 4 * 3 + 2

const TAU = 2 * math.pi

const function UnmapRotation(u16: number): number
	return (u16 / 65535) * TAU - math.pi
end

const function ReadTickerHeader(b: buffer, index: number): (number, boolean, boolean)
	const lastTicked = ClockUnwrap.unwrap(ServerWrap, buffer.readu32(b, index))
	const packed = buffer.readu8(b, index + 4)

	const isHalfTickRate = bit32.band(packed, 1) == 1
	const isFull = bit32.band(packed, 2) == 2

	return lastTicked, isFull, isHalfTickRate
end

const function DeserializeFull(b: buffer, index: number): CFrame
	const x = buffer.readf32(b, index)
	index += 4
	const y = buffer.readf32(b, index)
	index += 4
	const z = buffer.readf32(b, index)
	index += 4

	const rx = UnmapRotation(buffer.readu16(b, index))
	index += 2
	const ry = UnmapRotation(buffer.readu16(b, index))
	index += 2
	const rz = UnmapRotation(buffer.readu16(b, index))
	index += 2

	return CFrame.new(x, y, z) * CFrame.fromOrientation(rx, ry, rz)
end

const function DeserializeYaw(b: buffer, index: number): CFrame
	const x = buffer.readf32(b, index)
	index += 4
	const y = buffer.readf32(b, index)
	index += 4
	const z = buffer.readf32(b, index)
	index += 4

	const ry = UnmapRotation(buffer.readu16(b, index))
	index += 2

	return CFrame.new(x, y, z) * CFrame.fromOrientation(0, ry, 0)
end

const ChangedLookUp = {
	networkOwner = Entity._SetEntityNetworkOwner,
	isHalfTicked = SetTickMode,
	_data = Entity.SetData,
	entityConfig = Entity.SetConfig,
	autoUpdatePosition = Entity.SetAutoUpdatePos,
	mountParentId = SetMountId,
	mountOffset = SetMountOffset,
	broadPhase = Entity.SetBroadPhase,
	_interpolationMode = Entity.SetInterpolationMode,
	_humanoidDisabledStates = Entity._SetHumanoidDisabledStates,
	_humanoidState = Entity._SetHumanoidState,
}

const function HandleChanges(changes: { id: number, data: { { any } } })
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(changes.id)
	if not entity then
		return
	end
	local modelData
	local modelChanged = false
	for _, pair in changes.data do
		const key = pair[1]
		const value = pair[2]

		const handler = ChangedLookUp[key]
		if handler then
			handler(entity, value)
		elseif key == "latestCFrame" then
			Entity.SetCFrame(entity, value)
		elseif key == "model" then
			modelData = value
			modelChanged = true -- value is nil when the model was cleared
		elseif key == "_player" then
			if value then
				Holder.SetAsCharacter(value, entity)
			else
				Holder.RemovePlayerCharacter(entity)
			end
		elseif key == "paused" then
			if value then
				Entity.PauseReplication(entity)
			else
				Entity.ResumeReplication(entity)
			end
		elseif key == "_lockedCFReplication" then
			entity._lockedCFReplication = value
			if not value then
				const part = Entity._GetPart(entity)
				if part then
					Entity._UnlockPartPhysicsReplication(part)
				end
			else
				Entity.SyncOwnerShip(entity)
			end
		else
			Warn.high("Unhandled entity change key:", key)
		end
	end

	if modelChanged then
		const model, modelType, handle = ModelHelper.CreateModelFromData(modelData)
		Entity.SetModel(entity, model, modelType :: any)
		entity._modelHandle = handle
	end
end

const function HandleNewEntity(data: Types.EntityReceivePacket)
	const model, modelType, handle = ModelHelper.CreateModelFromData(data.model)
	local cframe = data.cframe
	const localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	-- initializes cframe for local character just in case client loads in a different spot
	if data.networkOwner == localPlayer and model and model == localPlayer.Character then
		const root = (model :: Model).PrimaryPart
		if root then
			cframe = root.CFrame
		end
	end
	const entity = Entity._new(data.config, model, modelType :: any, cframe)

	entity.id = data.id
	entity._player = data._player
	entity._modelHandle = handle
	entity.paused = data.paused or false
	entity.autoUpdatePosition = data.autoUpdatePosition or false
	entity.isHalfTicked = data.isHalfTicked
	entity._data = data._data
	entity.mountParentId = data.mountParentId
	entity.mountOffset = data.mountOffset or CFrame.identity
	entity.broadPhase = data.broadPhase or entity.broadPhase
	entity._lockedCFReplication = data._lockedCFReplication or false
	entity._interpolationMode = data._interpolationMode

	Entity._Push(entity, data.time, cframe)

	Entity._SetEntityNetworkOwner(entity, data.networkOwner)

	Entity._SetHumanoidDisabledStates(entity, data._humanoidDisabledStates)
	Entity._SetHumanoidState(entity, data._humanoidState)
	SetTickMode(entity, data.isHalfTicked)
	Holder.RegisterEntity(entity)
end

const function PushCFrameFor(
	id: number,
	clientOwned: boolean,
	cframe: CFrame,
	time: number,
	isHalfTick: boolean,
	teleport: boolean?,
	isStop: boolean?
): boolean
	const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
	if not entity then
		Warn.high("Received update for non existent entity with id", id)
		return false
	end
	
	if entity.isContextOwner or clientOwned ~= (entity.networkOwner ~= nil) then
		return false
	end

	const withinTeleportThreshold = entity._teleport and os.clock() - entity._teleport < 0.5
	if withinTeleportThreshold then
		if teleport then
			entity._teleport = nil
		else
			return false
		end
	end
	if teleport then
		entity._ownerChangedAt = nil
		entity._ownerSmoothing = nil
	end

	if clientOwned then
		const renderCache = entity._clientClock
		if renderCache then
			if isHalfTick then
				renderCache:SetTickRate(renderCache._baseTickRate * 2)
			else
				renderCache:SetTickRate(renderCache._baseTickRate)
			end
			if isStop then
				renderCache:OnStop(time)
			else
				renderCache:OnSnapShot(time)
			end
		end
	else
		const renderCaches = entity.entityConfig.CLIENT_CLOCK
		if renderCaches then
			const renderCache = isHalfTick and renderCaches.HALF or renderCaches.NORMAL
			if renderCache and isStop then
				renderCache:OnStop(time)
			elseif renderCache then
				renderCache:OnSnapShot(time)
			end
		end
	end

	if entity.isHalfTicked ~= isHalfTick then
		SetTickMode(entity, isHalfTick)
	end
	entity.isHalfTicked = isHalfTick

	if isStop then
		Entity._PushStopped(entity, time, cframe)
	else
		Entity._Push(entity, time, cframe)
	end
	return true
end

const function HandleClientOwned(b: buffer)
	BytesReceived += buffer.len(b)
	const bLen = buffer.len(b)
	local index = 0

	while index < bLen do
		const rawTime = buffer.readu32(b, index)
		index += 4
		const length = buffer.readu8(b, index)
		index += 1
		for i = 1, length do
			const id = buffer.readu16(b, index)
			index += 2
			const packed = buffer.readu8(b, index)
			index += 1
			const isFull = bit32.band(packed, 1) == 1
			const isHalfTickRate = bit32.band(packed, 2) == 2
			const teleport = bit32.band(packed, 4) == 4
			const isStop = bit32.band(packed, 8) == 8
			local cf: CFrame
			if isFull then
				cf = DeserializeFull(b, index)
				index += FULL_BYTES
			else
				cf = DeserializeYaw(b, index)
				index += YAW_BYTES
			end
			const entity = Holder.GetEntityFromId(id)
			if not entity then
				Warn.medium("Received update for non existent entity with id", id)
				continue
			end
			const owner = entity.networkOwner

			if owner and owner.Parent == nil then
				continue
			end

			const time = ClockUnwrap.unwrapFor(ClientOwnedWrap, owner or "__unknown", rawTime)
			PushCFrameFor(id, true, cf, time, isHalfTickRate, teleport, isStop)
		end
	end
end

const function HandleServerOwned(b: buffer, isStop: boolean?)
	const bLen = buffer.len(b)
	BytesReceived += bLen
	local index = 0
	while index < bLen do
		const lastTicked, isFull, isHalfTickRate = ReadTickerHeader(b, index)
		index += TickerHeaderBytes
		const length = buffer.readu8(b, index)
		index += 1
		for i = 1, length do
			const id = buffer.readu16(b, index)
			index += 2
			local cframe
			if isFull then
				cframe = DeserializeFull(b, index)
				index += FULL_BYTES
			else
				cframe = DeserializeYaw(b, index)
				index += YAW_BYTES
			end
			PushCFrameFor(id, false, cframe, lastTicked, isHalfTickRate, nil, isStop)
		end
	end
end

const function HandleUnreliable(id: string, data: buffer)
	if id == "X" then -- Server Owned
		HandleServerOwned(data)
	elseif id == "O" then -- Client Owned
		HandleClientOwned(data)
	else
		Warn.high("Unknown unreliable replicate id", id)
	end
end

const function HandleReliable(newEntities: { any }, removedEntities: { number }, entityChanges: { any })
	if removedEntities then
		for _, id in removedEntities do
			HandleRemoved(id)
		end
		RemovedPerSec += #removedEntities
	end

	if newEntities then
		for _, data: any in newEntities do
			HandleNewEntity(data)
		end
		NewPerSec += #newEntities
	end

	if entityChanges then
		for _, changeData in entityChanges do
			HandleChanges(changeData)
		end
		ChangesPerSec += #entityChanges
	end
end

UnreliableEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(HandleUnreliable)
ReliableEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(HandleReliable)
Shared.Remotes.SafeReplicate.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(id: string, data: buffer)
	if id == "X" then
		HandleServerOwned(data, true)
	elseif id == "O" then
		HandleClientOwned(data)
	else
		Warn.high("Unknown replicate id", id)
	end
end)

	for _, entry in list do

			if not state then

				ClientOwnedWrap[player] = state
			end
			state.lastRaw = raw
			state.offset = math.max(state.offset, offset)
		end
	end
end)

end

const function CanInterpolate(entity: Types.Entity, primaryPart: BasePart): boolean
	if entity.isContextOwner then
		return false
	end

	if entity.entityConfig.ASSEMBLY_ROOT_PART_CHECK and not entity._alignDriver then
		if primaryPart.AssemblyRootPart ~= primaryPart then
			Warn.low(
				"Primary part for entity "
					.. entity.id
					.. " is not the assembly root part. Skipping interpolation for this entity."
			)
			return false
		end
	end

	if Frustum.IsThrottled(entity) then
		return false
	end

	if not entity.snapshot then
		Warn.medium("No snapshot for entity", entity)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

const function SmoothOwnerChange(entity: Types.Entity, primaryPart: BasePart, targetCFrame: CFrame): CFrame
	const changedAt = entity._ownerChangedAt
	if changedAt then
		entity._ownerChangedAt = nil
		if os.clock() - changedAt < MAX_OWNER_SMOOTH_DELAY then
			const drawn = primaryPart.CFrame
			entity._ownerSmoothing = {
				offset = drawn.Position - targetCFrame.Position,
				rotation = drawn.Rotation * targetCFrame.Rotation:Inverse(),
				start = os.clock(),
			}
		end
	end
	return Entity._ApplyOwnerSmoothing(entity, targetCFrame)
end

const function Interpolate(entity: Types.Entity, mode: Types.INTERPOLATION_MODE)
	const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
	if not primaryPart or not CanInterpolate(entity, primaryPart) then
		return
	end
	const snapshot = entity.snapshot :: Types.Snapshot<CFrame, Vector3>
	CheckedThisFrame += 1
	debug.profilebegin("Get Render CFrame")
	local targetTime = Entity.GetTargetRenderTime(entity)
	if mode == "ALIGN" then
		targetTime += os.clock() - LastClockUpdate
	end
	local targetCFrame = snapshot:GetAt(targetTime)
	debug.profileend()
	if not targetCFrame then
		return
	end
	targetCFrame = SmoothOwnerChange(entity, primaryPart, targetCFrame)
	if entity.broadPhase and Frustum.IsCulled(entity, targetCFrame) then
		return
	end
	debug.profilebegin("Set CFrame")
	if targetCFrame == targetCFrame then
		if mode == "ALIGN" then
			AlignDriver.Step(entity, primaryPart, targetCFrame, targetTime)
		else
			AlignDriver.Clear(entity)
			-- Using cframe here instead of bulkmoveto as there were some issues relating to moving the character via bmt.
			-- SEE in ROSS https://discord.com/channels/385151591524597761/1406041519747764374/1408085390618919104
			primaryPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
		end
	end
	MovedThisFrame += 1
	debug.profileend()
end

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	local steppedEntities: { Types.Entity } = {}
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
		steppedEntities = {}
		Frustum.Update()
		RenderCache.UpdateAll(deltaTime)
		LastClockUpdate = os.clock()
		debug.profilebegin("Prepare Frustum Check")
		Frustum.Prepare()
		debug.profileend()
		local total = 0
		const startTime = os.clock()
		debug.profilebegin("Interpolate Entities")
		for _, entity in idMap do
			ModelResolver(entity)
			if entity.destroyed then
				continue
			end
			if entity.mountParentId then

				AlignDriver.Clear(entity)
				continue
			end
			if entity.paused then
				continue
			end
			total += 1
			const mode: Types.INTERPOLATION_MODE? = GetMode(entity)
			if mode == "ALIGN" then
				if not entity._alignDriver then
					Interpolate(entity, mode)
				end
				table.insert(steppedEntities, entity)
			elseif mode then
				Interpolate(entity, mode)
			elseif entity._alignDriver then
				AlignDriver.Clear(entity)
			end
		end
		debug.profileend()
		const endTime = os.clock()
		debug.profilebegin("Update Entity Stats")
		UpdateEntityStats()
		debug.profileend()
		debug.profilebegin("Apply Velocities")
		AlignDriver.ApplyVelocities()
		debug.profileend()
		TotalInterpolationTime += (endTime - startTime)
		AmtInterpolations += 1

		ApplyMounts()
		if not Stats._PAUSE then
			Stats.TOTAL_CLIENT_ENTITIES_CHECKED_THIS_FRAME = total
			Stats.ENTITIES_MOVED_THIS_FRAME = MovedThisFrame
			Stats.TOTAL_CLIENT_ENTITIES = total
			Stats.AVG_INTERPOLATION_TIME_MS = (TotalInterpolationTime / AmtInterpolations) * 1000
		end
		MovedThisFrame = 0
		CheckedThisFrame = 0
		if AmtInterpolations > 60 then
			TotalInterpolationTime = 0
			AmtInterpolations = 0
		end
		Sender.Update()
		Ticker._IncrementGlobalTick()
	end)

	RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
		-- for align pos
		debug.profilebegin("Interpolate Align Entities")
		Frustum.Prepare()
		for _, entity in steppedEntities do
			if entity.destroyed or entity.paused or entity.mountParentId then
				continue
			end
			if GetMode(entity) == "ALIGN" then
				Interpolate(entity, "ALIGN")
			end
		end
		debug.profileend()
	end)

	const ClientHeartbeatRemote = Shared.Remotes.ClientHeartbeat
	ClientHeartbeatRemote:FireServer(os.clock()) -- seed on join
	local clientHeartbeatAcc = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		clientHeartbeatAcc += dt
		if clientHeartbeatAcc >= CLIENT_CLOCK_SYNC_RATE then
			clientHeartbeatAcc = 0
			ClientHeartbeatRemote:FireServer(os.clock())
		end
	end)

	Shared.Remotes.ClientLoaded:FireServer()
end)

return nil

const Entity = require(Shared.Entity)
const ClockUnwrap = require(Shared.ClockUnwrap)
const ServerReplicate = require(script.Parent.Parent.Server.Replicate)
const UnreliableEvent = Shared.Remotes.Replicate
const SafeReplicateEvent = Shared.Remotes.SafeReplicate

const ClientOwned = Holder._clientOwned
if not ClientOwned[LocalPlayer] then
	ClientOwned[LocalPlayer] = {}
end
const PlayerEntities = ClientOwned[LocalPlayer]

const FULL_BYTES = 4 * 3 + 2 * 3 + 3
const YAW_BYTES = 4 * 3 + 2 + 3
const MAX_BUFFER_SIZE = 900

const BUFFER = buffer.create(MAX_BUFFER_SIZE + 50)
local INDEX = 0

const TAU = math.pi * 2

local clock = 0
local hasTeleport = false
local hasStop = false

const function MapRotation(radians: number): number
	return math.round((radians + math.pi) / (TAU / 65535))
end

const function FireEvent(entity: Types.Entity, eventName: string, ...: any)
	const events = entity._events
	if not events then
		return
	end
	const signal = events[eventName]
	if signal then
		signal:Fire(entity, ...)
	end
end

const function SerializeFull(b: buffer, cframe: CFrame, index: number)
	const x, y, z = cframe.X, cframe.Y, cframe.Z
	const rx, ry, rz = cframe:ToOrientation()

	buffer.writef32(b, index, x)
	index += 4
	buffer.writef32(b, index, y)
	index += 4
	buffer.writef32(b, index, z)
	index += 4
	buffer.writeu16(b, index, MapRotation(rx))
	index += 2
	buffer.writeu16(b, index, MapRotation(ry))
	index += 2
	buffer.writeu16(b, index, MapRotation(rz))
	index += 2

	return index
end

const function SerializeYaw(b: buffer, cframe: CFrame, index: number)
	const x, y, z = cframe.X, cframe.Y, cframe.Z
	const _, ry, _ = cframe:ToOrientation()

	buffer.writef32(b, index, x)
	index += 4
	buffer.writef32(b, index, y)
	index += 4
	buffer.writef32(b, index, z)
	index += 4
	buffer.writeu16(b, index, MapRotation(ry))
	index += 2

	return index
end

const function Flush()
	if INDEX == 0 then
		return
	end

	const copy = buffer.create(INDEX + 4)
	buffer.writeu32(copy, 0, ClockUnwrap.quantize(clock))
	buffer.copy(copy, 4, BUFFER, 0, INDEX)
	if hasTeleport or hasStop then
		SafeReplicateEvent:FireServer(copy)
	else
		UnreliableEvent:FireServer(copy)
	end

	INDEX = 0
end

const function WriteEntity(
	id: number,
	cf: CFrame,
	fullCFrame: boolean?,
	halfTicked: boolean?,
	teleport: boolean?,
	stop: boolean?
)
	const length = if fullCFrame then FULL_BYTES else YAW_BYTES

	if INDEX + length > MAX_BUFFER_SIZE then
		Flush()
	end

	buffer.writeu16(BUFFER, INDEX, id)
	INDEX += 2
	local packed = if fullCFrame then 1 else 0

	if halfTicked then
		packed += 2
	end

	if teleport then
		packed += 4
	end

	if stop then
		packed += 8
	end

	buffer.writeu8(BUFFER, INDEX, packed)
	INDEX += 1

	if fullCFrame then
		INDEX = SerializeFull(BUFFER, cf, INDEX)
	else
		INDEX = SerializeYaw(BUFFER, cf, INDEX)
	end
end

--//This is to catch an edge case where the primarypart hasn't been replicated
const function CheckLocker(entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity._cfLockFailed then
		if entity._lockedCFReplication and entity.isContextOwner and not entity._player then
			const part = Entity._GetPart(entity)
			if part then
				Entity._LockPartPhysicsReplication(part)
				entity._cfLockFailed = nil
			end
		else
			entity._cfLockFailed = nil
		end
	end
end

const function CheckEntity(entity: Types.Entity)
	if entity.destroyed or entity.paused then
		return
	end

	const config = entity.entityConfig
	local tickRate = config.TICK_RATE

	if entity.isHalfTicked then
		tickRate = tickRate * 2
	elseif entity.isHalfTicked == nil then
		return
	end

	const now = clock
	const lastTime = entity.lastReplicatedTime or 0
	const difference = now - lastTime

	if difference < tickRate then
		return
	end
	CheckLocker(entity)
	FireEvent(entity, "Ticked", difference)
	const primaryPart = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)

	if entity.autoUpdatePosition and primaryPart then
		Entity._Push(entity, now, primaryPart.CFrame)
	end

	const currentCFrame = entity.latestCFrame
	const lastCFrame = entity.lastCheckedCFrame
	if currentCFrame and ServerReplicate.HasCFrameChanged(lastCFrame, currentCFrame) then
		entity.lastReplicatedTime = now
		const fullCFrame = config.FULL_ROTATION
		entity.lastCheckedCFrame = currentCFrame
		const teleport = entity._teleport ~= nil
		hasTeleport = hasTeleport or teleport
		WriteEntity(entity.id, currentCFrame, fullCFrame, entity.isHalfTicked, teleport)
		entity._teleport = nil
		const step = if lastCFrame then currentCFrame.Position - lastCFrame.Position else Vector3.zero
		const paused = (entity._idleTicks or 0) > 0
		Entity._RecordMove(entity, step, if paused then math.max(math.round(difference / tickRate), 2) else 1)
	elseif currentCFrame then
		const idleTicks = difference // tickRate
		const stopAfter = entity._stopAfter or 1
		if idleTicks >= stopAfter and (entity._idleTicks or 0) < stopAfter then
			hasStop = true
			WriteEntity(entity.id, currentCFrame, config.FULL_ROTATION, entity.isHalfTicked, false, true)
		end
		entity._idleTicks = idleTicks
	end
end

const function Update()
	clock = os.clock()
	for entity in PlayerEntities do
		CheckEntity(entity)
	end

	Flush()
	hasTeleport = false
	hasStop = false
end

return {
	Update = Update,
}

const Players = game:GetService("Players")

const Events = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Events)

const ReplicationRules = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.ReplicationRules)
const RuleAllows = ReplicationRules.Allows
const Stats = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Stats)
const Warn = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Warn)

const Shared = script.Parent.Parent.Shared
const Types = require(Shared.Types)
const Holder = require(Shared.Holder)
const Ticker = require(Shared.Ticker)
const Entity = require(Shared.Entity)
const Signal = require(Shared.Signal)

const SetTickMode = Entity._SetTickMode

type Entity = Types.Entity

local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.1
local MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE = 0.0005

local lastUpdate = 0

Config._WaitForLock(function()
	UPDATE_INTERVAL = Config._GetConfig("GRID_UPDATE_INTERVAL") or UPDATE_INTERVAL
	MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE = Config._GetConfig("GRID_MAX_UPDATE_TIME") or MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE
end)

local FULL_TICKED = 0
local HALF_TICKED = 0
local UN_TICKED = 0

type PlayerEntityHolder = Types.PlayerEntityHolder

const entities = Holder.idMap
const playerTablePositionPair: { [PlayerEntityHolder]: vector } = {}
const playerToHolder: { [Player]: PlayerEntityHolder } = {}

const function Check(entity: Entity)
	const part = Entity.GetPrimaryPart(entity)
	const cframe = part and part.CFrame or entity.latestCFrame
	if not cframe or entity.destroyed then
		return
	end
	if entity.id < 1 then
		Warn.high(entity, " has invalid id, cannot check for proximity")
		return
	end
	const position: vector = cframe.Position :: any
	const entityConfig = entity.entityConfig
	local hasNormalTickers = false
	local hasHalfTickers = false
	const halfTickDistance = entityConfig.HALF_TICK_DISTANCE or math.huge
	const normalTickDistance = entityConfig.NORMAL_TICK_DISTANCE or math.huge
	const networkOwner = entity.networkOwner
	const ownedHolder = networkOwner and playerToHolder[networkOwner]

	const isLocked = entity._lockedCFReplication
	const isNotNative = isLocked or entity.modelReplicationMode ~= "NATIVE"
	for holder, playerPos in playerTablePositionPair do
		const viewer = holder.PLAYER
		const allowed = RuleAllows(entity, viewer)
		if not allowed then
			continue
		end

		const distance = vector.magnitude(position - playerPos)

		-- if entity is native then we keep it half ticked else remove it
		if distance > halfTickDistance and isNotNative then
			if holder == ownedHolder then -- always replicate to the owner
				hasNormalTickers = true
				table.insert(holder._TEMP_NORMAL, entity)
			end
			continue
		end

		if distance <= normalTickDistance then
			hasNormalTickers = true
			table.insert(holder._TEMP_NORMAL, entity)
		else
			hasHalfTickers = true
			table.insert(holder._TEMP_HALF, entity)
		end
	end

	const configTicker = entityConfig.TICKER
	if not configTicker then
		return
	end

	const currentTicker = entity._ticker
	if hasHalfTickers and not hasNormalTickers then
		SetTickMode(entity, true)
		HALF_TICKED += 1
	elseif hasNormalTickers then
		SetTickMode(entity, false)
		FULL_TICKED += 1
	else
		UN_TICKED += 1
	end
	if (hasNormalTickers or hasHalfTickers) and entity._ticker ~= configTicker then
		Ticker.move(entity, configTicker)
	elseif not (hasNormalTickers or hasHalfTickers) and currentTicker then
		SetTickMode(entity, nil)
		Ticker.Remove(currentTicker, entity)
	end
end

local yielded: thread? = nil
local totalTime = 0
const function DoLoop()
	totalTime = 0
	FULL_TICKED = 0
	HALF_TICKED = 0
	UN_TICKED = 0
	for holder, _ in playerTablePositionPair do
		table.clear(holder._TEMP_HALF)
		table.clear(holder._TEMP_NORMAL)
	end
	debug.profilebegin("EntityGrid.Update")
	local count = 0
	local start = os.clock()
	local sections = 1
	-- clone as the table could be mutated
	for _, entity in table.clone(entities) do
		debug.profilebegin(`Check One`)
		Check(entity)
		count += 1
		debug.profileend()
		if os.clock() - start > MAX_TIME_PER_UPDATE then
			sections += 1
			debug.profileend()
			totalTime += os.clock() - start
			yielded = coroutine.running()
			coroutine.yield()
			yielded = nil
			start = os.clock()
			debug.profilebegin("EntityGrid.ResumeUpdate")
		end
	end
	debug.profileend()
	totalTime += os.clock() - start
	Stats.SERVER.GRID_UPDATE_SECTIONS = sections
	Stats.SERVER.ENTITY_GRID_UPDATE_TIME_MS = totalTime * 1000
	Stats.SERVER.NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES = count
	Stats.SERVER.ENTITIES_FULL_TICKED = FULL_TICKED
	Stats.SERVER.ENTITIES_HALF_TICKED = HALF_TICKED
	Stats.SERVER.NON_TICKED = UN_TICKED

	for _, holder in playerToHolder do
		table.clear(holder.HALF)
		table.clear(holder.NORMAL)
		for _, entity in holder._TEMP_NORMAL do
			table.insert(holder.NORMAL, entity)
		end
		for _, entity in holder._TEMP_HALF do
			table.insert(holder.HALF, entity)
		end
	end

	if Stats.SERVER._SHOULD_REPLICATE then
		const gridStats = {}
		for _, holder in playerToHolder do
			const entry = { HALF = {}, NORMAL = {} }
			for _, entity in holder.NORMAL do
				table.insert(entry.NORMAL, entity.id)
			end
			for _, entity in holder.HALF do
				table.insert(entry.HALF, entity.id)
			end
			gridStats[holder.PLAYER.Name] = entry
		end
		Stats.SERVER.GRID_STATS = gridStats
	end
end

-- this might be able to be optimized more later
const function Update()
	if yielded then
		task.spawn(yielded)
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastUpdate < UPDATE_INTERVAL then
		return
	end
	lastUpdate = os.clock()
	task.spawn(DoLoop)
end

const function UpdatePlayerPosition(player: Player, position: vector)
	const holder = playerToHolder[player]
	if not holder then
		return
	end
	playerTablePositionPair[holder] = position
end

const function GetEntityHolder(Player: Player): PlayerEntityHolder?
	return playerToHolder[Player]
end

const function PlayerAdded(player: Player)
	if playerToHolder[player] then
		return
	end
	const t: PlayerEntityHolder = {
		PLAYER = player,
		HALF = {},
		NORMAL = {},
		REPLICATED = {},
		_TEMP_HALF = {},
		_TEMP_NORMAL = {},
		EntityAdded = Signal.new(),
		EntityRemoving = Signal.new(),
	}
	playerToHolder[player] = t
	playerTablePositionPair[t] = vector.zero

	Events._Signals.PlayerLoaded:Fire(player)
end
if RunService:IsServer() then
	Shared.Remotes.ClientLoaded.OnServerEvent:Connect(PlayerAdded)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		const holder = playerToHolder[player]
		if not holder then
			return
		end
		holder.EntityAdded:DisconnectAll()
		holder.EntityRemoving:DisconnectAll()
		playerTablePositionPair[holder] = nil
		playerToHolder[player] = nil
	end)
end

return {
	Update = Update,
	UpdatePlayerPosition = UpdatePlayerPosition,
	GetEntityHolder = GetEntityHolder,
}
